manifest.scope: Photo/video collection managers, end-user galleries, photo-library organization utilities, and duplicate-file cleanup tools. Desktop, web/server, CLI and mobile are eligible. Legacy repositories are included and labelled. General-purpose editors, single-image viewers without substantive collection organization, SDKs/components, AI generators, backup/download-only tools, generic CMS/file hosting, and release-only binary repositories are excluded.
manifest.ranking: Highest live GitHub star counts among the explicitly eligible repositories in the documented discovery pool; not an authoritative ranking of every project on GitHub.
notes: The user explicitly allowed legacy projects. Distinct legacy/current repositories in a product lineage are retained; repository-frequency and family-frequency are both reported to expose this bias.
Immich-go, Google Photos Takeout Helper, osxphotos and similar utilities are eligible because they implement substantive photo-library import/organization workflows, not just downloading files.
Image-hosting projects are eligible only as full end-user gallery/collection-management applications; SDKs, upload transports and generic file-sharing servers are not.
Capabilities are documentation/code evidence, not an assertion that all 50 applications were installed, benchmarked, or safety-audited.

additional_discovery: Explicit checks for known photo-library and cleanup projects whose names/descriptions did not match keyword searches.
meichthys/foss_photo_libraries used only to discover candidate names; its comparison cells were not used as feature evidence.
Live GitHub GraphQL metadata for every explicitly eligible candidate before selecting the highest-starred 50.
limitations: Search results are capped and depend on names, descriptions, topics and indexing; this is not an exhaustive GitHub census.
Eligibility requires editorial judgement. The report states the exact scope and publishes selected/eligible-below-cutoff/excluded candidate records.
Unselected discovery candidates were descriptively screened, not subjected to the individual deep feature analysis required of all selected repositories.
Stars of monorepositories and archived/fork-lineage repositories are not directly comparable measures of current product adoption.

duplicates.cleanup.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

duplicates.configurable_similarity.name: Classic algorithm and threshold controls
duplicates.configurable_similarity.definition: Choose grayscale percentage-difference or pHash, or combine both so either match qualifies. Controls include hash-difference threshold, minimum similarity and required fraction of matching sampled pHash frames.
duplicates.configurable_similarity.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

duplicates.content_detection.name: Duplicate detection
duplicates.content_detection.definition: Checking file duplication remains on the roadmap. Current processed-path and destination-name sets are not duplicate-content detection.
duplicates.content_detection.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

duplicates.cross_root_isolation.name: Match only across independent trees
duplicates.cross_root_isolation.definition: --isolate counts matching content within one root as one replica, distinguishing cross-tree backups from repeated paths inside a tree; removal can retain/drop a root's matching files together.
duplicates.cross_root_isolation.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

duplicates.database_comparison.name: Compare against prior/missing files
duplicates.database_comparison.definition: Settings can scan against the entire database and include non-existing files; tombstone mode also enables missing-file comparison.
duplicates.database_comparison.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

duplicates.deferred_verification.name: Defer verification until deletion
duplicates.deferred_verification.definition: --deferconfirmation postpones byte-level equality checks in interactive mode until immediately before deletion.
duplicates.deferred_verification.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

duplicates.delete_files.name: Delete redundant files
duplicates.delete_files.definition: remove permanently removes selected redundant entries using the separately reviewed report and keeper policies.
duplicates.delete_files.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

duplicates.deleted_content_memory.name: Remember deleted content
duplicates.deleted_content_memory.definition: Optional RememberDeletedContent retains fingerprints when the last copy is deleted, so re-downloaded content can be recognized; database cleanup becomes tombstone-aware. This is not a general reviewed-pair ignore list.
duplicates.deleted_content_memory.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

duplicates.duration_tolerance.name: Duration candidate constraints
duplicates.duration_tolerance.definition: Configure percentage duration tolerance with minimum/maximum seconds bounds; with percentage disabled, seconds-only tolerance is supported. Maximum sampled duration is also configurable.
duplicates.duration_tolerance.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

duplicates.existing_hardlink_policy.name: Recognize existing hard links during duplicate scans
duplicates.existing_hardlink_policy.definition: Account for multiple paths referring to the same underlying file and control or document whether they count as duplicates. This does not imply creating hard links.

duplicates.external_result_mirroring.name: Legacy dupeGuru metadata mirroring
duplicates.external_result_mirroring.definition: Tools page describes loading dupeGuru result files and mirroring entry fields before deleting elsewhere, but current roadmap marks Fix Duplicate Files a regression still to restore; not a current built-in scanner.
duplicates.external_result_mirroring.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

duplicates.fielded_names.name: Ordered or reordered filename fields
duplicates.fielded_names.definition: Dash-separated fields are compared individually; an order-independent mode can match artist/title reversed between files, with each field used once.
duplicates.fielded_names.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

duplicates.filesystem_boundary.name: Single-filesystem matching
duplicates.filesystem_boundary.definition: --one-fs skips nested mount points and cross-filesystem symlinks and avoids matching across devices/filesystems.
duplicates.filesystem_boundary.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

duplicates.flat_results.name: Dupes-only review mode
duplicates.flat_results.definition: Hide reference rows to sort all duplicate files independently by columns, combine with relative values, and mark batches such as extension or bitrate differences.
duplicates.flat_results.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

duplicates.folder_relationship.name: Same/different-folder matching
duplicates.folder_relationship.definition: FolderMatchMode permits unrestricted, same-folder-only or different-folder-only matching with configurable same-folder depth.
duplicates.folder_relationship.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

duplicates.follow_symlinks.name: Optional symlink traversal
duplicates.follow_symlinks.definition: --symlinks follows symlinked directories; manual warns that keeping a link while deleting its target can lose the usable file.
duplicates.follow_symlinks.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

duplicates.geometric_invariance.name: Rotated and mirrored duplicate matching
duplicates.geometric_invariance.definition: Optional comparison setting adds mirror/flip and 90-degree rotation variants; changed invariance/hash/filter parameters create distinct cached signatures.
duplicates.geometric_invariance.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

duplicates.link_fallback_chain.name: Ordered action fallbacks
duplicates.link_fallback_chain.definition: Configure comma-separated handlers; smart link tries clone, reflink, hardlink then symlink. Default script handler is permanent remove, not trash.
duplicates.link_fallback_chain.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

duplicates.metadata_candidates.name: Attribute-based possible-duplicate detection
duplicates.metadata_candidates.definition: Identify candidate duplicates using names, sizes, dates or dimensions without claiming content equality. Available attributes and false-positive risks vary.

duplicates.metadata_collapse.name: Collapse presumed duplicate timeline entries
duplicates.metadata_collapse.definition: De-duplicate identical files setting collapses matching AUID entries and retains hidden copies for bulk actions. Missing AUID is derived from MD5(timestamp plus file size), not file bytes; this is presentation deduplication, not verified exact-content cleanup.
duplicates.metadata_collapse.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

duplicates.metadata_merge.name: Preserve metadata when deduplicating
duplicates.metadata_merge.definition: Preserve metadata when deduplicating. Exact behavior, limits, editions and platforms are specified in the per-repository evidence.
duplicates.metadata_merge.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

duplicates.metadata_preservation_checks.name: Metadata-aware automated comparisons
duplicates.metadata_preservation_checks.definition: Rule comparators can protect EXIF/XMP/IPTC/human-readable/software metadata and ICC presence; they check presence flags, not equality or richness of contents.
duplicates.metadata_preservation_checks.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

duplicates.modified_time_bounds.name: Incremental mtime and tolerance filters
duplicates.modified_time_bounds.definition: Scan files newer than a timestamp or updated stamp file, retaining size siblings as comparison candidates. Separate mtime-window requires content-equal files to lie within a time window, which can transitively chain groups.
duplicates.modified_time_bounds.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

duplicates.move_aside.name: Move redundant copies
duplicates.move_aside.definition: move sends selected redundant files to a target directory instead of deleting or linking them; this is not described as an OS trash integration.
duplicates.move_aside.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

duplicates.name_constraints.name: Name and relative-path match constraints
duplicates.name_constraints.definition: Require same/different basename, extension, extensionless name, parent directory or relative path in addition to content matching; optional case-insensitivity is ASCII-only, not fuzzy-image/name matching.
duplicates.name_constraints.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

duplicates.neural_transformed_videos.name: Neural transformed-copy detection
duplicates.neural_transformed_videos.definition: DINOv2 embeddings via ONNX add matches for cropped, mirrored, zoomed, letterboxed or heavily edited copies; classic results remain authoritative and are never hidden by enabling AI. Default threshold is 94%.
duplicates.neural_transformed_videos.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

duplicates.order_policy.name: Deterministic output and keeper ordering
duplicates.order_policy.definition: Order by modification time (default), status-change time or filename, with reversal; changelog documents ctime tie-breaking for mtime.
duplicates.order_policy.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

duplicates.partial_content.name: Explicit byte-range comparison
duplicates.partial_content.definition: Clamp start/end by byte offset, percentage or factor to compare part of each file, e.g. excluding a fixed header. Results are partial-content matches, not exact whole-file duplicates.
duplicates.partial_content.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

duplicates.partial_hash_only.name: Optional partial-hash-only matching
duplicates.partial_hash_only.definition: --skip-content-hash bypasses whole-file hashing, with explicit false-positive warnings and advice to enlarge prefix/suffix samples. This mode is not safe exact-content verification.
duplicates.partial_hash_only.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

duplicates.path_selection.name: Path and regex-based review selection
duplicates.path_selection.definition: Select/deselect by substring, prefix, suffix, exact path or PCRE2 expression; clear or invert selections within affected sets before tagging them.
duplicates.path_selection.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

duplicates.permission_match.name: Require matching ownership and permissions
duplicates.permission_match.definition: --permissions prevents files with different owner, group or permission bits from being considered duplicates.
duplicates.permission_match.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

duplicates.pixel_identity.name: Exact decoded-pixel matches
duplicates.pixel_identity.definition: Distinguishes same-resolution/pixel-content matches even when metadata or file encoding differs; pixel hashes can be regenerated independently.
duplicates.pixel_identity.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

duplicates.preprocess_matching.name: External preprocessing before matching
duplicates.preprocess_matching.definition: --transform invokes an external program per file, with pipe or $IN/$OUT support. Documentation demonstrates stripping EXIF with exiv2 before matching, not perceptual image matching.
duplicates.preprocess_matching.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

duplicates.query_scoped_pairs.name: Independent queries for pair sides
duplicates.query_scoped_pairs.definition: Require one side, both sides or different searches per side, plus maximum Hamming distance and require/exclude pixel matches; mixed-pair or full-group review modes.
duplicates.query_scoped_pairs.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

duplicates.remaining_copy_filter.name: Hide resolved groups safely
duplicates.remaining_copy_filter.definition: Can hide groups with at most one remaining existing member; files on disconnected drives still count as offline rather than deleted.
duplicates.remaining_copy_filter.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

duplicates.replay_reports.name: Merge and replay prior scans
duplicates.replay_reports.definition: Replay saved JSON to change ranking/filter/output or merge previous runs without rehashing. It does not discover new paths and ignores entries whose mtime changed; hashing/traversal options no longer apply.
duplicates.replay_reports.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

duplicates.replication_counts.name: Unique and under/over-replicated files
duplicates.replication_counts.definition: Can report unique files or groups below/above a chosen replication factor, rather than only pairs of duplicates.
duplicates.replication_counts.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

duplicates.result_similarity_filter.name: Similarity and selected-group filters
duplicates.result_similarity_filter.definition: Result filters support minimum/maximum similarity and groups with checked items.
duplicates.result_similarity_filter.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

duplicates.review_cleanup.name: Scoped and library-wide duplicate review
duplicates.review_cleanup.definition: Duplicate scans can target a collection or selection; library-wide cleanup reports reclaimable space and bulk removes chosen copies. Sources do not specify hash versus perceptual equality.
duplicates.review_cleanup.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

duplicates.review_status.name: Persist pending/resolved review records
duplicates.review_status.definition: Filter pending/resolved/type, delete group records individually/in bulk or clear pending groups before detection. Looser reruns exclude photos already in visual groups, so groups must be cleared to reconsider them.
duplicates.review_status.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

duplicates.rich_alternate_labels.name: Rich alternate categorization
duplicates.rich_alternate_labels.definition: Basic alternate relationships exist, but ordered WIP/recolour labels and richer presentation are explicitly future work; large alternate sets currently scale poorly.
duplicates.rich_alternate_labels.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

duplicates.rotation_dimension_tolerance.name: Cross-resolution and rotated picture matches
duplicates.rotation_dimension_tolerance.definition: Preferences can permit differing dimensions and rotations in the same picture duplicate group and allow mixed file extensions.
duplicates.rotation_dimension_tolerance.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

duplicates.selective_recursion.name: Control recursion per directory argument
duplicates.selective_recursion.definition: --recurse traverses all supplied roots; --recurse: traverses only roots positioned after that option, permitting mixed shallow/deep scans.
duplicates.selective_recursion.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

duplicates.stored_fingerprint.name: Stored original-content fingerprints
duplicates.stored_fingerprint.definition: Expose Photos' stored hash of original file for cross-library matching, distinct from the metadata-based duplicates property.
duplicates.stored_fingerprint.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

duplicates.traversal_controls.name: Traversal boundaries and link handling
duplicates.traversal_controls.definition: Limit depth, mount crossing, hidden files and permission eligibility; follow symlinks, ignore them or compare their target strings. Loop detection is documented when following links.
duplicates.traversal_controls.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

duplicates.unique_inventory.name: Unique-file inventory and complete hashes
duplicates.unique_inventory.definition: Unique-path formatter emits nonduplicate paths; --hash-unmatched completes hashes for same-size nonduplicates, while --hash-uniques hashes every traversed file, including unique sizes.
duplicates.unique_inventory.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

duplicates.video_audio_fingerprints.name: Video audio-fingerprint matching
duplicates.video_audio_fingerprints.definition: Separate audio comparison mode uses similarity, shorter/longer duration ratio, minimum duration and maximum audio difference; Krokiet manual says this mode itself does not require ffmpeg, unlike visual hashing/thumbnails.
duplicates.video_audio_fingerprints.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

duplicates.visual_partial_clips.name: Silent/retimed clip matching
duplicates.visual_partial_clips.definition: Independent AI partial-detection switch compares dense keyframes by a consistent time offset; at least four hits must agree, default frame threshold 89%. Works without audio, including muted/re-dubbed clips.
duplicates.visual_partial_clips.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

duplicates.visual_transform_controls.name: Flip/background matching controls
duplicates.visual_transform_controls.definition: Core settings expose horizontal-flip comparison and ignoring black/white pixels, distinct from optional neural transformed-copy detection.
duplicates.visual_transform_controls.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

editing.annotations.name: Draw, annotate or add text/stickers to images
editing.annotations.definition: Add drawn or composited annotations to image pixels; this is distinct from searchable metadata captions.

editing.color_palette.name: Image color palette screen
editing.color_palette.definition: v0.7 lists Color Palette and single-media handler opens PaletteActivity for the current file; color search/editing is not implied.
editing.color_palette.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

editing.draw_filters.name: Drawing and filters
editing.draw_filters.definition: README explicitly includes drawing and image filters in the basic editor; no professional RAW processing is implied.
editing.draw_filters.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

editing.export_renditions.name: Resolution/format export dialog
editing.export_renditions.definition: Admins/Users export originals, full-size previews, resized JPEGs or playable video renditions with per-download retry; Viewers/Guests/Visitors may download but not use Export.
editing.export_renditions.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

editing.face_blur.name: Blur a person's faces in copies
editing.face_blur.definition: Blur everywhere creates new copies of photos containing the selected person; face models also enable local blur/mosaic editor tools.
editing.face_blur.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

editing.filters.name: Composition photo filters
editing.filters.definition: Help describes choosing a filter in media options, labels it experimental and explicitly says filters are not federated.
editing.filters.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

editing.fisheye_dewarp.name: Background Insta360 dewarping
editing.fisheye_dewarp.definition: INSV/INSP/fisheye DNG become equirectangular derivatives using known camera FOV or configured fallback; dual-lens video/proxy files stack and originals stay unchanged.
editing.fisheye_dewarp.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

editing.hdr_tonemap.name: HDR-to-SDR previews and playback
editing.hdr_tonemap.definition: HDR phone video is tone-mapped during thumbnail/conversion paths; HDR badges and probe/rebuild job repair older previews.
editing.hdr_tonemap.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

editing.image_compression.name: Image compression / encoder-quality controls
editing.image_compression.definition: Reduce image output size or configure encoder quality. Algorithms, targets, metadata handling and animation limits vary.

editing.layers.name: Layered photo compositing
editing.layers.definition: Up to sixteen JPEG/PNG image layers, locked base, reorder/duplicate/hide/lock, transforms, five blend modes, opacity, clipping and erase/paint masks; output flattens visible layers and missing source media can be relinked on recovery.
editing.layers.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

editing.motion_extract.name: Extract motion clips or selected frames
editing.motion_extract.definition: Save embedded motion as a separate video or use frame picker for stills without changing source. Editing its still creates a separate image copy.
editing.motion_extract.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

editing.nondestructive_photo_editor.name: General non-destructive photo edits
editing.nondestructive_photo_editor.definition: README places cropping and colour adjustments in planned/in-progress enhancements, separate from existing lossless metadata and export processing.
editing.nondestructive_photo_editor.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

editing.processing_scopes.name: Three-level image-processing inheritance
editing.processing_scopes.definition: Named configuration overrides provider overrides global defaults, including explicit disabled switches. Effective settings show value sources and can revert to inherited values.
editing.processing_scopes.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

editing.proprietary_adjustments.name: Advanced SDK filters and adjustments
editing.proprietary_adjustments.definition: Proprietary build conditionally includes IMG.LY advanced editor. UI defines exposure, highlights, shadows, clarity, gamma, colour, blur-focus, overlays, text and sticker controls; these must not be attributed to every FOSS build.
editing.proprietary_adjustments.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

editing.raw_development.name: RAW sensor development controls
editing.raw_development.definition: White-balance presets/custom temp/tint; exposure/tone; sharpening; Linear/VNG/PPG/AHD/DCB demosaic; denoise and half resolution; sRGB/AdobeRGB/Wide/ProPhoto output; clip/blend/rebuild highlights. TIFF 8/16 export only holds development, not additional crop/markup/look edits.
editing.raw_development.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

editing.remote_compression.name: Single/batch TinyPNG compression
editing.remote_compression.definition: README lists batch compression; configured TinyPNG processing accepts JPEG/PNG, skips previously compressed records and overwrites the local original with downloaded output. Multiple configured API keys can be selected.
editing.remote_compression.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

editing.video_adjustments.name: Per-clip video picture changes
editing.video_adjustments.definition: Transform/crop Fit/Fill/Crop, scale/rotation/position/horizontal flip/background plus per-clip light/color/curves and opacity.
editing.video_adjustments.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

editing.video_audio_mixing.name: Voice-over and multitrack audio
editing.video_audio_mixing.definition: Import audio, record local voice-over or extract clip sound; mix gain/pan/fades/mute/solo/master limiter, channel routing/mono downmix, sidechain ducking and three-band EQ/high-pass.
editing.video_audio_mixing.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

editing.video_auto_crop.name: Detect static video borders
editing.video_auto_crop.definition: ffmpeg-backed optimization detects black bars or static edge content using thresholds/sample limits and applies the proposed crop to selected files.
editing.video_auto_crop.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

editing.video_crop_rotate.name: Video framing and orientation
editing.video_crop_rotate.definition: Mobile crops freely or to 1:1, 9:16, 16:9, 3:4 or 4:3 and rotates in 90-degree steps, accounting for original orientation.
editing.video_crop_rotate.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

formats.additional_ai_inputs.name: Audio, video and ebook understanding
formats.additional_ai_inputs.definition: Semantic support for ebooks, audio and video is listed as future work; extension-only ebook placement is already present in type mode.
formats.additional_ai_inputs.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

formats.adjustment_sidecars.name: AAE edit round-trip
formats.adjustment_sidecars.definition: Export AAE adjustment files and re-import with original/edited companions to preserve non-destructive edits when Photos naming conventions match; unmatched edits become separate assets.
formats.adjustment_sidecars.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

formats.alternate_downloads.name: Multiple formats per image
formats.alternate_downloads.definition: enable_formats plus format_ext associates files such as CR2, CMYK JPEG or ZIP in pwg_format with one image. Cloud offers this from Enterprise; storing RAW companions does not prove RAW decoding.
formats.alternate_downloads.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

formats.arbitrary_uploads.name: Configured non-image uploads
formats.arbitrary_uploads.definition: Add extensions such as MP4, PDF or MP3 and disable image-only mode to upload other types. This does not establish a video/audio playback library.
formats.arbitrary_uploads.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

formats.archive_ebook_previews.name: Archive/eBook covers
formats.archive_ebook_previews.definition: ZIP/RAR/7z/Tar variants show first archive image; EPUB shows cover and comic-book archives use cover/first page.
formats.archive_ebook_previews.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

formats.burst_grouping.name: Burst pattern handling
formats.burst_grouping.definition: Collection has configurable burst patterns; v1.15.6 adds Realme pattern recognition.
formats.burst_grouping.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

formats.burst_groups.name: Burst companion preservation
formats.burst_groups.definition: Default export includes burst photos unless skipped; macOS 11+ import groups burst members, unlike older versions. Missing iCloud bursts remain a documented limitation.
formats.burst_groups.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

formats.content_detection.name: Content-based filetype detection and override
formats.content_detection.definition: Detects type by inspecting content rather than trusting extension/MIME; users can force a type from context menu.
formats.content_detection.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

formats.document_project_previews.name: Document and creative-project previews
formats.document_project_previews.definition: PDF first-page rendering, PSD flattened image, and embedded thumbnails for Blender/Krita/Clip Studio/iWork/OpenDocument/PowerPoint and other listed formats; embedded preview availability varies.
formats.document_project_previews.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

formats.document_text_extraction.name: Document content extraction
formats.document_text_extraction.definition: Readers handle UTF-8 text/Markdown, DOCX-style documents, PDF, Excel/CSV and PowerPoint text. Plain text is capped at 3,000 characters and PDF at its first three pages; legacy .doc/.ppt are routed through libraries primarily intended for modern formats, so successful legacy parsing is not guaranteed.
formats.document_text_extraction.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

formats.documents_archives.name: Document/archive cataloguing
formats.documents_archives.definition: Can import PDF/Office/ebook/archive formats with differing previews; PDF thumbnails except encrypted PDFs and CBZ identification do not imply internal document reading.
formats.documents_archives.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

formats.font_text_previews.name: Font and plaintext previews
formats.font_text_previews.definition: Font formats show Aa/alphanumeric samples; plaintext previews render only first 256 bytes. Full text/syntax highlighting remain planned.
formats.font_text_previews.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

formats.front_back_pairs.name: Double-sided image pairs
formats.front_back_pairs.definition: Back2Front links a reverse-side photo to a front ID, can hide the back from album listings and exposes See back in the viewer.
formats.front_back_pairs.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

formats.geotiff.name: GeoTIFF overlay
formats.geotiff.definition: Detects GeoTIFF and exposes Show as map overlay rather than merely treating georeferenced TIFF as an ordinary thumbnail.
formats.geotiff.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

formats.hdr.name: HDR photo decoding/display
formats.hdr.definition: Decode or display supported HDR photos, including Ultra HDR/gain-map variants; device and format constraints are preserved in repository evidence.

formats.hdr_thumbnails.name: Ultra HDR thumbnail metadata
formats.hdr_thumbnails.definition: Desktop v1.7.30 preserves HDR gain maps in Ultra HDR JPEG thumbnails generated on Linux/Windows; this is narrower than a universal HDR rendering guarantee.
formats.hdr_thumbnails.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

formats.heic_jpeg_pairs.name: Manage HEIC+JPEG companions
formats.heic_jpeg_pairs.definition: Offers separate, keep-HEIC, keep-JPEG and either-cover stacking modes based on matching basenames; this is not by itself proof of Live Photo video pairing.
formats.heic_jpeg_pairs.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

performance.linux_io_optimization.definition: Orders accesses by physical placement and uses page-cache drop-behind on Linux; documentation says these optimizations are unavailable on other platforms.
performance.linux_io_optimization.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

performance.loading_policy.name: Speed versus validity/quality controls
performance.loading_policy.definition: Settings expose file-loading priority choices including speed, compromise and avoiding invalid files, plus high-quality deep-zoom rendering.
performance.loading_policy.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

performance.low_memory_paths.name: Compressed paths for large trees
performance.low_memory_paths.definition: README attributes low memory use on millions of paths to prefix-compressed representations; this is a project claim, not a measured result here.
performance.low_memory_paths.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

performance.multiple_transcoders.name: External and distributed transcoding
performance.multiple_transcoders.definition: Deploy separate go-vod containers/hosts and list several addresses for load distribution with per-client sticky routing; supports external/object storage with documented setup.
performance.multiple_transcoders.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

performance.native_ffmpeg.name: Optional native FFmpeg bindings
performance.native_ffmpeg.definition: Can call FFmpeg functions natively for claimed speed improvement; requires compatible FFmpeg 8.x shared libraries rather than master builds.
performance.native_ffmpeg.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

performance.parallel_export_api.name: Threaded export integration
performance.parallel_export_api.definition: API documents concurrent export using threads on Python 3.11+; PhotosDB cannot be pickled for multiprocessing. This is an API/example capability, not a claimed default CLI speedup.
performance.parallel_export_api.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

performance.parallel_thumbnails.name: Concurrent thumbnail generation
performance.parallel_thumbnails.definition: Thumbnail workers default to CPU count minus one with configurable concurrency cap; this is derivative processing, not a claim of parallel scanning or perceptual matching.
performance.parallel_thumbnails.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

performance.pause_server_jobs.name: Pause server processing during import
performance.pause_server_jobs.definition: --pause-immich-jobs defaults true to reduce thumbnail/other server workload during a bulk upload, requiring appropriate server permissions.
performance.pause_server_jobs.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

performance.per_item_failure_isolation.name: Continue past failed photos
performance.per_item_failure_isolation.definition: Per-photo errors mark an item failed and continue, while fatal errors terminate nonzero; logs/TUI report counts.
performance.per_item_failure_isolation.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

performance.progress_reporting.name: Progress and elapsed time
performance.progress_reporting.definition: Progress and elapsed time. Exact behavior, limits, editions and platforms are specified in the per-repository evidence.
performance.progress_reporting.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

performance.query_embedding_cache.name: Shared in-flight query cache
performance.query_embedding_cache.definition: AI-search controller caches normalized query embeddings/futures so simultaneous equivalent queries share a remote call; zero-length polling skips Bedrock/KNN work.
performance.query_embedding_cache.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

performance.redirect_cache.name: Cache dispatch targets
performance.redirect_cache.definition: Dispatch stores URL targets with a 3600 cache duration and redirects directly on cache hits; release notes identify Redis cache fixes.
performance.redirect_cache.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

performance.remote_thumbnail_storage.name: Remote thumbnail publication
performance.remote_thumbnail_storage.definition: Bundled opt-in thumbnail-storage plugin uploads derivatives to default/secondary storage, rewrites URLs, deduplicates uploads per run and falls back to local URLs on upload failure.
performance.remote_thumbnail_storage.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

performance.retained_page_state.name: Retain tool results during navigation
performance.retained_page_state.definition: 1.2.3 scans uninstall/startup/privacy pages on first opening and preserves results, scroll position and category choices on page switches.
performance.retained_page_state.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

performance.retry.name: Retry unreliable exports
performance.retry.definition: --retry sets export retry attempts for failures such as intermittent NAS connections.
performance.retry.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

performance.ripgrep_scan.name: Optional fast directory scanner
performance.ripgrep_scan.definition: Installed ripgrep replaces wcmatch scanning for speed and Git-style glob parity; docs warn fallback pattern behavior can differ.
performance.ripgrep_scan.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

performance.scheduled_tasks.name: Scheduled task execution
performance.scheduled_tasks.definition: README lists scheduled task dispatch as an unchecked roadmap item; asynchronous immediate work is separate.
performance.scheduled_tasks.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

performance.split_workers.name: Separate API and processing workers
performance.split_workers.definition: Include/exclude worker settings let containers isolate web/API work from background processing and distribute resources.
performance.split_workers.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

performance.tiled_rendering.name: Off-thread tiled decoding
performance.tiled_rendering.definition: Large photos decode in a worker and stream tiles to the GPU instead of decoding entirely on the main UI thread.
performance.tiled_rendering.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

privacy.access_rules.name: Hotlink and file-access controls
privacy.access_rules.definition: Allowed source domains, file/IP allow/block lists and whitelist-only access can restrict public delivery; CDN caches may delay enforcement.
privacy.access_rules.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

privacy.activity_cleanup.name: Browser and system trace cleanup
privacy.activity_cleanup.definition: Clears selected browsing history, searches, cookies, recent items and clipboard traces; not equivalent to secure disk erasure.
privacy.activity_cleanup.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

privacy.ai_key_encryption.name: Encrypted provider-key storage
privacy.ai_key_encryption.definition: AI_CONFIG_SECRET encrypts saved API keys; operator must keep a separate backup because secret loss/change makes keys unreadable. This does not encrypt hosted images end-to-end.
privacy.ai_key_encryption.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

privacy.app_lock.name: Local application access lock
privacy.app_lock.definition: Gate application or media access with a PIN, password or device authentication. Access locks alone do not imply encrypted files.

privacy.app_private_vault.name: Locked app-private vaults
privacy.app_private_vault.definition: Vaults support pattern/PIN/password and biometric unlock, with optional lock when the screen turns off. Warning states app uninstall/data-clear loses vault items; encryption at rest is not established by these sources.
privacy.app_private_vault.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

privacy.authentication_gates.name: Password and fingerprint gates
privacy.authentication_gates.definition: Configure password checks for hidden content/deletion and fingerprint unlock when Android M+ and hardware support it; password checks compare a stored SHA-256 hash.
privacy.authentication_gates.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

privacy.backup_encryption.name: Password-protected backup archive
privacy.backup_encryption.definition: Optional archive password protects exported vault media, which is decrypted inside archive; vault custom credentials are included only with protected archives. Without archive password restored vault uses device lock.
privacy.backup_encryption.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

privacy.capture_protection.name: Block app-content screen capture
privacy.capture_protection.definition: General Settings Secure Mode blocks screenshots, screen recordings and the recent-apps preview. It protects display/capture surfaces rather than encrypting ordinary files; vault encryption remains a separate feature.
privacy.capture_protection.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

privacy.disable_account.name: Temporary account deactivation
privacy.disable_account.definition: Disabling hides profile, photos, comments and likes until login reactivates the account; permanent deletion is separate and may have an admin-configured grace period.
privacy.disable_account.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

privacy.error_reporting_control.name: Local-first sanitized error reports
privacy.error_reporting_control.definition: 1.6.0 retains at most 30 reports for 30 days locally, deduplicating repeats; admin may opt into maintainers or own Sentry/GlitchTip. Reports rebuilt from allowlisted fields remove paths/names/URLs/identifiers.
privacy.error_reporting_control.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

privacy.guest_view.name: Authenticated-exit handoff viewer
privacy.guest_view.definition: Mobile guest view restricts browsing to one item/selection/album, hides edit/share/delete/info/navigation and requires configured device authentication to exit.
privacy.guest_view.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

privacy.hidden_archive.name: Separate hide and archive semantics
privacy.hidden_archive.definition: Hide removes photo from all ordinary views/shares except Hidden; Archive suppresses timeline/Memories but retains albums/search/places. Neither changes files or encrypts media.
privacy.hidden_archive.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

privacy.hidden_folders.name: Hidden folder/album visibility controls
privacy.hidden_folders.definition: Hide/unhide filesystem-backed media folders/albums using application state or media-scan markers. This is not an encryption guarantee.

privacy.hidden_media.name: Hidden media section
privacy.hidden_media.definition: Hide selected media from ordinary collection views and expose a separate hidden area. Authentication and encryption guarantees differ and must be checked in the repository evidence.

privacy.ip_blocklist.name: IP upload blocking
privacy.ip_blocklist.definition: Administrator-configurable IP blacklist is explicitly documented.
privacy.ip_blocklist.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

privacy.mobile_offline_mirror.name: Official source-preview offline editing
privacy.mobile_offline_mirror.definition: Unreleased mobile app mirrors metadata/grid thumbnails and queues favourite/hide/trash/rating/caption/album edits; full originals still need network unless already on device, and resync rebuilds disposable mirror.
privacy.mobile_offline_mirror.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

privacy.nsfw_display_controls.name: Manual NSFW display controls
privacy.nsfw_display_controls.definition: Hide or blur manually flagged NSFW content in listings, control inclusion in random results and lock user flag changes. This is not automatic moderation.
privacy.nsfw_display_controls.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

privacy.original_access_plugin.name: Webroot access-control extension
privacy.original_access_plugin.definition: README describes lychee-webroot as a separate extension controlling photo accessibility and keeping Lychee files hidden. Its existence must not be interpreted as default core original-file protection.
privacy.original_access_plugin.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

privacy.pin_locked_folder.name: PIN-locked assets
privacy.pin_locked_folder.definition: Locked Folder hides assets until session unlock; access initially lasts 15 minutes and can extend with activity. While unlocked, locked assets may appear in search/utilities; Lock/sign-out revokes access.
privacy.pin_locked_folder.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

privacy.private_people.name: Hide identities without hiding pictures
privacy.private_people.definition: Private/hidden people withhold names/regions from viewers/guests/visitors and remove names from generated titles after maintenance; pictures remain visible, so this is not redaction/encryption.
privacy.private_people.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

privacy.recovery_key.name: User-held recovery key
privacy.recovery_key.definition: A 24-word key recovers access after password loss; absent password, signed-in recovery route/key or preconfigured trusted contact, support cannot decrypt Photos data.
privacy.recovery_key.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

privacy.repository_anonymisation.name: Delayed repository account anonymisation
privacy.repository_anonymisation.definition: Repository content attribution is reassigned to a null account after default 90 days, configurable by operator; does not eliminate IP/content inference or malicious-server risks.
privacy.repository_anonymisation.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

privacy.screen_content_protection.name: Hide app-switcher content
privacy.screen_content_protection.definition: Mobile Hide content obscures app-switcher views and disables screenshots on Android; no claim of general screen-recording prevention is made.
privacy.screen_content_protection.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

privacy.session_security.name: Password hashing and configurable sessions
privacy.session_security.definition: PBKDF2 with legacy password migration, HttpOnly sessions, isolated admin/user login and configurable age. HTTPS-only Secure cookies are configurable and disabled by default.
privacy.session_security.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

privacy.source_link_protection.name: Protected original-image links
privacy.source_link_protection.definition: Configurable source protection uses keyed links; 2.8.7 changes token/key handling and invalidates old links. FAQ warns web-server image caching can cause 404 behavior.
privacy.source_link_protection.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

privacy.telemetry_control.name: Control or disable telemetry
privacy.telemetry_control.definition: Provide an explicit telemetry setting or opt-out. Presence of an opt-out does not mean telemetry is disabled by default.

privacy.two_factor_auth.name: Account two-factor authentication
privacy.two_factor_auth.definition: Require a second authentication factor for the media service account. Supported factors and recovery policies vary; authenticator products are not inventoried as photo features.

privacy.upload_ip_geolocation.name: Uploader IP recording and optional lookup
privacy.upload_ip_geolocation.definition: Optional custom API receives upload IP and selected JSON fields populate UploadAddress. This is uploader network geolocation, not photo GPS mapping.
privacy.upload_ip_geolocation.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

safety.account_activity_log.name: Account activity history
safety.account_activity_log.definition: Security help recommends reviewing Account Log for suspicious activity. This is account history, not a durable pre-operation crash-recovery file journal.
safety.account_activity_log.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

safety.atomic_report_export.name: Atomic report publication
safety.atomic_report_export.definition: Analysis export flushes and syncs a sibling temporary file before atomic publication; failed writes preserve the previous report destination. This is report safety, not copied-photo verification.
safety.atomic_report_export.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

safety.backup_deletion_separation.name: No automatic cross-device destructive sync
safety.backup_deletion_separation.definition: Native-device deletion does not delete backup, and cloud deletion does not silently erase the device original. Ente remembers uploaded files to avoid automatically re-uploading deliberately deleted cloud copies.
safety.backup_deletion_separation.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

safety.builder_dry_run.name: Non-writing builder inspection
safety.builder_dry_run.definition: --dry-run performs processing but does not save manifests, clean thumbnails or run plugin side effects; --key-regex limits inspection to matched storage keys.
safety.builder_dry_run.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

safety.changed_file_guards.name: Recheck changed files before cleanup actions
safety.changed_file_guards.definition: Validate reviewed files before destructive/cleanup actions and skip or reject stale targets. Exact checks and overrides vary.

safety.companion_operation_rollback.name: Companion-aware move rollback
safety.companion_operation_rollback.definition: If one file of a photo cannot move, previously moved companion files are put back; rename also retains old names on failure. Docs establish per-photo rollback, not a durable crash-recovery journal.
safety.companion_operation_rollback.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

safety.content_change_check.name: Rehash unchanged-timestamp files
safety.content_change_check.definition: Check file contents rereads every byte to detect replacements retaining old mtime, then reimports/reindexes changes with appropriate personal-data preservation. It is not documented as bit-rot recovery or copy verification.
safety.content_change_check.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

safety.corruption_preservation.name: Preserve corrupt catalogue
safety.corruption_preservation.definition: Detects per-library corruption and prompts a library switch while preserving the original database instead of silently rebuilding it.
safety.corruption_preservation.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

safety.date_reset.name: Reset original capture timestamp
safety.date_reset.definition: Timewarp --reset restores original recorded date/time/timezone only on macOS 13+ and only where Photos stored those original values.
safety.date_reset.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

safety.deletion_choice_log.name: Log deletion choices
safety.deletion_choice_log.definition: --log writes file-deletion choices to a chosen logfile; documentation does not describe rollback or saved file contents.
safety.deletion_choice_log.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

safety.dry_run.name: Preview imports, exports and edits
safety.dry_run.definition: Export/import/batch/sync/geotag/push-exif support dry-run paths; import also validates/render-checks templates and checks already-imported versus not-imported files without importing.
safety.dry_run.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

safety.export_trash_retention.name: Keep locally exported deleted copies
safety.export_trash_retention.definition: Cloud deletion moves exported files into an export Trash folder; subsequently emptying cloud Trash does not automatically delete those local copies.
safety.export_trash_retention.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

safety.free_space_guard.name: Optional low-disk operation guard
safety.free_space_guard.definition: Can pause index/import/upload below configured free-space percentage with 100 MB floor; disabled by default because network/FUSE/container probes may be unreliable.
safety.free_space_guard.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

safety.hash_database_backup.name: Timestamped checksum-cache backups
safety.hash_database_backup.definition: Storage implementation provides timestamped copies of existing hash.json; this is backup of small integrity metadata, not copies of all media.
safety.hash_database_backup.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

safety.hosted_catalogue_backup.name: Hosted database backup and restore checks
safety.hosted_catalogue_backup.definition: Specification describes HA Postgres, six-hour snapshots, daily portable dumps, encrypted locked cross-provider copies and daily restore testing with alerts. These are service operational claims, not tested here.
safety.hosted_catalogue_backup.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

safety.hosted_retention_lock.name: Provider-level deletion protection
safety.hosted_retention_lock.definition: Hosted Wasabi replica uses compliance hold plus a 21-day release buffer; cleanup occurs later after customer permanent deletion. This does not promise user restoration after Trash expires.
safety.hosted_retention_lock.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

safety.keyword_filters.name: User keyword filters
safety.keyword_filters.definition: Current configuration supports custom content filters with bounded keywords, scan length, regex size and creation/update rates; default limits include 20 filters and 10 keywords per filter.
safety.keyword_filters.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

safety.operation_history.name: Cleanup and change history
safety.operation_history.definition: Records completed cleanup/system changes, reclaimed space and failures. Duplicate deletion appends history after execution; this is not an undo-capable transactional operation journal.
safety.operation_history.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

safety.organization_preview.name: Preview proposed directory tree
safety.organization_preview.definition: Shows the proposed hierarchy before executing operations and offers another organization mode when the proposal is rejected; execute_operations also has an explicit non-mutating dry_run path.
safety.organization_preview.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

safety.parental_controls.name: Restricted child accounts
safety.parental_controls.definition: When administrators enable the feature, parents create linked child accounts and choose posting, commenting, liking/sharing and federation permissions; configured child-count limits apply.
safety.parental_controls.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

safety.partial_failure_reporting.name: Accurate batch-delete outcomes
safety.partial_failure_reporting.definition: Bulk deletion reports complete success, partial failure or total failure and returns failed paths instead of always claiming success.
safety.partial_failure_reporting.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

safety.people_yaml_backup.name: Automatic tagged-person YAML backup
safety.people_yaml_backup.definition: People manual lists automatic YAML backup of tagged people as upcoming; general metadata sidecars must not be assumed to fully back up face identities.
safety.people_yaml_backup.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

safety.permanent_delete.name: Explicit permanent cleanup
safety.permanent_delete.definition: Duplicate and disk-analysis deletion directly remove selected files, report removed/already-absent/failed outcomes and reconcile scan caches. Analysis stops a batch on possible partial mutation or lost authority.
safety.permanent_delete.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

safety.read_only_client.name: Mobile read-only/kid mode
safety.read_only_client.definition: Read-only app mode permits timeline viewing while preventing accidental device photo deletion; not an encrypted vault.
safety.read_only_client.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

safety.replica_restore.name: Replica restoration endpoint
safety.replica_restore.definition: Loader exposes images/restore calling restoreFromReplica; exact operator workflow/backup completeness remains unverified.
safety.replica_restore.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

safety.social_moderation.name: Mute/block/report controls
safety.social_moderation.definition: Accounts can be muted/blocked from feeds; direct messages can be reported or deleted. Config bounds user mutes/blocks/domain blocks.
safety.social_moderation.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

safety.storage_mount_checks.name: Startup storage health checks
safety.storage_mount_checks.definition: Read/write marker checks validate expected storage mounts and permissions; failed checks normally prevent server startup.
safety.storage_mount_checks.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

safety.sync_recovery_snapshots.name: Scoped synchronization rollback snapshots
safety.sync_recovery_snapshots.definition: Sync snapshots allow local rollback on failure with retention, size display, export/deletion and active-use protection. Cannot restore deleted remote objects; not general file-operation undo.
safety.sync_recovery_snapshots.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

safety.sync_simulation.name: Preview synchronization
safety.sync_simulation.definition: Simulation-only mode reports prospective filesystem/database synchronization without applying changes; distinct from a general undo journal.
safety.sync_simulation.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

safety.transform_copy.name: Protect originals during transforms
safety.transform_copy.definition: $IN transformations use a temporary copy by default; --no-copy deliberately permits the external command to modify the original and is warned as data-loss-prone.
safety.transform_copy.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

safety.trusted_contact_recovery.name: Photos Legacy recovery
safety.trusted_contact_recovery.definition: Previously accepted Ente trusted contacts can request recovery with a 7/14/30-day owner veto period, then change account password; configured from Photos mobile and applicable to photo succession.
safety.trusted_contact_recovery.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

safety.unavailable_library_guard.name: Unmounted/mass-missing protection
safety.unavailable_library_guard.definition: Missing-file detection checks whole result before changes, refuses apparently unmounted roots or configured excessive missing count and avoids flagging photos after unreadable-subfolder scans.
safety.unavailable_library_guard.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

safety.upload_finalization_recovery.name: Recover result saving without reupload
safety.upload_finalization_recovery.definition: Records remote completion separately from gallery/success-script finalization. Retrying original task uses persisted finalization data and API finalizationId rather than uploading again.
safety.upload_finalization_recovery.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

safety.upload_limits.name: Configurable upload size and type restrictions
safety.upload_limits.definition: Server enforces configured maximum size and allowed filename/MIME suffix combinations; this is not evidence of full decoding, malware scan or content-safety recognition.
safety.upload_limits.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

search.board_name.name: Find boards by name
search.board_name.definition: Board search uses name; autocomplete and owner-name filters help select boards.
search.board_name.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

search.bookmarkable_filters.name: Share/bookmark filter URLs
search.bookmarkable_filters.definition: Active filters live in page address, appear as removable chips and preserve words/media when cleared; this is URL persistence rather than a saved-query catalogue.
search.bookmarkable_filters.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

search.calendar_terms.name: Human-readable date filtering
search.calendar_terms.definition: Parses month names/abbreviations, day ordinals and years into capture-date constraints; when a month lacks a year, selects the current or most recent applicable year.
search.calendar_terms.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

search.catalogue_states.name: Find missing/edited/cloud/deleted assets
search.catalogue_states.definition: Query missing originals, referenced versus managed, iCloud-managed/synced, hidden, favorite, edited/external-edit, in/no album, deleted and missing descriptive metadata states.
search.catalogue_states.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

search.domain_scoping.name: Independent file and tag domains
search.domain_scoping.definition: Choose local/trash/known-file domain and specific tag service, including union of several file domains; current/pending tags can be searched separately.
search.domain_scoping.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

search.duplicate_results.name: GUI structured result filters
search.duplicate_results.definition: Filter path text plus size ranges, mtime and twin count; generate scripts for all results or only visible results.
search.duplicate_results.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

search.full_text.name: Full-text partial phrase search
search.full_text.definition: README explicitly supports full-text multi-phrase, partial-word retrieval; exact filename/path tokenization is not specified in the inspected feature section.
search.full_text.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

search.library_text.name: Basic library/album/media text search
search.library_text.definition: Text search over documented library entities; arbitrary metadata, Boolean, OCR or semantic search are not implied.

search.local_result_filters.name: Refine the open directory or search result
search.local_result_filters.definition: Feature manual describes a local filter panel that further narrows the current directory or search results, distinct from submitting the full structured query language.
search.local_result_filters.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

search.multilingual_semantic.name: Multilingual semantic queries
