storage.automatic_disaster_failover.definition: Reliability document describes manually tested secondary-storage/database recovery and lists fully automatic failover as future work; primary DB active/passive failover is already distinct.
storage.automatic_disaster_failover.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

storage.database_choices.name: Configurable catalogue database backend
storage.database_choices.definition: Document support for alternative database engines; maturity and migration constraints vary by engine and repository.

storage.distribution_groups.name: Group-based storage routing
storage.distribution_groups.definition: Distribution groups associate group name, storage-key ID, user type and compression flag; default group cannot be deleted.
storage.distribution_groups.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

storage.hosted_replication.name: Three-provider hosted replicas
storage.hosted_replication.definition: Hosted specification describes two hot encrypted copies in Amsterdam/Frankfurt and one cold copy in Paris across Backblaze/Wasabi/Scaleway; self-hosters must design their own redundancy.
storage.hosted_replication.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

storage.paid_cloud_capacity.name: Paid hosted capacity
storage.paid_cloud_capacity.definition: README describes Photos as a paid service with a 10 GB free allocation; additional hosted capacity requires a subscription, separate from self-hosting.
storage.paid_cloud_capacity.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

system.activity_trace_cleanup.name: Browser and system trace cleanup
system.activity_trace_cleanup.definition: Clears selected browsing history, searches, cookies, recent items and clipboard traces; this is an OS/application administration tool, not photo-metadata privacy or secure disk erasure.
system.activity_trace_cleanup.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

system.application_optimization.name: Shrink supported application installations
system.application_optimization.definition: Deep Cleanup overview documents application optimization to reduce supported application size without affecting normal use; exact eligible apps and transformations are not specified there. This is not photo compression.
system.application_optimization.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

system.application_uninstall.name: Uninstall applications and remnants
system.application_uninstall.definition: Uninstalls applications and reviews associated caches/settings/leftovers, treating potential personal files cautiously. AI manual warns vendor uninstallers control their own final scope.
system.application_uninstall.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

system.context_menu_extensions.name: Windows file-oriented menu actions
system.context_menu_extensions.definition: Add copy-path/name/image-dimensions, terminal-here, desktop shortcuts and system-tool shortcuts.
system.context_menu_extensions.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

system.context_menu_management.name: Windows Explorer menu management
system.context_menu_management.definition: Since 1.2.3, browse by app/menu location, disable/restore/remove entries, configure file types, switch supported Windows 11/classic styles and optionally restart Explorer.
system.context_menu_management.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

system.maintenance.name: Common system repair actions
system.maintenance.definition: Documented maintenance targets missing search results, incorrect icons, sound and network issues; available operations depend on platform.
system.maintenance.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

system.memory_management.name: Resource-heavy app and memory management
system.memory_management.definition: Find and quit resource-heavy applications and free memory manually or automatically; performance improvements are project claims.
system.memory_management.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

system.operation_history.name: Cleanup and change history
system.operation_history.definition: Records completed cleanup/system changes, reclaimed space and failures. Duplicate deletion appends history after execution; this is not an undo-capable transactional operation journal.
system.operation_history.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

system.resource_monitor.name: Live resource and hardware metrics
system.resource_monitor.definition: CPU/GPU/memory/network/disk trends; supported devices also expose temperature, power, battery and disk-health information, with menu/taskbar/tray/floating displays. These are whole-computer metrics, not photo-library analytics.
system.resource_monitor.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

system.startup_management.name: Disable and re-enable startup entries
system.startup_management.definition: Manage startup registrations to reduce login/background load, with ability to turn entries back on.
system.startup_management.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

system.validated_optimization.name: Built-in system settings optimization
system.validated_optimization.definition: Only built-in validated settings are accepted; no arbitrary commands/scripts/registry paths. Values are reread after changes and high-impact, elevated or restart-required actions are flagged.
system.validated_optimization.review_basis: Feature name and evidence-inventory semantics reviewed; description retains source-backed scope.

notes: Counts measure documented presence in the selected repositories, not independent product implementations, quality or recommendations.
Core, optional, plugin and paid capabilities count as documented support; roadmap, unclear and explicit unsupported findings do not.
A blank matrix cell means not established by this research, never a claim that the repository cannot do it.
Product-family counts are supplied alongside repository counts to expose legacy/fork-lineage duplication.
The final atomic pass separated explicit compound findings (widgets versus wallpaper; FTP versus SFTP; PDF/document versus creative-project previews; group roles versus account storage quotas).
A broader capability and a meaningful specialized variant may both appear, e.g. HLS streaming and encrypted HLS. Counts are therefore not additive measures of total product functionality.
Ordinary logs/history remain distinct from durable crash-recovery journaling; access locks/hiding remain distinct from encryption.

R01.summary: Self-hosted photo/video server with mobile backup, managed and external libraries, local ML search/people organization, sharing and extensive background maintenance.
deployment: Self-hosted Docker Compose server with PostgreSQL and separate ML service
Browser client
Android and iOS mobile clients
Node/npm or Docker upload CLI
R01.storage_model: Managed uploads retain unmodified originals under upload or optional template-organized library directories; database stores paths, user metadata and relationships. Thumbnails, encoded video, profiles and database backups occupy separate directories. External libraries index mounted folders without copying and may write XMP/delete originals only when mounts permit. Catalogue database and originals must both be backed up.
R01.privacy_model: Core storage and inference can stay on the operator's server, but models initially download, default map styles/tiles use external infrastructure, optional Cast loads Google scripts, and configured OIDC/SMTP/remote ML can involve other systems. Remote ML receives previews and lacks its own authentication controls. PIN-locked assets are session access controls, not established E2EE or at-rest encryption. v3.3.6 disables unintended upstream ONNX Runtime telemetry.
maturity_notes: Frozen main dae37df1a70c21493acdafd85bad8ab69e6b390d; latest manifest release v3.3.6 dated 2026-11-04. Pinned main documentation can be ahead of that release.
Support documentation says all features remain free; purchasing a user/server license supports development rather than unlocking a feature tier.
Experimental areas explicitly include external-library filesystem watching, hardware acceleration and Google Cast.
Important current docs qualify older claims: read-only external metadata edits fail, video face analysis is thumbnail-only, and auto album ordering is not implemented.

features.name: Self-hosted media server
features.detail: Server manages owned uploads and mounted media without requiring a third-party photo-storage account.

features.name: Docker Compose services
features.detail: Documented server/ML containers and volume mounts support split workers and optional remote ML.

features.name: Browser application
features.detail: Browser upload/view, administration, people, tags and sharing are explicitly in the client matrix.

features.name: Android client
features.detail: Android mobile app offers backup, viewing and platform-specific charging/delay controls.

features.name: iOS client
features.detail: iOS app supports selective/background backup subject to OS scheduling and Background App Refresh.

features.name: Managed uploads
features.detail: Web/mobile/CLI originals are copied into managed upload storage with separate derivatives.

features.name: Selective background mobile backup
features.detail: Choose included/excluded device albums, upload on app open/resume and background opportunities; Wi-Fi-only is default, configurable. Individual local-only assets can be uploaded manually.

features.name: One-way device album synchronization
features.detail: Creates/merges same-named server albums and backfills existing uploads. Later local deletes/reordering do not propagate; matching already-shared server albums share the newly added media.

features.name: iCloud-backed mobile asset retrieval
features.detail: Selected iOS albums can pull missing iCloud assets into temporary device cache for hashing/upload, then clear temporary files; requires extra data and device space.

features.name: Content-checksum upload deduplication
features.detail: Mobile/CLI hashes avoid re-uploading known content across upload methods/devices; server still hashes if CLI prehash is skipped. Upload-library scope is not global across accounts/external libraries.

features.name: External folders indexed in place
features.detail: External files appear in normal timeline/maps/albums after scanning without managed-copy import; modified source files require rescan.

features.name: Multiple external import paths
features.detail: One external library can recursively scan multiple mounted roots, adding a path only once when roots overlap.

features.name: Scheduled external rescans
features.detail: Nightly scans and manually triggered scans refresh libraries; admin can select presets or a cron schedule.

features.name: Experimental external-library watching
features.detail: Advanced-user watcher auto-imports changes but may fail on network drives and requires sufficient OS watcher capacity.

features.name: Case-insensitive glob exclusions
features.detail: Per-library full-path patterns exclude extensions/subtrees; matching existing assets are offlined on later scan. CLI also accepts ignore globs.

features.name: Folder navigation alongside timeline
features.detail: Enable folder view to navigate external directory trees or template-organized managed assets.

features.name: Optional storage templates
features.detail: Admin templates control directory/filename pattern using date/name/album and conditional fields; migration jobs apply changes retroactively. Date variables use server timezone.

features.name: Managed naming collisions avoided
features.detail: Default UUID names avoid filename collisions; template collisions append a sequence number rather than overwrite.

features.name: Download original or edited media
features.detail: Clients download photos/videos; edited assets default to edited output but original version can be selected.

features.name: Community Google Takeout importer
features.detail: Official CLI documentation recommends separate community-maintained immich-go for Google Photos Takeout rather than claiming native CLI Takeout parsing.

features.name: Scrubbable chronological browsing
features.detail: Mobile/web matrix documents draggable timeline scrollbars, with external and uploaded media appearing together.

features.name: Virtual scrolling
features.detail: README explicitly lists virtual scroll on both mobile and web; this is stronger evidence than ordinary lazy image loading.

features.name: Video viewing
features.detail: Both clients view uploaded videos and use separately generated compatibility transcodes; originals remain unchanged.

features.name: 360-degree image viewing
features.detail: README marks 360-degree display available on web, not mobile.

features.name: Years-ago memories
features.detail: Both clients show past-date memories; scheduled generation defaults to nightly tasks.

features.name: Stack related assets
features.detail: Both clients support stacked photos; duplicate review can stack multiple retained candidates.

features.name: Favorite assets
features.detail: Favorites are available on both clients, usable as filters and merged when resolving a duplicate group to one keeper.

features.name: Archive without deletion
features.detail: Archive hides media from main timeline/folder view but retains it in search and a dedicated archive view; not a privacy vault.

features.name: Camera and capture metadata
features.detail: View EXIF/GPS and filter camera make/model/lens; extracted metadata drives location/date behavior.

features.name: Read companion XMP
features.detail: Reads supported description/rating/date/GPS/tag fields; filename.ext.xmp wins over filename.xmp. Other sidecar fields remain stored but are not searchable.

features.name: Import IPTC keywords
features.detail: Tags can be imported from IPTC Keywords as well as XMP hierarchical tag fields; not a claim of full IPTC coverage.

features.name: Merged sidecar write-back
features.detail: Selected edited metadata is written to XMP without replacing unrelated fields; managed imports copy sidecars, and external write-back requires a writable mount. Discover/Sync jobs handle later sidecars.

features.name: Hierarchical tag management
features.detail: Enable Tags view, create/assign tags to photos/videos and navigate by tag; README limits Tags UI to web.

features.name: Star ratings
features.detail: Assign searchable star ratings and read/write XMP Rating; duplicate resolution preserves highest group rating.

features.name: Asset descriptions
features.detail: Descriptions are editable/searchable and written to dc:description/tiff:ImageDescription sidecar fields.

features.name: Edit capture timestamps
features.detail: Timestamp edits are supported and XMP DateTimeOriginal/DateCreated fields are written; read-only external mounts prevent editing.

features.name: Edit location metadata
features.detail: Location edits persist in database/XMP GPS latitude/longitude, not original file bytes; read-only external mounts cannot accept edits.

features.name: CLIP semantic search
features.detail: PostgreSQL/VectorChord searches image embeddings against freeform text without requiring explicit keywords; supported model choices trade accuracy, latency and memory.

features.name: Multilingual semantic models
features.detail: Choose supported multilingual models; nllb uses the user's language setting while xlm/siglip2 understand language independently. Changing models requires rerunning Smart Search.

features.name: Filename, extension and path search
features.detail: Full/partial filenames, extensions, folder names and original path fragments are searchable.

features.name: Combined metadata filters
features.detail: Filter descriptions, camera/lens, albums and archive/favorite/not-in-album state alongside other search criteria.

features.name: Time-frame filters
features.detail: Search with start/end time bucket dates.

features.name: Photo/video filters
features.detail: Restrict search to images, videos or both and filename extensions.

features.name: Place search
features.detail: Search city/state/country generated by local reverse geocoding.

features.name: Multi-person search
features.detail: Filter assets containing one or more recognized faces and browse a named person's media.

features.name: Tag search
features.detail: Filter assigned/imported tags and open tag-specific media views.

features.name: Star-rating search
features.detail: Advanced search explicitly includes user-assigned star ratings.

features.name: Recognized-text search
features.detail: Search text inside images; background pipeline explicitly includes an OCR job after thumbnail generation.

features.name: Background text recognition
features.detail: OCR is a first-class background processing task; optional supported acceleration also covers OCR model processing.

features.name: Detect face regions
features.detail: ML service processes generated previews into scored boxes and face embeddings; configurable detection score filters false positives.

features.name: Identity matching
features.detail: Recognition compares saved face embeddings and assigns identities; on videos this is only faces visible in the generated thumbnail, not full-video analysis.

features.name: Incremental person clustering
features.detail: DBSCAN-derived clustering uses recognition distance/core-point minimums, preserves prior people incrementally and revisits unassigned candidates nightly.

features.name: Name and curate people
features.detail: Name groups, change feature photo, hide people and favorite/pin them; set birthdate to show age when an image was taken.

features.name: Merge and assign face groups
features.detail: Merge detected people, manually assign unassigned faces and requeue missing/all recognition after tuning; existing results may need reprocessing.

features.name: Import existing face metadata
features.detail: FAQ says embedded asset face/person metadata creates faces and people on import; not limited to new ML discovery.

features.name: Self-hosted ML inference
features.detail: Default ML container processes previews on the self-hosted system and downloads missing models; inference is not synonymous with a guaranteed air-gapped first run.

features.name: Optional remote ML worker
features.detail: Send preview images to another ML container, optionally retaining local fallback. URLs are tried sequentially, not load-balanced; recognition clustering remains server/database-side.

features.name: Optional GPU/NPU ML
features.detail: Experimental ARM NN, CUDA, ROCm, OpenVINO and RKNN backends have model/device/driver limits; ARM NN does not accelerate query-time text search.

features.name: Visual duplicate suggestions
features.detail: Enabled-by-default ML utility groups visually similar assets for review; distinct from exact upload checksum deduplication.

features.name: Keeper choice and preselection
features.detail: Choose which candidates to retain/trash; suggested keeper preference uses larger byte size then richer EXIF count, not a measured aesthetic-quality score.

features.name: Retain multiple candidates
features.detail: More than one asset can be retained and optionally stacked; retained assets then keep their own metadata rather than merging it.

features.name: Preserve metadata when deduplicating
features.detail: Only exactly one keeper plus at least one trashed asset triggers merge: union albums/tags, any favorite, highest rating, combined descriptions, most restrictive visibility and GPS only when nonempty coordinates agree.

features.name: User-created albums
features.detail: Create albums and add uploaded/external assets; albums are independent of physical storage unless optional template behavior uses album names.

features.name: CLI directory-to-album import
features.detail: CLI --album creates albums from each uploaded file's containing folder or --album-name targets one album. External-library scans do not natively create matching albums.

features.name: Person collections
features.detail: Explore people and view all assets containing a selected person's face.

features.name: RAW media support
features.detail: Client matrix and supported-format table establish RAW/RW2 support; full decoder/extension list is maintained separately.

features.name: HEIC/HEIF support
features.detail: Both HEIC and HEIF are explicitly supported image formats.

features.name: AVIF support
features.detail: AVIF is explicitly supported.

features.name: JPEG XL support
features.detail: JPEG XL .jxl is explicitly supported.

features.name: SVG media support
features.detail: Supported-format table includes SVG.

features.name: Live Photo backup/playback
features.detail: README explicitly lists Apple Live Photo backup and playback on mobile and web.

features.name: Motion Photo backup/playback
features.detail: Motion Photo backup/playback appears in both client columns.

features.name: Non-destructive crop
features.detail: Crop creates an edited version and can be reverted to the original.

features.name: Rotation and mirroring
features.detail: Photo edit controls include rotation and mirroring.

features.name: Original-preserving edits
features.detail: Image edits create another version; metadata writes use sidecars/database. Original bytes are retained, though emptying trash can delete originals.

features.name: Compatibility video derivatives
features.detail: Transcode policy generates web-compatible derivatives without replacing originals; changing policy and rerunning jobs can delete unnecessary transcodes.

features.name: Experimental hardware transcoding
features.detail: NVENC/QSV/RKMPP/VAAPI can accelerate encoding, with optional decoding. Hardware, codec, Linux/WSL and quality/size tradeoffs apply; Raspberry Pi is unsupported in this guide.

features.name: Global media map
features.detail: Both clients display geotagged assets on a global map; map tile/style services are distinct from local reverse geocoding.

features.name: Server-local reverse lookup
features.detail: GeoNames data is loaded into PostgreSQL on minor upgrades; city/state/country queries then run locally.

features.name: Configurable map tile/style provider
features.detail: Set separate light/dark style JSON URLs and choose another tile provider rather than the default tiles.immich.cloud styles. Offline basemap provisioning is not established.

features.name: Separate user accounts
features.detail: Multiple users own assets and libraries, with admin-managed passwords and per-user settings; accounts are not counted as selectable multiple catalogues.

features.name: Album editor/viewer permissions
features.detail: Assign shared users read-write editor or read-only viewer permissions on albums.

features.name: Shared album contributions
features.detail: Instance users can contribute their own photos/videos to shared albums when given editor permission.

features.name: Public asset/album links
features.detail: Random-secret URLs share selected photos/videos or albums with non-users and configurable permitted actions.

features.name: Password-protected shares
features.detail: Public links can require a password.

features.name: Expiring shares
features.detail: Public-link configuration includes an expiration date.

features.name: Upload through a shared link
features.detail: Permit non-account visitors to contribute photos/videos into the owner's account using a configured public share.

features.name: One-way partner library sharing
features.detail: Grant broad asset/metadata/download/resharing access with optional per-partner timeline inclusion. Person data and favorites are not shared; both parties must grant separately for reciprocity.

features.name: Account storage quotas
features.detail: Admins set GiB quotas that block further upload when exceeded; external libraries do not count against the quota.

features.name: PIN-locked assets
features.detail: Locked Folder hides assets until session unlock; access initially lasts 15 minutes and can extend with activity. While unlocked, locked assets may appear in search/utilities; Lock/sign-out revokes access.

features.name: Mobile offline capability
features.detail: README marks offline support on mobile, not web. Inspected docs do not specify guarantees that all remote originals/search/models are available offline.

features.name: Read-only external mounts
features.detail: Docker :ro protects external original files; metadata edits also cannot persist, and files trashed in UI can return after trash-empty/rescan because disk deletion is denied.

features.name: Application trash
features.detail: Trash delays permanent deletion. Missing external files move to trash on rescan and restoration requires restoring the source; their metadata is discarded after documented 30-day removal.

features.name: Free Up Space on device
features.detail: Review/delete only device assets already backed up and not in server trash, with cutoff date, keep favorites/albums and keep photo/video options; iCloud Shared Album items are excluded.

features.name: Native trash for mobile cleanup
features.detail: Free Up Space confirms a reviewed list then moves assets to native trash in batches (Android 2000/iOS 10000); manually empty OS trash to reclaim space immediately.

features.name: Mobile read-only/kid mode
features.detail: Read-only app mode permits timeline viewing while preventing accidental device photo deletion; not an encrypted vault.

features.name: Scheduled database backups and restore
features.detail: Default daily 2am dumps retain 14 copies; manual backups and UI restore are supported. Restore creates a rollback point, migrates/checks health and rolls back on failure. Media is not in database dumps.

features.name: Persistent checksum integrity checking
features.detail: Scheduled checks compare stored/actual checksums and detect missing/untracked paths; checks default nightly at 3am with configurable time/progress budgets and refresh-only-reported options.

features.name: Startup storage health checks
features.detail: Read/write marker checks validate expected storage mounts and permissions; failed checks normally prevent server startup.

features.name: Dependent background processing
features.detail: Job pipeline covers metadata, template migration, thumbnails, smart search, faces, OCR, video and duplicates, plus separately configurable nightly jobs; admin views job state.

features.name: Separate API and processing workers
features.detail: Include/exclude worker settings let containers isolate web/API work from background processing and distribute resources.

features.name: Multiple generated preview levels
features.detail: Maintains blurred thumbhash, WebP previews, JPEG thumbnails and person face thumbnails in derivative storage.

features.name: Regenerate or remove derivatives
features.detail: Queue missing/all thumbnail/transcode jobs separately from originals; policy changes can remove unnecessary encoded video without deleting original media.

features.name: SMTP account/album notifications
features.detail: Notify new users, users added to shared albums and collaborators about new assets; per-user controls and custom HTML templates are documented.

features.name: Account usage and quota statistics
features.detail: Account settings show usage and admins can see per-user quota percentages in Server Stats.

features.name: OpenAPI and scoped API keys
features.detail: Documented OpenAPI with generated TypeScript/Dart clients; web users create API keys with restricted permissions and can manage logged-in devices.

features.name: Recursive upload CLI
features.detail: CLI supports recursive paths, globs, albums, visibility, dry run, JSON output, upload concurrency, filesystem watching and explicit local-delete/delete-duplicate options.

features.name: OIDC single sign-on
features.detail: Configure third-party provider, mobile/web redirects, auto-registration/launch and backchannel logout. Role/quota claims can synchronize on login; default storage label is registration-only unless changed.

features.name: Opt-in web Google Cast
features.detail: Experimental photo/video Cast requires Google scripts, public HTTPS/reachable Google DNS and Cast-compatible video formats.

features.name: Mobile Cast
features.detail: Cast manual explicitly reserves Android/iOS support for future development.

features.name: Full-video facial scanning
features.detail: FAQ limits current video face recognition to a generated thumbnail and mentions possible future whole-video scanning.

features.name: NSFW filtering
features.detail: FAQ explicitly says NSFW image filtering is unavailable; an open request is not an implemented feature.

features.name: Custom album photo ordering
features.detail: FAQ says manual reordering is not yet available and links a planned-feature discussion.

limitations.text: Back up originals and database independently. Automatic database backups contain metadata only, not pictures/videos; managed originals must not be modified/moved manually.

Each external library has one immutable owner. Moving an external file is treated as a new asset on rescan and can lose Immich-only metadata/album membership. Read-only mounts block metadata writes, potentially silently.

Exact import deduplication is not global across users/external libraries. Visual duplicate suggestions are different from byte equality or full-video similarity. Face analysis of video is thumbnail-only.

Free Up Space also deletes from iCloud and other Apple devices when iCloud sync is enabled, and can remove media needed by WhatsApp chat history; keep relevant albums and maintain independent server backups.
iOS controls background timing; Android battery policies may suppress workers. Some custom network authentication/certificate features are experimental and can break media transfers/playback.

Remote ML exposes previews to its operator and has no built-in access security. Multiple configured ML URLs are sequential fallback, not load balancing. Models/maps/Cast can require external network access; v3.3.6 specifically disables unintended upstream telemetry.

Smart Search uses embeddings, not generated editable object tags/captions. Arbitrary custom CLIP models are unsupported; only listed compatible models work. Animal identity recognition and backup-time original-image compression are explicitly unavailable.
Hardware acceleration is experimental and platform/model dependent; transcodes can be larger/lower quality at comparable settings. HDR player color issues are acknowledged.

Inspected evidence does not establish E2EE, encrypted originals, guaranteed offline basemaps or durable per-file-operation/crash-recovery journaling. Locked Folder, trash and catalogue rollback are distinct features.

Library guide says read-only mounts disallow UI deletion, while FAQ describes UI trash followed by reappearance. Both agree that filesystem originals cannot be deleted; exact UI behavior may vary by version.

gaps: Model benchmark tables were sampled only after reading complete selection/methodology prose; no benchmark claims are presented as our measurements.
Mobile offline cache scope, encryption and operation journaling are not established.
Current pinned documentation may precede release availability and contains one qualified read-only-trash UI inconsistency.

R02.summary: Self-hosted photo/video catalogue with in-place indexing or managed import, local recognition, rich metadata/search, linked-media stacks and controlled sharing; paid memberships add specific roles, administration and formats/maps.
deployment: Docker browser application on Windows/macOS/Linux hosts; AMD64 and ARM64 including Raspberry Pi/Apple Silicon
Installable browser PWA rather than native Windows/macOS mobile clients
Linux tar packages/manual source builds for experienced administrators; optional managed hosting
R02.storage_model: Originals folder preserves existing hierarchy when indexed; optional import copies/moves into canonical date-organized names. Storage folder holds derivatives, JSON/YAML sidecars, configuration, backups and SQLite where used; MariaDB is supported and October 2026 release adds experimental PostgreSQL. Multiple host roots can be mounted below one originals root. Accounts normally share that library, not separate catalogues.
R02.privacy_model: Built-in ONNX labels/faces execute locally; optional Ollama may be self-hosted and OpenAI/Ollama Cloud require network/API keys. Maps and reverse geocoding contact PhotoPrism/MapTiler services. Read-only mode plus read-only mounts protect originals, while normal mode allows specific changes. Private media/people and role restrictions are access controls, not encryption; no E2EE or guaranteed air-gap claim.
maturity_notes: Manifest release 261029-963b58c50 (2026-10-29); README pinned to develop 28c02df9312d81e8b8bf349727ab4131740bf2ec.

Feature manuals are official live docs inspected 2026-11-09 and may describe later develop behavior. Historical TensorFlow/FaceNet defaults differ from current ONNX YuNet/SFace models; old libraries retain FaceNet until migrated.
Community source is AGPL; standard images bundle paid extensions under Plus terms, while ce image is AGPL. Paid features below are separated from core.
PostgreSQL is explicitly experimental. Official MySQL 8 support is discontinued; SQLite is documented as less suitable for high-concurrency/large libraries.

features.name: Browser-based photo and video interface
features.detail: PhotoPrism provides its library browsing, metadata editing, organization and sharing interface through a web browser. PWA installation is optional and is not a native Windows/macOS or mobile application distribution.

features.name: Native Linux server packages
features.detail: Official tar packages can run the PhotoPrism server directly on compatible Linux distributions without Docker. They require manual configuration, updates and installation of system dependencies; this is a native server distribution with a browser interface, not a Linux desktop GUI package.

features.name: Paid managed hosting option
features.detail: Official documentation offers fully managed hosting through selected partners, and the personal-edition comparison lists PikaPods as a paid managed deployment. Provider plans and feature availability differ from a self-hosted installation.

features.name: Translated interface and language selection
features.detail: The October 2026 release explicitly discusses missing user-interface translations, fixes the sign-in language picker and invites native-speaker translation improvements. Account roles can retain a personal language preference; this is UI localization, not multilingual image search.

features.name: Interactive 3D Earth view
features.detail: Places can switch to a globe that rotates, zooms and tilts; the guide says it works with all map styles and can combine with terrain mode. Paid satellite/terrain map services remain a separate capability.

features.name: Optional OpenID Connect sign-in
features.detail: The edition comparison lists OpenID Connect SSO for self-hosted Community, Essentials and Plus. WebDAV documentation explains that OIDC-authenticated accounts use app passwords instead of their account password for WebDAV; provider-specific configuration was not inspected.

features.name: Self-hosted browser photo library
features.detail: Runs server under owner control with web UI; Docker supports AMD64/ARM64 on multiple host OSes, not native desktop installers.

features.name: Multi-architecture Docker images
features.detail: Stable and preview images include converters/dependencies; CE and standard extension-bundled images have distinct licensing terms.

features.name: Installable responsive PWA
features.detail: Browser app can be installed on phone/tablet/desktop home screen; this does not establish a native mobile background-backup service.

features.name: SQLite/MariaDB and experimental PostgreSQL
features.detail: SQLite and MariaDB supported; October release adds explicitly experimental PostgreSQL and database-transfer CLI. MySQL 8 support is discontinued.

features.name: Index originals in place
features.detail: Indexing leaves existing file/folder names unchanged, reads metadata and writes derived data outside originals by default.

features.name: Multiple mounted source folders
features.detail: Host folders/drives can be mounted as subfolders below one originals tree; this is one catalogue over multiple mounts, not isolated per-user libraries.

features.name: Preserved folder hierarchy
features.detail: Folders and hierarchical Originals views reflect source organization; next index updates paths after media is moved within originals.

features.name: Managed copy or move import
features.detail: Copies by default or moves from import to originals; unsupported files remain in import. Web uploads follow import semantics rather than direct originals upload.

features.name: Canonical import names/date folders
features.detail: Imports assign unique filenames and year/month directories while preserving original name as indexed property; advanced destination patterns can be configured but do not rename existing imports.

features.name: Incremental and full rescan
features.detail: Index all or selected subfolder; Complete Rescan includes unchanged files and preserves manually entered labels/people/titles/captions.

features.name: Schedules and delayed WebDAV indexing
features.detail: Optional scheduled rescans and default five-minute safety delay after WebDAV changes; concurrent scans and slow transfers can produce load or incomplete sets.

features.name: Scoped ignore rules
features.detail: Automatic hidden-prefix exclusions plus directory-scoped .ppignore wildcard rules; rules do not retroactively remove already indexed items/stacks.

features.name: Google Photos metadata migration
features.detail: Reads Google Photos JSON sidecars and Apple XMP during indexing; this establishes metadata ingestion, not authenticated cloud sync or complete Takeout repair.

features.name: Companion mobile backup
features.detail: Compatible apps such as PhotoSync can back up iOS/Android media in background via WebDAV; companion licensing/OS behavior is external to PhotoPrism.

features.name: Skip duplicate imports
features.detail: Duplicates are skipped; Move import also deletes duplicate sources as though successfully moved, so it is a destructive source-cleanup choice.

features.name: SHA-1 and size duplicate detection
features.detail: Index detects/skips matching SHA-1+size files so they appear once in results/albums; no byte-confirmation claim is documented.

features.name: Dedicated duplicate browse/delete UI
features.detail: Manual explicitly says browsing and deleting duplicates in web UI is future work; automatic suppression is already present.

features.name: Linked RAW/JPEG stacks
features.detail: Same-folder basename companions always stack, including RAW/JPEG and hybrid image/video; this mandatory rule cannot be disabled.

features.name: Associated metadata companions
features.detail: XMP/JSON and other same-origin sidecars remain associated with media stack; permanent deletion removes related sidecars as well.

features.name: Configurable related-image grouping
features.detail: Optional sequential-name, same-second/position and Unique Image/XMP Instance ID grouping; choose primary preview or unstack nonprimary image. Changing rules does not auto-unstack old groups.

features.name: Cards, mosaic and list browsing
features.detail: Cards show title/time/location, mosaic emphasizes imagery, list shows metadata; selectable light/dark themes.

features.name: Calendar by capture time
features.detail: Calendar organizes media by time taken, complemented by regions, people, labels, folders and favorites navigation.

features.name: Fullscreen viewer and information sidebar
features.detail: Fullscreen viewing supports caption/sidebar toggles, editing and direct export/download.

features.name: Photo/video slideshow
features.detail: Viewer starts/pauses slideshows; Live Photos play when viewed in slideshow or hovered.

features.name: Viewer/library shortcuts
features.detail: Shortcuts include fullscreen, slideshow, info/caption/mute/favorite, edit, archive/restore and download/export.

features.name: Light/dark themes
features.detail: Result-view manual explicitly offers multiple light/dark themes; paid premium theme availability is not conflated with baseline theme switching.

features.name: Combined structured filters
features.detail: Space combines filters with AND; supported fields permit & or |, label groups permit leading !, and names/captions accept escaped operators/wildcards. Not universal arbitrary boolean syntax.

features.name: Current/original filename and path queries
features.detail: Separate name, filename, original and path filters support wildcards. Searches operate on files, so narrowly matching extensions can exclude a stack's companion video.

features.name: Camera/exposure/codec metadata filters
features.detail: Filter camera, lens, aperture, focal length, ISO, codec, captions/titles, hashes and source IDs, along with flags for private/archive/review/errors.

features.name: Capture and catalogue timestamps
features.detail: Year/month/day and taken/before/after plus added/edited/updated timestamps can be combined.

features.name: Media-type and stack filters
features.detail: Filter image/RAW/live/video/animated/audio/vector/document and stacked/unstacked/primary/unsorted states; filter presence alone does not establish each format's full playback semantics.

features.name: Megapixel and orientation filters
features.detail: Resolution ranges plus portrait/landscape/square/panorama conditions are documented.

features.name: Color and chroma queries
features.detail: Search standard dominant colors, chroma and monochrome flag; file-level results distinguish color/monochrome variants in stacks.

features.name: Geographic filters
features.detail: Country/state/city/category, coordinates with distance, bounding boxes, altitude, Open Location Code, S2 cell and nearby-photo UID filters.

features.name: Person and face-count search
features.detail: Exact person or partial people names with conjunction/disjunction, face IDs/new faces and minimum face counts; can combine with date/place filters.

features.name: Keywords and category-aware labels
features.detail: Search manual/generated labels, category expansion and keywords with supported boolean combinations.

features.name: Merged EXIF metadata
features.detail: Built-in EXIF parser plus optional ExifTool normalizes and merges camera/time/location data; changed files are reread when mtime changes.

features.name: IPTC extraction via ExifTool
features.detail: ExifTool extracts IPTC together with embedded EXIF/XMP into JSON sidecars; disabling it reduces metadata support.

features.name: XMP sidecar priority
features.detail: Standalone XMP fields take precedence, including documented GPS/altitude/subject multiword keywords; embedded XMP requires ExifTool. Support is selective, not all XMP schemas.

features.name: Import external face names/regions
features.detail: Enable Import Faces from XMP to reuse names/regions from Bridge, Lightroom, digiKam, ACDSee or Windows rather than reentering them.

features.name: Portable YAML metadata backup
features.detail: Indexer/editor creates human-readable YAML sidecars unless disabled and ExifTool JSON extracts; manual YAML edits are not synchronized back to overwrite existing index.

features.name: Editable labels and suppression
features.detail: Add/rename/remove labels; renaming affects all assigned pictures. Removing generated label sets confidence zero for reactivation; globally deleting prevents reapplication until deliberately restored.

features.name: Built-in broader label categories
features.detail: Generated labels belong to searchable broader groups such as vehicle; category grouping is not user-editable hierarchy.

features.name: Catalogue descriptive metadata
features.detail: Edit title, caption, copyright, camera/lens and private notes; title/caption/keywords searchable, Notes ignored. Manual changes survive rescans.

features.name: Edit catalogue date/time
features.detail: Details editor changes dates while preserving user overrides through indexing; release fixes timezone adjustment behavior. General embedded timestamp writing is not provided.

features.name: Edit catalogue coordinates visually
features.detail: Paste decimal coordinate pair or use built-in map/place search in Details. This is catalogue geotagging, not a claim that GPS is written into original EXIF.

features.name: Batch metadata/labels/albums
features.detail: When enabled, edits up to 999 selected pictures or a subset. Mixed values indicate replacement scope; partially assigned chips can add to all or remove from all.

features.name: Media, person and label favorites
features.detail: Like media for Favorites view and quality review; starring people/labels sorts them first.

features.name: General metadata writeback
features.detail: Except image orientation, PhotoPrism explicitly does not write changed metadata back into originals to avoid conflicts/data loss.

features.name: JPG/PNG orientation edit
features.detail: Choose correct orientation in Files tab; writes original metadata and is unavailable in read-only mode.

features.name: Automatic face regions
features.detail: Current built-in YuNet detects faces; only primary stack image is scanned, and small/rotated/low-contrast faces may be missed.

features.name: Identity matching by embeddings
features.detail: Current SFace embeddings compare faces; legacy libraries keep FaceNet until migration. Recognition starts after full library scan and can be CPU-intensive.

features.name: Background face grouping
features.detail: Groups similar faces, updates clusters after new data/corrections and can auto-name a consistent cluster when enough recognized members agree; New Faces shows clusters, not every unknown face.

features.name: Manual identity labels and covers
features.detail: Name in People, photo editor or info sidebar, rename person globally and select a representative face cover.

features.name: Reject/reassign/remove detections
features.detail: Bad matches remove or replace identity and update cluster thresholds in background; false positives can be removed with undo only before reload.

features.name: Mark missed faces manually
features.detail: Info Sidebar permits manual region marking missed by detection; 360-degree content explicitly does not support manual marking yet.

features.name: Hide identities without hiding pictures
features.detail: Private/hidden people withhold names/regions from viewers/guests/visitors and remove names from generated titles after maintenance; pictures remain visible, so this is not redaction/encryption.

features.name: Local automatic content labels
features.detail: Default ONNX classification generates labels/categories; model can be replaced or set to none without removing existing labels.

features.name: Built-in offline inference
features.detail: ONNX label/NSFW/face models run locally without model-service setup; maps and optional hosted AI are separate network dependencies.

features.name: Optional generative captions
features.detail: Configure Ollama or OpenAI for natural-language captions and labels; self-hosted Ollama recommends GPU, OpenAI needs API key/network. Not an established native semantic-search engine.

features.name: Explicit hosted model integration
features.detail: OpenAI/Ollama Cloud send images to configured service endpoints with API keys; configurable prompts/models/thresholds and service credentials, no requests to these hosts without key.

features.name: Per-model execution policy
features.detail: vision.yml supports auto/manual/on-index/newly-indexed/on-demand/on-schedule/always/never modes; on-index limited to built-in local models to avoid blocking ingestion.

features.name: NVIDIA acceleration
features.detail: Built-in ONNX models can use NVIDIA GPU; Ollama model/GPU/thread options are configurable. Documented timings are project claims, not benchmarks performed here.

features.name: Optional private-content classification
features.detail: NSFW detector can mark potentially objectionable images private; docs call it only partly reliable and older indexed images need rescan.

features.name: Heuristic review queue
features.detail: Review score uses known date/GPS, resolution, non-screenshot classification and favorite/edit/approval; low scores are withheld until approved unless disabled. Not blur/aesthetic scoring; manual says 1–5 while filter reference permits 1–7.

features.name: Curated virtual albums
features.detail: Create/edit albums, add selection to multiple albums, remove membership and choose cover; album deletion differs from file deletion.

features.name: Automatically refreshed Moments
features.detail: Moments are continuously updated time/place or content-label collections such as country/year or pets; no arbitrary user-defined smart-query builder is claimed.

features.name: Region/location collections
features.detail: Regions group images by location; time/place Moments supplement map navigation.

features.name: People collections and downloads
features.detail: View/download all a person's photos and add that selection to manual albums.

features.name: Standard world photo map
features.detail: All users receive hosted high-resolution OSM-based vector map; Places plots GPS media, supports search and requires WebGL 2.

features.name: Interactive location clusters
features.detail: Click grouped map markers for overlay and open associated photos in search; map can be restricted with most normal search filters.

features.name: External reverse geocoding
features.detail: PhotoPrism location service resolves coordinates to places; disabling Places retains indexed GPS but disables lookups/map UI. Community geocoding is rate-limited.

features.name: Satellite/terrain and enhanced location service
features.detail: Essentials/Plus provide additional MapTiler satellite/outdoor/3D styles and enhanced geocoding; standard hosted vector map remains free. Globe viewer works across styles.

features.name: RAW conversion with multiple engines
features.detail: Docker includes Darktable/RawTherapee; generated JPEG/PNG previews serve browser/ML use, outside originals by default. Camera support depends on converters.

features.name: HEIC/HEIF ingestion
features.detail: Supported with converted browser previews; heif-convert may not honor JPEG resolution limit.

features.name: AVIF image support
features.detail: Format table includes AVIF/sequences; preview conversion is distinct from browser-native display and converter resolution constraints.

features.name: JPEG XL conversion/previews
features.detail: JPEG XL generates JPEG/PNG preview sidecars for thumbnail/recognition where browsers cannot render original.

features.name: Vector graphics support
features.detail: Plus edition includes vector graphics support, with SVG/AI/EPS/PS listed in format reference; not attributed to free core merely because format table lists them.

features.name: Animated GIF playback
features.detail: GIF animation plays natively; ExifTool should remain enabled to extract duration/resolution.

features.name: Apple Live Photos
features.detail: Still/video companions stack and play on hover/slideshow; live search filters and dedicated navigation.

features.name: Motion Photo search/type support
features.detail: Live filter explicitly includes Motion and Live Photos; detailed phone-specific extraction matrix not established.

features.name: Browser-aware video playback
features.detail: FFmpeg is required for video indexing stills; ExifTool supplies duration/resolution/codec. Supported browser codecs stream directly under documented bitrate rules.

features.name: On-demand or precomputed AVC derivatives
features.detail: Converts unsupported codecs to MPEG-4 AVC on first play or convert CLI; first-play latency/storage can be large. Existing AVC is not re-encoded even above bitrate limit.

features.name: Optional hardware video transcoding
features.detail: Video guide explicitly supports configured hardware transcoding; exact device/driver matrix was not inspected.

features.name: Interactive 360 photos/videos
features.detail: Equirectangular content opens sphere viewer with pan/zoom/playback. Metadata identifies still projections; panorama flag plus roughly 2:1 frame identifies video; other projections stay flat.

features.name: Background Insta360 dewarping
features.detail: INSV/INSP/fisheye DNG become equirectangular derivatives using known camera FOV or configured fallback; dual-lens video/proxy files stack and originals stay unchanged.

features.name: Originals and configured stack downloads
features.detail: Download selected photos, individual Files-tab items or whole albums/moments/person collections; configure which stack files are included.

features.name: Resolution/format export dialog
features.detail: Admins/Users export originals, full-size previews, resized JPEGs or playable video renditions with per-download retry; Viewers/Guests/Visitors may download but not use Export.

features.name: Read-only secret album links
features.detail: Share manual albums, Moments, Months, Regions or Folders; visitors view/download only nonprivate media and cannot edit. Reusing secret can share multiple albums.

features.name: Multiple revocable expiring links
features.detail: Each collection can have different secret/expiry links; links can be deleted independently.

features.name: Password protection for album links
features.detail: Share manual explicitly describes optional password protection as planned, distinct from existing secret URLs and authenticated guest accounts.

features.name: Multiple accounts on shared library
features.detail: All editions have account CLI; Community includes Admin, Guest and Visitor, with full library or shared-only scope. Accounts are not separate selectable libraries.

features.name: Community administrator/guest roles
features.detail: Admins have unrestricted library/settings access; guests read shared content; anonymous visitors only shared resources. Superadmin flag prevents accidental role lockout and controls global flags.

features.name: User and Viewer roles
features.detail: Essentials/Plus add editable-library User without global settings and read-only Viewer excluding private/archive and uploads/indexing.

features.name: Web account/session administration
features.detail: Plus adds UI for accounts/sessions; account deletion disables/signs out but retains account record and uploaded pictures. CLI remains in all editions.

features.name: Authenticator 2FA and recovery
features.detail: Account 2FA uses compatible authenticator, one-time recovery code disabling 2FA, and administrator reset path.

features.name: Scoped device credentials
features.detail: App passwords support WebDAV-only scope; even Full Access app credentials cannot change account password or manage users.

features.name: Built-in WebDAV and external sync
features.detail: Mount originals/import to open/edit/delete remotely and sync external WebDAV servers; auth required, disabled in public mode, HTTPS required outside trusted local network.

features.name: Permission-aware MCP library tools
features.detail: October release adds search/browse and metadata/format/command lookups, enabled for eligible roles with per-account/global disable options; external assistants can access authorized library information.

features.name: OAuth app authorization
features.detail: Release adds authorization-code app/remote-MCP connections; PHOTOPRISM_OAUTH_APPS=none can block external app authorization.

features.name: Administration/maintenance CLI
features.detail: CLI provides index/import/convert/cleanup/thumb regeneration, backup, account management and database transfer; reset is destructive to index and requires backup.

features.name: Explicit read-only source mode
features.detail: Disables original-writing features including import/upload/delete/WebDAV; optional Docker :ro mounts enforce OS-level protection. Derivative conversion remains possible outside originals.

features.name: Archive/restore before permanent deletion
features.detail: Archive hides without deleting, and restore returns media; album membership is removed on archive and not automatically restored. This is reversible catalogue archive, not OS trash or retained deleted bytes.

features.name: Archive-first permanent delete
features.detail: Delete must be enabled; archived files can be selected or all removed with confirmation. Originals and sidecars are removed permanently, cached derivatives on later cleanup.

features.name: Scheduled SQL and metadata backups
features.detail: Default daily database dumps retain up to three; album/YAML backup switches and manual commands available. Full recovery also needs originals and preferably storage/config, copied separately.

features.name: Optional low-disk operation guard
features.detail: Can pause index/import/upload below configured free-space percentage with 100 MB floor; disabled by default because network/FUSE/container probes may be unreliable.

features.name: Persistent multisize libvips previews
features.detail: JPEG thumbnail matrix is hash-addressed outside originals, with Lanczos3 rendering and up to 16K previews; static minimum 720 px supports ML.

features.name: Trade precomputed storage for on-demand CPU
features.detail: Independent static/dynamic size limits and Dynamic Previews reduce disk use at cost of latency/CPU; smaller/lower-quality analysis thumbnails can impair recognition.

features.name: Background metadata/face/conversion work
features.detail: Face clusters update after indexing/corrections, optional AI has scheduled metadata-worker modes, and fisheye originals convert asynchronously.

features.name: Bound still-image conversion time
features.detail: Still/document/RAW conversion defaults to ten-minute timeout; -1 disables it. Video uses a separate timeout disabled by default.

features.name: Remove orphan index/cache entries
features.detail: Cleanup deletes unused thumbnails/orphan index entries when requested with indexing/CLI, not on schedule, and skips empty originals; thumbnail regeneration and full index reset are distinct operations.

features.name: Library debug logs
features.detail: Debug mode exposes logs under Library > Logs after restart; advanced configuration changes require restart.

features.name: Automatic tagged-person YAML backup
features.detail: People manual lists automatic YAML backup of tagged people as upcoming; general metadata sidecars must not be assumed to fully back up face identities.

limitations.text: Self-hosting is not fully offline: maps/reverse geocoding retrieve data from PhotoPrism/MapTiler; optional hosted AI transmits image inputs to configured services.
Paid User/Viewer roles, account/session UI, vector support and enhanced maps are not free core. Accounts share one catalogue rather than providing independent per-user libraries.
Move import deletes duplicate source files; archiving loses album memberships, permanent delete removes originals/sidecars, and rotation or basename-unstacking can modify original metadata/names.
Password-protected share links and dedicated duplicate cleanup UI remain planned. General original metadata writeback is unsupported except orientation.

Face matching is weaker for young children/age gaps and often misses nonupright faces; primary stack file only is analyzed. Private people hides names/regions, not pictures, and manual face marking is unsupported on 360 content.

FFmpeg is needed for video indexing and ExifTool for full metadata. AVC originals are not recompressed to meet bitrate limits; transcoded derivatives may exceed original storage. RAW/XMP changes do not regenerate existing JPEGs automatically.
Ignore rules do not retroactively remove entries, unsupported filename characters are skipped, and stack-setting changes do not automatically unstack existing items.
SQLite high-concurrency/large-library limitations and CPU/storage tradeoffs are documented claims, not measured here; low-disk runtime protection is disabled by default.
Review guide says score 1–5 while filter reference permits 1–7; newer metadata page lists XMP features beyond older FAQ's abbreviated list. Precise version/model behavior may vary across live docs.

Natural-language semantic search, OCR search, perceptual duplicate review, E2EE, offline basemap/geocoding, durable file-operation journal and separate per-user libraries were not established by inspected evidence.

gaps: Live docs may lead frozen release; no operational/benchmark verification performed.
Only explicit text/labelled edition differences used; icon-only comparison cells not interpreted.
External mobile apps, hardware encoder matrix and enterprise Pro feature set not individually audited.
Generic diff perceptual-hash filter does not establish user-facing similar-image search or duplicate cleanup.

R03.summary: Local file-cleanup toolkit with exact and perceptual duplicate scanning, media validation and corrective tools; Krokiet is the current desktop frontend and Czkawka GTK is legacy.
deployment: Portable Windows, macOS and Linux desktop binaries
Command-line frontend
Reusable Rust core library
Cedinia Android frontend with different tool availability
R03.storage_model: Scans user-selected filesystem paths in place. Shared on-disk caches store content/perceptual hashes, media checks and thumbnails; JSON configuration holds presets. Deletion, links, moves, EXIF cleaning and video optimization act on real files rather than a managed photo catalogue.
R03.privacy_model: README explicitly states no Internet access or user-statistics collection. Processing is local; external ffmpeg/ffprobe installations are needed for several video operations. This is not an encryption claim.
maturity_notes: Frozen commit c8a690aa1f692a48b52f6ad1e3c7f7227dac53a5; latest frozen release 12.0.2 (2026-09-09).
GTK 12.0 is the last GTK release; new development and binaries target Krokiet. Current-commit manuals include newer capabilities and must not all be assumed available in 12.0.2.
Cedinia has frontend-specific restrictions; README comparison and prose disagree about some Android audio/video availability, so desktop capabilities are not attributed wholesale to Android.

features.name: Windows desktop binaries
features.detail: Krokiet has prebuilt portable Windows 10/11 desktop binaries; release notes distinguish current Krokiet from legacy GTK packages.

features.name: macOS desktop binaries
features.detail: Release distribution includes Krokiet macOS x86_64 and ARM64 desktop builds; this is a native frontend, not a browser served from a container.

features.name: Linux desktop binaries
features.detail: Krokiet supplies prebuilt Linux desktop executables; the manual documents glibc 2.17+ and optional ffmpeg requirements for relevant video tools.

features.name: Translated desktop interface
features.detail: README explicitly documents multiple interface languages including Polish, English and Italian. Krokiet's Language setting changes the UI immediately without restart; this is interface translation, not multilingual content search.

features.name: Scan multiple filesystem roots
features.detail: Included paths accepts multiple directories with recursive traversal and optional other-filesystem exclusion; scans operate on existing files without import.

features.name: Whole-file duplicate hashing
features.detail: Groups by size, then first/last 4 KB prehash, then full-file hash. Blake3 is default; CRC32 and XXH3 are alternatives with different collision characteristics.

features.name: Name and size candidate matching
features.detail: Name, size and combined name+size modes avoid content reads; case sensitivity is configurable and docs explicitly warn these methods produce false positives.

features.name: Bytewise verification
features.detail: Krokiet manual explicitly says hash duplicate matching does not perform byte-by-byte comparison.

features.name: Configurable perceptual image grouping
features.detail: BK-tree/Hamming-distance matching with six hash algorithms, 8/16/32/64 hash sizes, resize filters and distance threshold; optionally ignores same-size or same-resolution groups. EXIF orientation is applied before hashing.

features.name: Rotated and mirrored duplicate matching
features.detail: Optional comparison setting adds mirror/flip and 90-degree rotation variants; changed invariance/hash/filter parameters create distinct cached signatures.

features.name: Visual video and subclip matching
features.detail: Requires ffmpeg/ffprobe. Compares perceptual frame sequences in temporal windows with duration tolerance, minimum matching-window fraction, letterbox detection and shorter-clip containment thresholds; presets include near-identical, similar and long-skip movie scans.

features.name: Video audio-fingerprint matching
features.detail: Separate audio comparison mode uses similarity, shorter/longer duration ratio, minimum duration and maximum audio difference; Krokiet manual says this mode itself does not require ffmpeg, unlike visual hashing/thumbnails.

features.name: Music tag and fingerprint matching
features.detail: Match selected title/artist/bitrate/genre/year/length tags, optionally approximate title/artist; alternatively compare content fingerprints with minimum matching segment and difference thresholds. Empty selected tags are not grouped.

features.name: Protected reference folders
features.detail: Ref paths participate as keeper references but are protected from selection/removal; all-reference scans are refused. Link actions target a group's reference file where present.

features.name: Exclude paths and patterns
features.detail: Excluded directories, whole-path glob patterns, include/exclude extensions and image/video/music/text extension groups restrict scans; default exclusions cover common system/cache locations.

features.name: Bound scan file sizes
features.detail: Global minimum/maximum size filters apply to appropriate tools; empty files, temporary files and largest/smallest scans explicitly ignore these bounds.

features.name: Group-aware keeper rules
features.detail: Select one or all except oldest/newest/biggest/smallest, shortest/longest path, and for images resolution; custom selection and group inversion are available. Highlighting and action checkboxes are deliberately distinct.

features.name: Allow every group member to be selected
features.detail: Select-all/inversion may check every member; deletion popup reports how many groups have every file checked rather than silently treating all actions as keep-one.

features.name: Leave groups unchanged
features.detail: Unselect-all or removing rows only from displayed results leaves files on disk; result hiding is not documented as a persistent review decision.

features.name: Shared signature caches
features.detail: CLI and Krokiet share full/prehash, perceptual image/video, music and scan caches; binary caches have JSON fallback and optional JSON export, with image parameters in cache keys.

features.name: Replace selected duplicates with hard links
features.detail: Group action keeps the reference or first checked file and links other checked members; requires at least two checked members without a reference. Applicable even to similar-media groups, so user judgment matters.

features.name: Replace selected duplicates with symbolic links
features.detail: Softlink action follows the same reference/first-checked keeper rule as hardlink; release notes explicitly mention surfacing rollback rename failures.

features.name: Export scan reports
features.detail: Save creates text, pretty JSON and compact JSON files; results cannot be loaded back into the GUI.

features.name: Preview and compare duplicate images
features.detail: Preview pane displays a highlighted image; Similar Images has a side-by-side Compare overlay. Video preview uses separately enabled thumbnails or thumbnail grids.

features.name: Find largest or smallest files
features.detail: Returns configurable N biggest or smallest files, default 50, excluding zero-byte files.

features.name: Find empty and content-empty files
features.detail: Finds zero-byte files, with extra checks for all-null content and non-visible-ASCII-only content; the latter can match non-Latin text, an explicit caution in the GUI manual.

features.name: Find recursively empty folder trees
features.detail: Reports topmost all-empty branches. Excluded/unreadable folders, symlinks or entries on another filesystem prevent a directory being declared empty.

features.name: Find configurable temporary artifacts
features.detail: Case-insensitive suffix matching includes download remnants, backups, cache/dump files and OS artifacts; users can replace/reset the suffix list.

features.name: Find broken or cyclic symbolic links
features.detail: Flags nonexistent targets and excessive/circular link chains; deletion removes the link, not its target.

features.name: Validate media and other files
features.detail: Parses images, audio, PDFs, archives, fonts and markup using type-specific libraries; errors are candidates for manual verification, not guaranteed corruption.

features.name: Quick or full video validation
features.detail: Off-by-default ffprobe header checks and slow ffmpeg full-decode checks require external ffmpeg; videos are otherwise not checked by Broken Files.

features.name: Detect and correct extension mismatches
features.detail: Magic-byte detection produces compatible-extension suggestions; Rename applies fixes and skips collisions with a warning.

features.name: Detect and repair problematic names
features.detail: Configurable rules cover uppercase extensions, emoji, edge whitespace, non-ASCII/transliteration, restricted character sets and repeated punctuation; results show proposed names and collision failures are reported.

features.name: Selective EXIF removal
features.detail: Finds metadata-bearing images and strips non-ignored tags; default preserved tag is Orientation. Cleaning supports library-dependent JPEG/PNG/TIFF/WebP/JXL/HEIF formats and creates a named cleaned copy unless overwrite is enabled.

features.name: Find and transcode inefficient videos
features.detail: Requires ffmpeg; excludes configurable already-efficient codecs and offers target codec, CRF, denoising, frame-size/fps limits, fail-if-bigger, overwrite and custom commands.

features.name: Detect static video borders
features.detail: ffmpeg-backed optimization detects black bars or static edge content using thresholds/sample limits and applies the proposed crop to selected files.

features.name: Hardware video encoding
features.detail: Optimizer offers NVENC, VAAPI, QSV, VideoToolbox and AMF, contingent on ffmpeg and the platform encoder.

features.name: RAW decoding for similar-image scans
features.detail: Current manual documents built-in rawler RAW decoding; optional libraw replaces the decoder rather than being mandatory.

features.name: HEIF/HEIC similar-image decoding
features.detail: Similar-image support requires a build with the heif feature and relevant system libraries; not inferred from EXIF-cleaning format support.

features.name: AVIF similar-image decoding
features.detail: Requires the libavif build feature and associated libraries.

features.name: JPEG XL similar-image scanning
features.detail: JXL is listed among supported similar-image extensions in the current Krokiet manual.

features.name: Interactive disk-usage charts
features.detail: Treemap and sunburst views provide file-type toggles, folder drilldown, type detection choices and detail thresholds. Uses file sizes rather than allocated space, counts hardlinks per name and does not follow symlinks.

features.name: Move or copy checked files
features.detail: Move popup can copy instead, preserve folder structure and either skip conflicts or rename to avoid them.

features.name: Use system trash
features.detail: Separate Trash action for checked scan results is recoverable through the OS, while Delete is permanent; trash may fail on network shares. Disk-usage chart's similarly named action is explicitly not functional.

features.name: Review destructive selections
features.detail: Checkboxes determine actions independently of highlighted preview rows, and delete popup flags groups with all members selected; reference rows are protected.

features.name: EXIF-cleaned copies by default
features.detail: EXIF cleaning defaults to writing a .czkawka_cleaned_exif copy; overwrite is an explicit popup option.

features.name: Configurable multithreading
features.detail: Thread count can be set, with zero meaning all CPU threads; changing it requires restart. Speed claims are project claims, not tested benchmarks.

features.name: Stop active scans
features.detail: Action bar switches between Scan and Stop during work.

features.name: Reusable video thumbnails
features.detail: With ffmpeg, generate a single position-based thumbnail or tiled grid; CLI pre-scanning populates GUI cache, and unused thumbnails older than seven days can be cleaned at startup.

features.name: Clean stale scan caches
features.detail: Automatic stale-record cleanup and a manual Clean outdated cache action remove entries for changed/missing files; separate global and per-preset settings are stored as JSON.

features.name: Notify on scan completion
features.detail: General settings include completion sound and desktop notification switches.

features.name: Persist scan configurations
features.detail: Ten user presets save roots, filters and tool parameters, plus a reserved command-line-path slot; custom selection rules are separately persisted.

features.name: Automatable CLI frontend
features.detail: Separate command-line frontend shares the core and caches; release 12.0.2 also adds starting a Krokiet scan through command-line arguments.

features.name: Embeddable scanning core
features.detail: UI-independent czkawka_core exposes scan configuration, typed results and shared functionality for other applications.

features.name: Local operation without telemetry
features.detail: README explicitly states no Internet access and no collection of user information/statistics.

features.name: Keyboard-driven result review
features.detail: Arrow/page/home/end navigation, shift-range highlighting, Space check/uncheck, Enter open and Ctrl+A highlight are documented.

features.name: Immediate dark/light switching
features.detail: Dark theme and UI language settings apply without restarting.

features.name: Portable desktop binaries
features.detail: Prebuilt Windows 10/11, macOS and Linux binaries require no installation; optional media builds/runtime dependencies remain separate.

features.name: Cedinia Android frontend
features.detail: Repository supplies a touch-oriented Cedinia frontend; its supported tools differ from Krokiet and GTK.

limitations.text: Current-branch capabilities are not a guarantee of inclusion in frozen release 12.0.2; GTK is discontinued as a released frontend.
Disk Usage's Move to trash currently only hides a chart item; it does not move the underlying file to trash.
Similar-image scanning excludes GIF and ICO; HEIC/AVIF depend on build features. Broken-file results can be false positives.
Saved result reports cannot be reloaded. No durable undo journal, persistent duplicate-review decisions, encrypted vault or photo-library AI is established by inspected documentation.
Hash-cache minimum-size UI is labelled KB although current core comparison uses bytes, according to the manual. Settings other than immediate preset actions are saved only on normal exit.

gaps: No evidence of catalogue-style face recognition, maps or sharing; not the toolkit's documented focus.
Android tool availability is not fully reconciled across README statements.
Inventory is pinned-current documentation, not a feature-by-feature verification of the older release.

R04.summary: Ente Photos combines end-to-end-encrypted backup and sharing with cross-platform clients, optional on-device AI and a mobile account-free local gallery. Auth and Locker product features are excluded.
deployment: iOS and Android Photos apps, including alternative Android distributions
Native macOS/Windows/Linux Photos desktop clients
Photos and public-album web applications
Photos CLI
Self-hosted Museum/server and web applications with Docker Compose
R04.storage_model: Cloud mode preserves uploaded originals and stores encrypted metadata, album membership and derived indexes separately. Reused assets have logical album references, not OS symlinks. Desktop/CLI export creates album folders plus Takeout-style JSON sidecars and can duplicate one asset across multiple exported albums. Mobile gallery mode reads device media without an account. Self-hosting requires configured database and object storage.
R04.privacy_model: Originals, descriptive metadata, face/search indexes and shared interactions are encrypted before server storage; ML queries/inference run on-device. Public-link keys reside in the URL fragment, so anyone receiving the link can decrypt its contents and metadata. Password links add server access control, not new encryption. Map tiles/model provisioning/backup/sharing need network services; local gallery and already-indexed search have offline operation. Hosted replication policies do not automatically apply to self-hosting.
maturity_notes: Scope is Ente Photos plus shared account/server capabilities applicable to Photos. GitHub stars are for the entire ente/ente monorepo, not Photos alone.
Pinned 52b907b57018958468615f4036851c196291012f. Manifest latest release locker-v1.0.12 belongs to another product and is not used as a Photos version.
Inspected Photos changelog records mobile v1.3.69/v1.3.68 in November 2026 and desktop v1.7.31 in October 2026; pinned documentation may be ahead of individual client packages.
Hosted service offers 10 GB free storage per README, with paid capacity/family benefits; self-hosting is distinct. Video streaming is explicitly beta.

Several guides simplify desktop face management as view-only, while the detailed face guide documents naming/merging and merge-history undo. Fine-grained incorrect-face editing remains mobile-only; this distinction is retained.
