features.name: Translated Photos interface
features.detail: Photos mobile v1.3.66 explicitly adds Korean UI language support and updates translations across sharing, account recovery, cleanup and onboarding; v1.3.67 restores missing translations. This is interface localization, separate from Magic Search query-language support; equal language coverage across clients is not asserted.

features.name: End-to-end-encrypted Photos
features.detail: Encrypts original media and metadata on the client; security FAQ identifies XChaCha20/XSalsa20, Poly1305 and Argon2id. Server operators do not receive plaintext library data or encryption keys.

features.name: Account-free local mobile gallery
features.detail: Gallery mode on iOS/Android browses device photos/videos and runs optional local face/semantic analysis without uploading; desktop does not have this mode.

features.name: Offline local/indexed use
features.detail: Device media and already-indexed face/Magic Search work offline; remote originals must first download, and account sharing/backups/maps are separate network-dependent functions.

features.name: Android Photos client
features.detail: Photos app supports Android and alternative distribution channels including F-Droid, with local gallery and encrypted backup modes.

features.name: iOS Photos client
features.detail: iOS app supports gallery/backup, editors and local AI, subject to mobile permission/background constraints.

features.name: Windows desktop Photos
features.detail: Native desktop client supports watch folders, local AI and continuous export; it is not the independent Auth client.

features.name: macOS desktop Photos
features.detail: Desktop Photos supports local AI/watch/export and macOS device-authentication app lock.

features.name: Linux desktop Photos
features.detail: Native Photos desktop release supports Linux, including documented RAW-preview improvements and export/ML workflows.

features.name: Photos and album web clients
features.detail: Web client supports uploads, basic search, metadata and sharing; public album viewers do not need an account. Web ML/face recognition is not available.

features.name: Self-hosted Photos backend
features.detail: Open-source production server can be deployed with configurable endpoints/buckets, Photos web and a separate public Albums application; clients can connect to it.

features.name: Docker Compose setup
features.detail: Quickstart provisions containers; documented minimum is one CPU core and 1 GB RAM. Production configuration/backup is the operator's responsibility.

features.name: Browse device folders in place
features.detail: Mobile gallery mode reads native Camera/Screenshots/other device albums without an import copy; cloud mode is a separate backup workflow.

features.name: Selective background mobile backup
features.detail: Selected device folders/albums back up originals without compression, use Wi-Fi by default with a cellular override, resume interrupted uploads and map into Ente albums.

features.name: Only-new-photo cutoff
features.detail: Onboarding new-only mode starts at seven days ago; enabling later uses the current moment. Already queued uploads are not cancelled and manual older uploads still work.

features.name: Desktop watched folders
features.detail: Monitors additions/deletions while the desktop client runs; new files upload and local deletions move cloud membership to Uncategorized instead of permanent removal. Edits to already-uploaded files are not tracked.

features.name: Multiple watched directories
features.detail: Multiple desktop watch folders have independent album-mapping choices and sync concurrently; these are roots feeding one account, not separate catalogues.

features.name: Flat folder-to-album mapping
features.detail: Upload/watch chooses one flattened album or separate albums named by leaf folders. Equal leaf names can merge into one album and empty folders are ignored.

features.name: Google Takeout metadata import
features.detail: Matches media with Takeout JSON dates/location/captions. Extract all archive parts into one parent while preserving album subfolders; reimporting skipped assets does not repair their stored dates.

features.name: Skip existing uploads
features.detail: Same-album duplicates skip; cross-album matches add logical references without re-upload. Mobile uses content hash; web/desktop require matching hash and filename.

features.name: Exact duplicate cleanup
features.detail: Manual mobile/desktop cleanup recognizes content hashes and retains one underlying file with references in each album; independently generated thumbnails can differ without changing identity.

features.name: Mobile near-image cleanup
features.detail: ML Similar images groups visually related but nonidentical photos for mobile review; desktop lacks this dedicated cleanup feature.

features.name: Similar-image keeper defaults
features.detail: Review can override deletion choices. Favorites are never auto-selected; other files favor the largest size, with filename as tie-breaker, not resolution or EXIF completeness.

features.name: Review similar groups before removal
features.detail: Mobile Similar images requires reviewing groups and confirming which copies to keep/delete; logical album references help avoid removing every representation of a scene from albums.

features.name: Free device space after backup
features.detail: Shows reclaimable size and removes backed-up local copies after confirmation, retaining Ente originals; the automated action covers all backed-up items rather than an arbitrary selective subset.

features.name: Original-quality export
features.detail: Desktop/CLI export preserves original file bytes and album folders; files in several albums appear in each exported folder, potentially increasing local space.

features.name: Continuous one-way local backup
features.detail: Desktop continuous export downloads new items while running; CLI repeated/scheduled exports incrementally update a disk or mounted NAS. Local edits do not upload back.

features.name: Takeout-style export sidecars
features.detail: Exports edits into metadata/filename.ext.json with canonical photoTakenTime, description and geoData; originals remain unchanged. Legacy creationTime field is deprecated.

features.name: Keep locally exported deleted copies
features.detail: Cloud deletion moves exported files into an export Trash folder; subsequently emptying cloud Trash does not automatically delete those local copies.

features.name: Resume uploads and exports
features.detail: Interrupted backup resumes with connectivity and repeated CLI export continues previous work; retained encrypted upload staging can temporarily increase device storage.

features.name: Square and proportional layouts
features.detail: Mobile gallery chooses square tiles or original-proportion mosaic; pinch adjusts density and crosses into mosaic without modifying images.

features.name: Capture-date timeline
features.detail: Device gallery presents photos chronologically; cloud metadata date selection uses embedded metadata, Takeout sidecar, filename inference then upload-time fallback.

features.name: Photo/video viewer
features.detail: Local and signed-in mobile modes provide a full-screen photo/video viewer with swiping and pinch zoom.

features.name: Pinch zoom and swiping
features.detail: Gallery-mode comparison explicitly includes pinch-to-zoom and swiping between media; collage framing also uses pinch/drag.

features.name: Album slideshows
features.detail: Mobile and desktop play photos/Live Photos, not videos, with 5-second through 10-minute intervals, ordered/shuffled playback and black/blurred backgrounds. Mobile can combine albums; desktop plays one album.

features.name: Desktop/web shortcuts
features.detail: Search focus, range/additive/select-all selection and delete shortcuts are documented; slideshow uses arrows and Space.

features.name: Original video playback
features.detail: Clients view videos, but browser-unsupported codecs may require original-file download instead of streaming.

features.name: Encrypted video streaming beta
features.detail: Optional stream generation creates 720p H.264 at 2 Mbps in encrypted HLS with encrypted playlist, enabling seeking without downloading whole originals. Stream storage is quota-exempt only during beta.

features.name: HLS video streaming beta
features.detail: Optional beta streaming generates 720p H.264 at 2 Mbps with an HLS playlist so mobile and web/desktop clients can begin playback and seek without first downloading the complete original. A stream must have been generated; unsupported or failed streams can fall back to original-file playback/download. Streams are encrypted and quota-exempt only during beta.

features.name: Virtual cloud albums
features.detail: Signed-in users create albums with covers/descriptions and reuse one original across albums through references; local account-free mode does not provide Ente albums.

features.name: Nested albums
features.detail: FAQ explicitly states albums are flat and cannot be nested, even when uploaded folders are nested.

features.name: Manual drag ordering
features.detail: FAQ explicitly says photos/videos cannot currently be dragged into a custom album order; available Sort by options must be used instead.

features.name: Uncategorized catch-all
features.detail: Removing the last album membership or watched-folder file retains the asset in Uncategorized. Cleaning removes only entries also present in an album the user owns.

features.name: People-driven auto-add albums
features.detail: Mobile config adds existing/new owned uploads containing selected named people after local face indexing, including editable collaborative albums; Favorites/Uncategorized are excluded and disabling ML pauses updates.

features.name: Signed-in favorites
features.detail: Favorites are account-backed organization, used by widgets and protected by similar-image auto-selection; unavailable in account-free gallery mode.

features.name: Timeline decluttering archive
features.detail: Archive removes items from home timeline/memories while retaining search and album visibility; no extra authentication is required.

features.name: Authenticated hidden section
features.detail: Hide removes owned media from ordinary timeline/albums/search and requires device authentication for Hidden; a still-local copy may remain visible in On device views.

features.name: Filename search
features.detail: Web/basic search includes filename alongside date, description and album; no semantic model is required for these fields.

features.name: Parsed metadata and caption search
features.detail: Only fields parsed at import are searchable; raw EXIF can still be displayed separately. Captions/descriptions are searchable and encrypted.

features.name: Date-constrained discovery
features.detail: Magic Search documentation combines semantic results with date filters and specific time periods; web supports basic date search.

features.name: On-device CLIP Magic Search
features.detail: Opt-in local CLIP matches natural-language objects/scenes/colors/activities and relationships; combine with dates, people, albums or locations. English typically works best; not available in the web client.

features.name: Optional client-side ML
features.detail: Face and semantic indexing runs on mobile/desktop. Signed-in mode indexes backed-up media only, whereas signed-out gallery mode can index permitted local files.

features.name: Local face detection
features.detail: Opt-in analysis detects face regions as the first stage of recognizing people; web does not support this feature.

features.name: Automatic person groups
features.detail: Automatically groups similar faces after indexing. Mobile mixed-group re-evaluation applies stricter settings for difficult cases such as babies.

features.name: Cross-photo identity matching
features.detail: Face groups find all photos containing the same people across albums; identity naming and corrective operations remain local and encrypted on sync.

features.name: Named people
features.detail: Mobile/desktop assign names to groups and make them searchable; selecting an existing named identity merges groups.

features.name: Merge, de-merge and reject faces
features.detail: Mobile supports de-merge, Not this person, ignored-group restore and cover selection; desktop has naming/merge-history undo/ignore but not individual incorrect-face editing or cover selection.

features.name: Person-name search
features.detail: Named identities can be searched across albums using the local face index; no unencrypted face data or search queries need reach the service.

features.name: Reuse encrypted indexes across devices
features.detail: Index on desktop, sync encrypted results to mobile and disable mobile local indexing to reduce memory load. Concurrent clients avoid duplicate indexing but documentation says this does not accelerate the overall job.

features.name: Person growth timelines
features.detail: Mobile Memory Lane requires at least two years with four eligible person photos per year; known ages below three, hidden items and ignored faces are excluded. Timelines include age/year captions and public-link presentation.

features.name: On-this-day and curated memories
features.detail: Mobile memories/widgets show On This Day, Past Years and smart curated moments; notifications can exclude a person by hiding them from memories.

features.name: On-demand text selection
features.detail: Mobile long-press recognizes/copies text in photos/Live Photos using on-device OCR. Android downloads models on first use; supported languages vary, and Trash/guest views and video are excluded.

features.name: Library-wide recognized-text search
features.detail: OCR guide explicitly states Detect Text builds no searchable library index; occasional CLIP matches to prominent text are not dedicated OCR search.

features.name: QR actions inside photos
features.detail: Mobile detects multiple QR codes on-device and offers open/copy/share plus supported UPI payment actions; scanning alone does not upload QR contents.

features.name: Full EXIF inspection
features.detail: Reads capture time/camera/GPS for import and exposes View all EXIF on mobile/web/desktop; not every raw field is searchable.

features.name: IPTC import
features.detail: Imports embedded IPTC alongside other standards, including date information; original bytes remain preserved.

features.name: XMP import
features.detail: Reads embedded XMP for metadata/date extraction without implying arbitrary XMP sidecar editing.

features.name: Encrypted descriptive captions
features.detail: Edit searchable descriptions in the info panel on mobile/web/desktop; values sync encrypted and are separate from originals.

features.name: Correct capture timestamps
features.detail: Desktop bulk Edit/Fix time can use original/digitized/metadata EXIF dates, parsed filename or custom time. Corrections sync but never rewrite original EXIF.

features.name: Batch date/location editing
features.detail: Desktop supports bulk creation-time changes; mobile/web/desktop allow location edits on multi-selection.

features.name: Non-embedded coordinate corrections
features.detail: Add or drag map coordinates for photos lacking/wrong locations. Values belong to Ente's separate metadata and do not strip/replace GPS inside the original or phone-library copy.

features.name: Rename without rewriting originals
features.detail: Filename edits in the info panel are stored separately and synced; original filename is preserved.

features.name: Photo/album map
features.detail: View all GPS-tagged media or one album on the map across clients; location search is local and coordinates encrypted. Desktop changelog explicitly references OpenStreetMap tile loading.

features.name: Custom radius-defined places
features.detail: Create labels such as Home/Office by choosing a center and radius; the app groups matching photos locally, with encrypted location labels.

features.name: Private location discovery
features.detail: Search location tags and geographic areas locally; Magic Search can be narrowed to a tagged place.

features.name: Photo crop and straighten
features.detail: Mobile editor crops and straightens arbitrary tilts; saved result is a separate copy.

features.name: Rotate/flip photos
features.detail: JPEG-only rotation/flip edits avoid re-encoding; other edits may re-encode. Originals remain untouched.

features.name: Filters and color adjustments
features.detail: Mobile editor offers filters, brightness/contrast/saturation/exposure/hue/temperature/tint/fade. Recent changelog explicitly removes Sharpness and Luminance.

features.name: Draw, text and stickers
features.detail: Mobile editor draws and layers text/stickers with font/color/background/alignment controls and per-object edit/duplicate/delete; text becomes image pixels rather than searchable caption metadata.

features.name: Two-to-six-photo mobile collages
features.detail: Choose layouts, swap tiles by long-press/tap, pinch/drag framing and save to device gallery; no videos or web/desktop creation.

features.name: Trim single videos
features.detail: Mobile editor sets start/end with preview and a one-second minimum; this documents trimming only, not joining. Each export is a finalized new file, not a saved edit recipe.

features.name: Video framing and orientation
features.detail: Mobile crops freely or to 1:1, 9:16, 16:9, 3:4 or 4:3 and rotates in 90-degree steps, accounting for original orientation.

features.name: New-copy MP4 export
features.detail: Native AVFoundation/Media3 export produces H.264 MP4, with FFmpeg H.264/AAC fallback; iOS simple trims can use passthrough. New copy preserves date/location/album membership where available.

features.name: Native accelerated video export
features.detail: Native export uses hardware acceleration where supported; software FFmpeg fallback runs when native export fails.

features.name: Save edited copies
features.detail: Photo/video edits leave original files unchanged and save new finalized copies. Edited dimensions/format or secondary metadata can change; not a reversible development-history stack.

features.name: Original metadata preserved on export
features.detail: Original downloads retain embedded metadata verbatim; Ente/Takeout corrections travel as JSON sidecars, not rewritten EXIF. Edited copies preserve selected camera/date/location fields but not necessarily all metadata.

features.name: Live Photos viewing and utilities
features.detail: Live Photos participate in album slideshows and photo OCR; differing video-frame thumbnail extraction does not affect exact duplicate identity.

features.name: Limited RAW previews and backup
features.detail: Backup FAQ explicitly calls RAW support limited; desktop v1.7.30 improves RAF/ORF/PEF/NRW/SRW previews on Linux/Windows. Universal camera compatibility is not claimed.

features.name: Broad image/video original backup
features.detail: Accepts image/* and video/* originals up to 10 GB, without upload compression; backup eligibility does not guarantee every client can thumbnail/play the format.

features.name: JPEG XL preview availability
features.detail: FAQ explicitly says JPEG XL may upload while lacking a thumbnail/preview; reliable viewing across clients is not established.

features.name: Ultra HDR thumbnail metadata
features.detail: Desktop v1.7.30 preserves HDR gain maps in Ultra HDR JPEG thumbnails generated on Linux/Windows; this is narrower than a universal HDR rendering guarantee.

features.name: Encrypted public/quick album links
features.detail: Share an album or selected items without requiring recipients' accounts. Quick links create a backing album, can become ordinary albums and can be revoked without deleting photos.

features.name: Password access control
features.detail: Optional link password gates server access to encrypted content but does not re-encrypt it or change the embedded link key.

features.name: Expiring links
features.detail: Choose preset/custom expiry and later extend/change it; expired or removed links stop granting access.

features.name: Link audience device cap
features.detail: Limits unique IP+User-Agent combinations, not actual physical devices; already admitted combinations retain access after the cap is reached. Free plans have a ten-device cap.

features.name: Uncapped paid link audiences
features.detail: Paid plans can create public links without the free tier's ten-device limit.

features.name: Masonry, grouped and Trip layouts
features.detail: Public viewers support proportional masonry, date groups or map/timeline Trip layout; Trip currently redirects custom-domain links to albums.ente.com.

features.name: Hide public download controls
features.detail: Owners can hide download buttons, but recipients can still copy via browser/tools/screenshots and metadata is not stripped. This is not DRM or guaranteed original-file protection.

features.name: Custom-domain album links
features.detail: Public links can use an owner-controlled domain; Trip and app-reopen/join flows have documented custom-domain limitations.

features.name: Separate accounts with sharing
features.detail: Each user has their own account/storage; invited collaborators share selected albums. Multiple accounts are not counted as selectable libraries.

features.name: Authenticated collaborative albums
features.detail: Email-invited participants add photos/videos. Each uploader pays their own quota, and their contributions leave the shared album if they leave while remaining in their account.

features.name: Viewer/collaborator/admin/owner roles
features.detail: Viewer views/downloads/comments, collaborator adds/removes own uploads, admin manages members/removes membership and suggests deletion; only owner manages links/deletes album and nobody permanently deletes others' assets.

features.name: Account-free collect links
features.detail: Anyone with the enabled link can view/add through a browser; collected files count to the owner's quota and guests cannot delete uploads. Current guide says contributor attribution is unavailable.

features.name: Encrypted album-scoped discussions
features.detail: Shared albums/public links support comments, quoted replies, likes and anonymous display names. Same photo has separate threads per album; owners/admins moderate. Comments cap at 500 characters and do not apply to unshared private albums.

features.name: Shared-album comments and likes
features.detail: Mobile, web and desktop support commenting, quoted replies and likes on shared photos/videos; public-link visitors can participate anonymously when enabled. Owners/admins moderate comments, each album keeps a separate thread for the same photo, and comments are limited to 500 characters. Unshared private albums do not support these interactions; comment and like data remain end-to-end encrypted.

features.name: Shared social activity feed
features.detail: Mobile Feed aggregates likes/comments/replies from shared albums; it is social history, not an operation-recovery journal.

features.name: Owner-approved deletion suggestions
features.detail: On mobile, album owners/admins remove others' selected photos from the album and send a deletion suggestion; actual photo owners accept/delete or reject/keep in their queue.

features.name: Paid family capacity sharing
features.detail: Paid subscriber plus five members share one plan while content stays private by default; admin can set individual storage limits.

features.name: Automatic future-album sharing
features.detail: Within family sharing, select owned albums in bulk and optionally share newly created albums automatically; shared capacity alone never grants content access.

features.name: Thirty-day cloud Trash
features.detail: Deleted Ente assets remain recoverable for 30 days and count toward quota until purged. Bulk restore targets a chosen album, not each previous membership; permanent deletion is unrecoverable.

features.name: Android device trash integration
features.detail: On Android 11+, deleting local gallery items through Ente uses Android system trash and exposes a Device recovery tab even for unbacked media; system retention is distinct from Ente's 30 days.

features.name: Review before cleanup/deletion
features.detail: Cloud deletion, empty Trash and device-space cleanup require confirmation; duplicate cleanup reviews results and reclaimable-space information first.

features.name: No automatic cross-device destructive sync
features.detail: Native-device deletion does not delete backup, and cloud deletion does not silently erase the device original. Ente remembers uploaded files to avoid automatically re-uploading deliberately deleted cloud copies.

features.name: Photos Legacy recovery
features.detail: Previously accepted Ente trusted contacts can request recovery with a 7/14/30-day owner veto period, then change account password; configured from Photos mobile and applicable to photo succession.

features.name: Local app lock
features.detail: Mobile/desktop offer PIN/password locks, configurable immediate-to-30-minute background autolock and device authentication; desktop device lock is macOS-only.

features.name: Hide app-switcher content
features.detail: Mobile Hide content obscures app-switcher views and disables screenshots on Android; no claim of general screen-recording prevention is made.

features.name: Authenticated-exit handoff viewer
features.detail: Mobile guest view restricts browsing to one item/selection/album, hides edit/share/delete/info/navigation and requires configured device authentication to exit.

features.name: Photos account second factor
features.detail: Shared account supports TOTP or WebAuthn passkeys as a second factor; adding passkeys replaces configured TOTP, rather than making Photos passwordless. This does not inventory Ente Auth's authenticator features.

features.name: User-held recovery key
features.detail: A 24-word key recovers access after password loss; absent password, signed-in recovery route/key or preconfigured trusted contact, support cannot decrypt Photos data.

features.name: Photos export CLI
features.detail: CLI exports selected albums or individual files and supports scheduled local/NAS backups; restarting export resumes. It is not a two-way filesystem sync tool.

features.name: Public third-party Photos API
features.detail: Advanced FAQ explicitly says there is no public third-party API and directs automation users to CLI; open server source is not equivalent to a supported public API.

features.name: Encrypted-album slideshow casting
features.detail: Cast sends an album slideshow to Chromecast or any Internet-connected screen using PIN pairing; multiple sessions can be managed. It does not mirror the photo currently scrolled on the phone.

features.name: Mobile memories/album/people widgets
features.detail: iOS/Android widgets show configured albums, memories or ML-selected people, usually refresh about every 15 minutes and require account features for album/people widgets.

features.name: Shared updates and memories reminders
features.detail: Mobile notifications cover shared additions, memories and tagged-person birthdays. Categories are configurable; birthday reminders occur on the day, not earlier.

features.name: Scheduled photo habits
features.detail: Mobile rituals link an owned album to weekdays/reminders and track capture-date-based scheduled-day streaks. Ritual camera supports up to 20 photos/session, not video; ritual settings stay local although the album syncs.

features.name: Three-provider hosted replicas
features.detail: Hosted specification describes two hot encrypted copies in Amsterdam/Frankfurt and one cold copy in Paris across Backblaze/Wasabi/Scaleway; self-hosters must design their own redundancy.

features.name: Provider-level deletion protection
features.detail: Hosted Wasabi replica uses compliance hold plus a 21-day release buffer; cleanup occurs later after customer permanent deletion. This does not promise user restoration after Trash expires.

features.name: Hosted database backup and restore checks
features.detail: Specification describes HA Postgres, six-hour snapshots, daily portable dumps, encrypted locked cross-provider copies and daily restore testing with alerts. These are service operational claims, not tested here.

features.name: Automatic cross-provider failover
features.detail: Reliability document describes manually tested secondary-storage/database recovery and lists fully automatic failover as future work; primary DB active/passive failover is already distinct.

features.name: Paid hosted capacity
features.detail: README describes Photos as a paid service with a 10 GB free allocation; additional hosted capacity requires a subscription, separate from self-hosting.

limitations.text: This profile excludes independent Auth token-management and Locker document features; monorepo stars and latest Locker release are not attributed solely to Photos.

No nested albums/custom drag ordering or general two-way sync. Watch folders do not update previously uploaded file edits, NAS watch imports are not officially supported and exports must not target an upload-watched directory.
Account-free local gallery is mobile-only and lacks cloud albums/favorites/hide/archive/sharing. Signing in discards local gallery ML indexes and limits subsequent indexing to backed-up assets.
Web lacks face/Magic Search; desktop lacks fine-grained face correction, mobile Similar images cleanup, collage and video editor. On-demand OCR does not create searchable text across the library.
10 GB per-file limit; RAW preview support is limited and uploaded formats may not display. Apple Portrait's separate editable depth/adjustment payload is not preserved like a full Apple Photos asset.

Public recipients can decrypt metadata including GPS. Hiding download buttons or editing the catalogue location neither prevents copying nor removes original embedded coordinates; password links are access control, not additional encryption.

Ente's symlink wording means logical album references, not filesystem link replacement. Exported multi-album files may consume repeated disk space and metadata edits require JSON-aware destination tools.

Hosted retention locks and restore checks do not make user-deleted data recoverable after the documented recovery windows, and do not establish a durable per-file-operation journal for client actions.
Offline basemaps, user-configurable integrity scrubbing, general tagging/rating writeback, full RAW development and a crash-recovery file-operation journal are not established by inspected sources.
Some documentation overstates hiding download controls in the collaboration page; the dedicated public-link guide explicitly disclaims preventing copies and is treated as controlling evidence.

gaps: No application execution or independent cryptographic/performance verification; hosted durability is reported as documented design.
Selected backup/security FAQ sections were read in full as listed, rather than every troubleshooting question; feature-specific guides and current Photos release entries cover the feature inventory.
Legacy Auth/Locker functionality excluded; client-version/platform asymmetries and a few internally simplified documentation statements are explicitly qualified.

R05.summary: Self-hosted photographic library with in-place indexing, local recognition/search, rich metadata interoperability, controlled sharing and explicit duplicate/stack workflows.
deployment: Unified Docker container
Multi-container Docker Compose with optional NVIDIA acceleration
Kubernetes and Unraid
Windows standalone librephotos.exe without Docker/Python
Responsive web application
Official Android/iOS Expo app is source-only and explicitly unreleased; separate released UhuruPhotos client
R05.storage_model: Local originals remain in configured per-user library roots; uploads enter configured upload folders. Database holds edits, ownership, people, albums and metadata. protected_media contains thumbnails, face crops, downloaded models, similarity indexes, extracted motion video and temporary ZIPs. PostgreSQL is used by standard Docker; SQLite by Windows/unified internal database. Optional Nextcloud import downloads local copies and does not write back.
R05.privacy_model: ML inference is local after model provisioning. New installs use offline ExifTool town geocoding, but default map tiles and address search contact external providers; release checks and explicitly enabled report sharing are additional network paths. Metadata write-back defaults off; OCR stores sensitive recognized text unencrypted. Public/shared-file delivery may strip metadata depending on permissions, but granting originals exposes embedded metadata. No E2EE or universal air-gap guarantee is claimed.
maturity_notes: Frozen dev commit db70302757661a8b82cc18266a2e79e29b0dccf9; latest release 1.6.0 was published 2026-11-09.
Current repository consolidates backend, frontend, mobile, docs and deployment repositories. Detailed versioned guides supersede stale feature-comparison rows and older inline notes.
Official Expo mobile app is explicitly not on stores/TestFlight/F-Droid or GitHub APK releases; its implemented source-preview capabilities are kept separate from normal released clients.
1.6.0 fixes sharing/user-management security issues and disables ONNX telemetry that 1.5.0/1.5.1 Docker images sent to Microsoft (models/hardware, not photos).
Performance/accuracy measurements in release notes are author claims, not benchmarks performed here. README recommends 8 GB+ for ML.

features.name: Translated web interface
features.detail: Release notes identify translated UI labels maintained through Weblate; user-selected language changes translated event titles, Things labels and localized numeric formatting. English-only Things search vocabulary is a separate limitation.

features.name: Self-hosted photo server
features.detail: Own-server library with browser frontend and local ML; README recommends at least 4 GB RAM and preferably 8 GB+ for analysis.

features.name: Unified or multi-container Docker
features.detail: Single-container install or separated backend/frontend/proxy Compose; Kubernetes and Unraid are recorded separately rather than inferred from generic Docker compatibility.

features.name: Kubernetes deployment manifests
features.detail: README explicitly provides Kustomize manifests in deploy/k8s; 1.6.0 release notes confirm those manifests were updated to the 1.6.0 image version.

features.name: Documented Unraid deployment
features.detail: README lists Unraid as an installation choice and links its dedicated installation guide. This records the documented deployment surface without asserting additional NAS integrations.

features.name: Standalone Windows application
features.detail: One folder with librephotos.exe, no Docker/Python installation required; SQLite and protected-media data are local to the Windows application.

features.name: Responsive web client
features.detail: Light/dark desktop/mobile layouts, phone bottom sheets and configurable pinned sidebar plus recent albums in 1.6.0.

features.name: Released third-party Android client
features.detail: Mobile guide points users needing an installable app to UhuruPhotos; 1.6.0 restores compatibility for its released builds. Official Expo client is separate and unreleased.

features.name: Unreleased official Android source preview
features.detail: Implemented official Expo Android app runs through Expo Go or a development build, but has no Google Play, F-Droid or GitHub APK release. It is distinct from the released third-party UhuruPhotos integration; production distribution is not counted as present.

features.name: Unreleased official iOS client
features.detail: Official mobile guide explicitly supports running the implemented iPhone app from source through Expo Go or a development build, but says there is no App Store or TestFlight release. This is an upcoming/source-preview surface, not currently packaged native iOS availability.

features.name: Index originals in place
features.detail: Scans existing image/video/RAW/XMP files without reorganizing them by default; unrelated sidecars/non-media are skipped.

features.name: Several roots per user library
features.detail: Main scan folder, additional admin-added folders and separate upload folder form one library; unreadable/unplugged roots are skipped without marking their photos missing.

features.name: Folder-tree browsing
features.detail: Browse indexed directories/subdirectories with recursive counts and newest-photo covers; empty/unindexed/hidden directories are not listed.

features.name: Safe incremental baseline
features.detail: Rereads new/changed files and sidecars and retries prior metadata failures; cancelled/partial/failed scans do not replace the last complete-library baseline.

features.name: Automatic per-library schedules
features.detail: Admin chooses hourly, daily or custom weekdays/time, off by default. Overlapping queued/running scans are skipped and server timezone is shown.

features.name: External watcher integration
features.detail: Official guide provides an inotifywait/curl/jq watcher feeding scan-files API, batching after 30 seconds; not an always-enabled native filesystem watcher.

features.name: Scan named files or subtrees
features.detail: API accepts up to 1000 changed paths and separately 1000 removed paths; validates library scope and detects move-out/move-in without losing personal edits.

features.name: Exclude user subfolders
features.detail: Leave out subfolders recursively, with optional trashing of already-indexed out-of-scope photos. Exclusion alone never deletes disk files; hidden/skip-pattern folders also stay out.

features.name: Queued web drag/drop uploads
features.detail: Drop multiple photos/videos anywhere, append to active queue and upload directly into own unlocked albums; account scan directory and admin upload enablement are prerequisites.

features.name: One-megabyte upload chunks
features.detail: Uploads one file at a time in 1 MB chunks; cancel stops after current chunk, retries failed/cancelled files while tab remains open and removes old partial uploads daily.

features.name: Content-aware upload skip
features.detail: Checks MD5 plus user ID before upload; existing photos can still be added to the target album without retransmitting bytes.

features.name: Read Google Takeout sidecar JSON
features.detail: Scans adjacent JSON for capture UTC time, GPS/altitude and description only as lower-priority fallback; handles supplemental/truncated/duplicate/edited filenames without rewriting originals.

features.name: Optional Nextcloud download/index
features.detail: Select remote folder, copy into nextcloud_media/user, reuse unchanged files and refresh changed media/XMP. Deleted remote files are marked missing, not silently deleted locally; no write-back to Nextcloud.

features.name: Move photos with companions
features.detail: Move within library with all variants/XMP, retaining albums/faces/ratings/shares. Skip missing, shared-file and Nextcloud-copy cases; selections over 100 use a background job. Copy is not established by this workflow.

features.name: Move into capture-date directories
features.detail: Choose year, year/month or year/month/day destinations with preview counts; undated photos remain until given dates.

features.name: Capture-date filename templates
features.detail: Presets/custom year/month/day/hour/minute/second/original-name tokens rename photos and companions, preview changes and suffix collisions; over 100 photos runs in background.

features.name: Safe move/rename collisions
features.detail: Move chooses rename-keep-both or skip; rename adds numbered suffixes. Destination files are never silently overwritten.

features.name: Companion-aware move rollback
features.detail: If one file of a photo cannot move, previously moved companion files are put back; rename also retains old names on failure. Docs establish per-photo rollback, not a durable crash-recovery journal.

features.name: Original and multi-variant export
features.detail: Single-photo page selects original variant; multi-photo ZIP includes all file variants and XMP sidecars with collision-safe paired names, optionally adding all stack photos.

features.name: Day/place timeline and date scrubber
features.detail: Capture-date grouped timeline with newest/oldest account-saved order, undated bucket and simple or photo-density scrubber; events always chronological.

features.name: Filtered photographic grids
features.detail: Views cover favourites, recent latest-import day, hidden/archive, photos/videos, screenshots/documents and missing-date/location/album cases; filter-aware select-all targets only displayed scope.

features.name: Cursor-paged large days
features.detail: 1.6.0 uses cursor pages for /api/days rather than offset/page-number queries, retaining scroll geometry while rows load. Reported speedups are not independently measured.

features.name: Lightbox and standalone photo page
features.detail: Black-stage lightbox, thumbnail strip, fullscreen toggle and deep-link photo address; browser Back closes viewer and restores grid position.

features.name: Load original on zoom
features.detail: Signed-in authorized viewers fetch original when zooming; RAW/HEIC/TIFF/JXL/rotated images may remain preview-only with original-download link. Public visitors retain display-size previews.

features.name: Timed slideshow and public presentation link
features.detail: Intervals 3/5/10/15/30 seconds with keyboard control; public album ?slideshow=1 starts automatically, stops at last photo and respects reduced-motion preference.

features.name: Command palette and viewer shortcuts
features.detail: Ctrl/Cmd+K, Ctrl/Cmd+P or / opens palette for people/places/albums/search/actions; viewer keys handle rating, text selection, archive, slideshow, navigation and video seek.

features.name: Light/dark theme and mobile layouts
features.detail: 1.6.0 redesign covers pages, viewer, dialogs and sidebar; map display darkening is performed in-browser without a second tile source.

features.name: Interactive 360-degree photo spheres
features.detail: WebGL drag/swipe/pinch viewer uses GPano equirectangular metadata or exact 2:1 images at least 6000 px wide; cylindrical panoramas and 360 videos are not sphere-rendered.

features.name: Direct or fallback video playback
features.detail: Checks browser codec support, plays original when possible and falls back on decode failure. Keyboard seeks 10 seconds/one minute except during live conversion.

features.name: Cached H.264 playback conversion
features.detail: For signed-in viewers unsupported videos convert while playing to H.264 capped at 720 lines and are cached; public unauthenticated visitors do not receive this conversion.

features.name: HDR-to-SDR previews and playback
features.detail: HDR phone video is tone-mapped during thumbnail/conversion paths; HDR badges and probe/rebuild job repair older previews.

features.name: Capture-time ordering
features.detail: User controls newest/oldest date order across lists; missing dates remain last. Per-album date sort refers to oldest member capture time, not album creation.

features.name: File-path text matching
features.detail: Text search includes indexed file paths alongside captions, people, location, cameras, lenses, types and ISO-format date fragments.

features.name: Technical camera/exposure filters
features.detail: Maker/model/lens plus inclusive min/max ISO, aperture, focal length and 35-mm equivalent; values absent from a photo cannot match their filter.

features.name: Personal and embedded keyword search
features.detail: Matches user tags and XMP/IPTC keywords, including sidecars. Display-translated AI Things remain searchable by English word in current guide.

features.name: All-word and quoted-phrase text search
features.detail: Every word must appear somewhere in indexed text; commas split words and quotes preserve phrases. Case/diacritics are folded except OCR; semantic augmentation can return nonliteral matches.

features.name: Inclusive capture-date ranges
features.detail: Before/after dates plus current-year/last-year/last-12-month shortcuts combine with other filters.

features.name: Find several people together
features.detail: Person-name search and repeat person filters require all chosen people in a photo; suggestions rank matches by face count.

features.name: Minimum stars or favourites filter
features.detail: Filter rating 1–5 threshold or favourites-only according to chosen rating UI.

features.name: Place names and GPS-presence filters
features.detail: Find by place name, custom private place or whether GPS exists; Places map limits visible place albums to current viewport.

features.name: Media, extension and RAW filters
features.detail: Photos/video/screenshots/documents plus main-file extension and Has a RAW file, including RAW companions.

features.name: Share/bookmark filter URLs
features.detail: Active filters live in page address, appear as removable chips and preserve words/media when cleared; this is URL persistence rather than a saved-query catalogue.

features.name: Optional OpenCLIP semantic retrieval
features.detail: Disabled by default; choose top 10/50/100 semantic matches above threshold, merged with ordinary text results. Requires completed embeddings/index, persisted under protected_media/similarity.

features.name: Similar-photo recommendations
features.detail: Lightbox shows semantically similar photos from OpenCLIP embeddings, distinct from pHash duplicate detection.

features.name: Search recognized photo text
features.detail: OCR text joins normal text search; PostgreSQL matches words whereas SQLite permits substring matches.

features.name: Extensive photographic metadata
features.detail: ExifTool reads dates/UTC offsets/GPS/altitude/orientation, camera/lens/serial, exposure, rights, video duration/codec and dimensions; on-demand raw-metadata dialog filters groups/tags/values and copies JSON.

features.name: IPTC keyword/caption/rights import
features.detail: Reads Keywords, Caption-Abstract, ObjectName, By-line and CopyrightNotice with documented XMP/EXIF precedence.

features.name: Embedded and sidecar XMP
features.detail: Reads basename.xmp and filename.ext.xmp, uppercase variants and RAW/video companion sidecars with field-specific precedence; hierarchy keywords flatten to last level.

features.name: Opt-in original metadata write-back
features.detail: Save to media file writes supported ratings/dates/manual captions/GPS/keywords/rights and optional face regions via ExifTool; support varies by format and image bytes are not re-encoded.

features.name: Opt-in XMP sidecar write-back
features.detail: Updates highest-priority existing main-file sidecar or creates filename.ext.xmp, preserving unrelated tags. RAW companion sidecars are read but writes target the main photo's sidecar.

features.name: Bulk ratings, dates, locations and tags
features.detail: Bulk UI edits use background write-back when enabled; Write now exports pre-existing catalogue edits in 200-photo batches with per-file errors and cancellation.

features.name: Shift or set capture dates
features.detail: Shift a selection by days/hours/minutes/seconds preserving intervals, or assign one timestamp. Manual dates survive rescans; Remove timestamp returns control to date rules.

features.name: Configurable metadata/date precedence
features.detail: Ordered rules choose XMP/EXIF/video/GPS/Takeout/name times, use recorded or GPS/default timezone and can be reapplied without rewriting originals or overriding manually set dates.

features.name: Assign, copy and remove locations
features.detail: Map click/drag, address search, pasted coordinates, explicit browser location or nearby-in-time photos; bulk defaults to filling missing GPS, with replace-all choice and optional write-back.

features.name: Personal tags with rename/merge
features.detail: Comma-separated autocomplete, bulk additive tagging, single-photo replacement/removal and user-private tag albums; rename/merge/delete can update keywords with write-back enabled.

features.name: Interoperable zero-to-five stars
features.detail: Choose stars or favourite toggle; keyboard 0–5 and bulk selection ratings map to imported/exported XMP rating, with configurable favourite threshold.

features.name: Favourite photos
features.detail: Favourites derive from rating threshold; removing a favourite sets rating to zero and therefore clears any existing star rating.

features.name: Manual captions alongside generated captions
features.detail: User captions are editable and searchable; generated suggestions are separate and do not overwrite a manual caption during bulk generation.

features.name: Creator, copyright and licence metadata
features.detail: Reads/displays creator/copyright and fixed Creative Commons/all-rights/public-domain licence choices, with supported write-back. Licence-bearing public photos expose relevant rights regardless of other detail switches.

features.name: Portable named MWG face regions
features.detail: Imports XMP RegionInfo faces/names and merges overlapping detections; optional face-write switch plus metadata-write mode exports normalized regions/names with rotation handling.

features.name: Export sidecars with variants
features.detail: ZIP export includes existing and newly written XMP beside originals/RAW companions, adjusting names together for collisions; privacy-constrained shared downloads intentionally strip metadata instead.

features.name: Privacy-stripped shared derivatives
features.detail: Thumbnails omit EXIF/XMP but retain colour profiles; restricted sharing serves full-size JPEG or video stream copies without recorded metadata. Old-thumbnail cleanup is available.

features.name: Database-first image rotation
features.detail: Rotate stills in 90-degree steps and regenerate thumbnails; default originals unchanged. Optional sidecar orientation works across formats; original EXIF orientation writes limited to JPEG/PNG/TIFF/WebP.

features.name: Camera RAW preview support
features.detail: Supports RAW indexing/preview, including upload formats browsers mislabel; paired RAWs can be downloaded even when browser zoom remains on preview.

features.name: HEIC/HEIF support
features.detail: Upload/index/preview HEIC and HEIF; HEIC/AVIF display orientation follows container rotation/mirroring rather than blindly trusting EXIF.

features.name: AVIF support
features.detail: Explicit upload support and supported ExifTool metadata-write format; browser presentation uses derived previews where required.

features.name: JPEG XL support
features.detail: README/upload/manual list JXL indexing and uploads; viewer may retain a derived preview and offer original download.

features.name: Animated GIF viewing
features.detail: Viewer always uses the animated GIF original rather than enlarging a static display preview.

features.name: Automatic RAW+JPEG file variants
features.detail: Same-folder/base-name files represent one photo, no toggle; main-file preference JPEG then video then RAW. Repair job merges orphan RAW photos but not already separate Live Photo videos.

features.name: Paired still/video Live Photos
features.detail: Scan groups same-capture still and clip as variants of one photo, with all variants in ZIP downloads.

features.name: Embedded Google/Samsung motion video
features.detail: Extracts embedded JPEG video into protected_media/embedded_media while preserving its embedded copy in original; enabled by default through feature toggle.

features.name: Companions stay attached during file operations
features.detail: Move, rename and ZIP keep RAW/Live variants and both XMP naming conventions paired; extracted motion-video derivatives remain in app storage.

features.name: User albums and covers
features.detail: Create empty or selected-photo albums, upload into them, choose covers and remove membership without deleting originals.

features.name: Many-to-many album collections
features.detail: Private labels such as Travel/Family group an album into several collections; deleting a collection preserves albums/photos. Not a nested filesystem hierarchy.

features.name: Chronological event generation
features.detail: Manual generation chains captures less than 36 hours apart with minimum two photos; people/place affect title, not grouping. Regeneration preserves chosen covers and localized web titles.

features.name: Person albums and private groups
features.detail: Per-person face covers, name merge/delete, private many-to-many people groups and birth date with age-at-capture display; birthdate also constrains recognition suggestions.

features.name: Generated place albums
features.detail: GPS/geocoded location generates place collections; private circular places can override local grouping while keeping provider names.

features.name: AI Things and caption hashtag albums
features.detail: Object/scene classifications form Things albums separate from user tags; caption hashtags remain visible independent of selected tagging model.

features.name: Lock album membership
features.detail: API-enforced lock blocks adding/removing photos including uploads, but not editing/deleting underlying photos, renaming/sharing album or deleting album.

features.name: Rule-based burst stacks
features.detail: EXIF burst/sequence and explicit filename patterns group same-camera frames; default two-second temporal continuity with subsecond times and sequence restarts. Optional proximity/pHash rules are disabled by default.

features.name: Manual stacks and cover selection
features.detail: Group separate captures, merge stacks, pick cover and unstack/break apart while retaining photos; timeline shows cover only and lightbox opens members.

features.name: Automatic exposure-bracket detection
features.detail: Detailed guide explicitly says Bracket is a reserved type not currently created; no bracket detection exists and Create stack always makes Manual, despite broader README wording.

features.name: MD5 exact-copy grouping
features.detail: Detects exact-copy candidates by MD5 file hash, distinct from visual hashes. No separate byte-comparison verification is documented.

features.name: Perceptual duplicate grouping
features.detail: 64-bit DCT pHash/Hamming distance from large thumbnails; strict/normal/loose sensitivity and two-pass BK-tree batches, default 10,000, including cross-batch comparisons.

features.name: Preview duplicate groups
features.detail: Thumbnails and group type/status/savings plus per-photo resolution,size,camera,date,path in review modal.

features.name: Keep selected and trash others
features.detail: Highest-resolution photo is preselected but user can choose another; resolution moves other photos to application trash and can be reverted/restored for resolved groups.

features.name: Dismiss non-duplicate group
features.detail: Not duplicates preserves all photos, unlinks them and marks group dismissed; this action cannot be reverted through UI and dismissal list currently returns no groups despite counts.

features.name: Persist pending/resolved review records
features.detail: Filter pending/resolved/type, delete group records individually/in bulk or clear pending groups before detection. Looser reruns exclude photos already in visual groups, so groups must be cleared to reconsider them.

features.name: Server-local ONNX models
features.detail: InsightFace, OpenCLIP and optional caption/OCR models execute locally; models download on demand or can be prepositioned for offline use.

features.name: Optional NVIDIA ML deployment
features.detail: README documents optional NVIDIA acceleration in separated Docker Compose deployment; no GPU benchmark or universal model acceleration is asserted.

features.name: OpenCLIP content labels
features.detail: Current model produces semantic embedding and tags in one pass; 1.6 caps five Things with class-specific thresholds. Manual retag refresh does not overwrite personal tags/captions.

features.name: Custom zero-shot vocabulary
features.detail: Admin custom_tags.txt adds words or word=description with multiple prompt descriptions separated by |; at most two custom/five total labels, no model retraining, and old photos need retagging.

features.name: Local LFM2.5-VL captions
features.detail: Per-photo suggestion or manually initiated whole-library background generation, preserving manual captions. Optional recognized names/place context defaults on; no automatic whole-library caption job after scan.

features.name: Opt-in local text recognition
features.detail: Admin selects PP-OCRv6 Tiny/Small/Medium and confirms plaintext privacy warning. Extract missing or all text; current versions queue after scan/upload, with three-failure suppression and retry-all override.

features.name: Selectable OCR overlay
features.detail: Own-photo viewer T action overlays recognized text for mouse selection/copy; requires OCR results.

features.name: Screenshot/document categories
features.detail: Screenshots are detected on scan; document inference combines OCR and content labels, so OCR is needed for automatic documents. Manual/bulk category corrections persist across rescans and support undo.

features.name: InsightFace face detection
features.detail: SCRFD finds boxes, merges overlapping imported MWG regions and offers a minimum relative face-size setting; imported regions are retained regardless.

features.name: ArcFace identity matching
features.detail: 512-dimensional ArcFace embeddings with selectable speed/memory model packs and learned classification against manually named people; confidence shown separately from clusters.

features.name: Configurable unknown-face clustering
features.detail: Stable clustering has auto size thresholds, min-samples and merge epsilon; labels split outputs by known person. Upload-triggered training waits for sufficient new faces and user inactivity.

features.name: Name faces and propagate within captures
features.detail: Dashboard/lightbox naming with recent-person shortcuts; clearly matching unnamed faces in bursts/duplicate groups can be labelled together, respecting prior rejections.

features.name: Reject, relabel, merge and restore faces
features.detail: Not-person decisions persist across training and person merge; false detections are soft-deleted/excluded from training and can be restored. Merge people preserves target cover but cannot itself be undone.

features.name: Draw a missed face
features.detail: Draw a box to request enlarged-area detection/encoding or retain manual box if no match/service unavailable; prevents overlapping duplicate regions and requires usable thumbnail.

features.name: Sample video frames for people
features.detail: Up to eight frames from 5%–95%, at most one/second, consolidate matching identities using largest face. Faces retain timestamp for seek-to-person; clips under two seconds use first frame only.

features.name: Interactive photo-location map
features.detail: MapLibre displays actual photo coordinates, viewport-filtered place tiles and click-to-open previews; online PhotoPrism/OSM basemaps or None.

features.name: Photo-count map clustering
features.detail: Photos within about a metre combine at one point; zoomed-out clusters count photos once, not every administrative place name.

features.name: Built-in offline town lookup
features.detail: New-install ExifTool/GeoNames geocoder finds nearest town ≥2000 population within 50 km plus district/region/country; no street/POI and borders can choose a town across a country line.

features.name: Optional online place providers
features.detail: Nominatim or keyed Mapbox/MapTiler/OpenCage/TomTom; Nominatim rate limit shared across workers around one request/sec. Language settings/provider switch only affect new lookups unless rerun.

features.name: Private named circular places
features.detail: Define up to 100 places of 25 m–2 km radius with live photo counts; smaller overlapping circle wins. Names dynamically group photos/search and can title events, but never leave owner via sharing/write-back.

features.name: Per-user ownership and libraries
features.detail: Multiple accounts retain their own photos/faces/ratings/albums; all sharing preserves source ownership. This is not a shared co-owned editable catalogue.

features.name: Album viewer/contributor/owner roles
features.detail: Can view versus Can add photos; contributors remove only their own contributions, owner controls cover/lock/sharing. Contributions leave album when contributor exits or loses contribution rights.

features.name: Contribute own photos to shared albums
features.detail: Links contributors' media without copy/move; recipient details require intersection of owner and contributor switches. Contributor photos are never included on owner's album public link.

features.name: Album-specific comments and likes
features.detail: Members can post plain-text comments up to 1000 chars/like photos, with own edit/delete and owner moderation; per-user 30/minute limit and membership/removal lifecycle.

features.name: Read-only whole-library sharing
features.detail: Share ongoing own photos with another account and independently opt into location/people/camera/captions/originals; recipient may mix them into timeline but cannot edit or add to own albums.

features.name: Approval-gated person sharing
features.detail: Only manually labelled person photos count; existing labels initially approve, later labels await review. Inferred/unknown faces do not auto-share; metadata switches start off and originals are withheld.

features.name: Public albums and revocable single-photo links
features.detail: Album custom/random slugs, replace/revoke single-photo random slugs and distinct Make public raw-image exposure; revoking burns slug instead of reviving old links later.

features.name: Album-link expiry
features.detail: Public album expiry supports exact date/time or 7/30/90-day presets and Never. Expiry is explicitly unavailable for single-photo links.

features.name: Password-protected photo links
features.detail: Guide explicitly says password protection is not available for photo shares yet; album password support is not established either.

features.name: Per-share detail and original controls
features.detail: Public date/location/camera/caption/face-name switches default off. Original public delivery requires all five; otherwise metadata-free copies are served. Whole-library originals independently override embedded privacy expectations.

features.name: Double-opt-in instance gallery
features.detail: Admin enables members-only/everyone and each user independently opts in. Gallery provides timeline/towns/named people/photographers, not private links or contributor photos; search engines default discouraged.

features.name: OpenID Connect sign-in
features.detail: README explicitly supports OpenID Connect SSO; LDAP compatibility is not inferred as native directory integration.

features.name: Interactive documented REST API
features.detail: Swagger/ReDoc plus documented metadata/search/targeted-scan/processing-status/upload/retention endpoints; Basic/JWT authentication described for scripts.

features.name: Administrative management commands
features.detail: Scan selected/all/Nextcloud roots, rebuild index, write metadata with dry-run, rehash, strip derived metadata, back up SQLite and repair upgrade data.

features.name: Trash and restoration
features.detail: Trash marks photos deleted while retaining them; restore reverses it. Permanent/empty-trash deletes originals and derivatives. Auto-delete defaults 0/off and shows per-photo countdown when enabled.

features.name: Destructive and unsaved-edit review
features.detail: Confirm permanent deletion, retention reductions and key destructive actions; unsaved metadata prompts on viewer navigation, page leave and tab close.

features.name: Undo selected catalogue actions
features.detail: Notifications undo favourites/hide/archive/public changes and face operations; timestamps can revert previous value, resolved duplicates restore trashed copies. Not a crash-recovery file journal.

features.name: Default metadata read-only and sidecar mode
features.detail: Scans only read originals and write-back is Off by default; sidecar mode preserves media bytes. Read-only mounted files cannot be permanently deleted, but catalogue edits still work.

features.name: Unmounted/mass-missing protection
features.detail: Missing-file detection checks whole result before changes, refuses apparently unmounted roots or configured excessive missing count and avoids flagging photos after unreadable-subfolder scans.

features.name: Rehash unchanged-timestamp files
features.detail: Check file contents rereads every byte to detect replacements retaining old mtime, then reimports/reindexes changes with appropriate personal-data preservation. It is not documented as bit-rot recovery or copy verification.

features.name: SQLite backup command
features.detail: backup_database keeps newest three by default, configurable, and can guard pending migrations. PostgreSQL needs separate pg_dump; originals/models/secret require their own backup.

features.name: Stage-aware processing queue
features.detail: Progress card covers thumbnails/Things/search/places/faces/OCR/captions, run-missing-stage actions and per-item errors; ordinary user jobs serialize globally while upload processing can run alongside.

features.name: Cooperative job and upload cancellation
features.detail: Jobs stop at checkpoints and clear queued steps; move/rename preserve completed changes. Model/ZIP downloads finish and clustering finishes current rebuild; upload-import jobs cannot cancel.

features.name: Recover interrupted processing
features.detail: After restart previously taken queue work reruns around ten minutes later; failed/cancelled scans do not advance baseline and later jobs fill missing analysis. Stuck checks target lack of progress, not simply duration.

features.name: Browse as thumbnails become ready
features.detail: Scan prioritizes thumbnails; upload progress distinguishes sent/processing/ready and timeline fills without reload while analysis continues.

features.name: Separate preview and model caches
features.detail: Tiny/grid/large/face derivatives, extracted motion clips and persistent similarity/model files; bulk ZIPs auto-expire around one day.

features.name: Targeted rescans and derived-data repair
features.detail: Rescan up to 1000 chosen photos, re-detect selected/folder faces, retry particular stages, rebuild embeddings/geocoding and repair RAW variants/old video previews without indiscriminately clearing manual data.

features.name: Jobs, services, logs and server stats
features.detail: Admin health/start/stop for ML services, job details, log refresh/download and JSON CPU/RAM/GPU/storage/per-user report; job-log removal is distinct from cancellation.

features.name: Local-first sanitized error reports
features.detail: 1.6.0 retains at most 30 reports for 30 days locally, deduplicating repeats; admin may opt into maintainers or own Sentry/GlitchTip. Reports rebuilt from allowlisted fields remove paths/names/URLs/identifiers.

features.name: Configured offline operation
features.detail: Preload model files, use offline ExifTool, hide online maps and disable release checks. OpenCLIP remains required; disabling caption/face features avoids their model downloads.

features.name: Server-local original analysis
features.detail: Local ML and original-folder indexing do not require third-party photo upload; optional online maps, reports and Nextcloud have separate disclosures.

features.name: Archive outside timeline and Memories
features.detail: Archive removes photos from the main timeline and Memories while retaining them in albums, search, people, places, folders and other filtered views; Unarchive returns them. Unlike Hide, archive does not remove photos from all ordinary views. Neither mode changes original files.

features.name: Hide media in a dedicated section
features.detail: Hide removes photos from ordinary timeline, album, people, place, search and folder views; they remain available in Hidden until unhidden. Hiding takes precedence when a photo is also archived. This is visibility control, not encryption, and the guide establishes no separate authentication guarantee for the Hidden section; original files are unchanged.

features.name: Library and processing totals
features.detail: Photo/day/person/face/event/place counts with inferred/labelled/unknown breakdown, plus data-volume usage bar that includes other content on that disk.

features.name: Monthly counts and stay timeline
features.detail: Monthly photo chart and chronological location-stay duration bar; timeline density scrubber also visualizes busy months/years.

features.name: Interactive place hierarchy
features.detail: Country/region/town tree with horizontal/vertical/radial layouts, counts, collapse, pan and zoom.

features.name: Place, Things and people word clouds
features.detail: Top 100 terms sized by frequency, clickable to search their photos.

features.name: Person co-occurrence graph
features.detail: Unweighted edges connect people appearing together in at least one photo, with draggable nodes/zoom; not an inferred social relationship beyond co-occurrence.

features.name: Face-cluster scatter visualization
features.detail: Projected embeddings coloured by identity, hover thumbnails, click-to-photo and per-person highlights assist correction.

features.name: Locally computed annual Rewind
features.detail: 1.6.0 shows per-user busiest day/month and most photographed people/places from Dec 20–Jan 6, computed on own server and admin-disableable.

features.name: Official source-preview camera backup
features.detail: Unreleased app implements album-selected photo/video backup, Wi-Fi/charging conditions, content skip and processing badges. OS background limits apply; not advertised as a released official backup client.

features.name: Official source-preview offline editing
features.detail: Unreleased mobile app mirrors metadata/grid thumbnails and queues favourite/hide/trash/rating/caption/album edits; full originals still need network unless already on device, and resync rebuilds disposable mirror.

features.name: Source-preview local reminders
features.detail: Unreleased mobile app schedules on-this-day notifications locally two weeks ahead without push service; they stop if not reopened/synced within two weeks.

features.name: Source-preview mobile share target
features.detail: Implemented Android development-build share target accepts images from other apps, not Expo Go; iOS share extension explicitly still being finalized.

limitations.text: Official mobile app is unreleased/source-only. Current README summary does not establish store-distributed Android/iOS clients; released UhuruPhotos is a separate integration.
Automatic exposure brackets are not implemented despite broad README wording; only manual/burst stack workflows and file variants are established.

Metadata originals write-back uses ExifTool overwrite_original without backup; turning it off does not undo writes. Generated captions, album/hidden/archive state and title are not written; Nextcloud copies never receive write-back.

Sidecar removals do not erase original embedded metadata and removing the final keyword can expose original keywords again. Hierarchical keywords flatten; XMP PersonInImage/HierarchicalSubject are not rewritten.

OCR stores all recognized text in plaintext and disabling OCR does not erase it or stop search finding it; no delete-OCR button exists. OCR guide says owner-only, while whole-library sharing guide says caption sharing includes recognized text: that privacy-documentation conflict remains unresolved.

Online tiles disclose the approximate photo area, tightly for mini-maps. Offline geocoding is town-level, not an offline basemap; cached-tile claims do not guarantee a usable completely disconnected map.

Granting original downloads exposes all embedded GPS/serial/keywords regardless of displayed-field switches. Already downloaded/shared copies cannot be recalled; collaborative public album links exclude contributor photos.
Single-photo links lack password/expiry; no jointly owned editable shared library exists. Album expiry and read-only library sharing are distinct capabilities.

Visual duplicate detection needs existing pHashes; older libraries require Rescan. Dismissed groups lose members, cannot be reverted and do not appear in the Dismissed filter despite its count. A looser run does not expand existing visual groups.

Changing InsightFace model packs does not re-encode existing faces automatically and can mix incomparable spaces; the guide requires deleting affected faces and rescanning to fully switch. Deleted-face rescan normally skips recorded deleted regions, making this operationally delicate.

Ordinary long-running jobs serialize across all users; bulk caption generation can block other jobs for hours. Transcoding prevents seeking while running and is not supplied to unauthenticated public visitors.

Takeout import does not restore albums, people or favourites; invalid/over-512-KB/ambiguous JSON is skipped. Media corruption repair, GPX track sync, general crop/colour editor and E2EE are not established.

Some inline guides retain stale statements: semantic-order claims differ between Search and Viewing, and older tag-write cautions conflict with versioned EXIF write-back documentation. This profile follows precise current write semantics and makes no guaranteed semantic ordering claim.

gaps: OCR visibility under whole-library sharing and contradictory semantic-order text need source/runtime verification.
Official mobile release unavailable; preview functions deliberately separated.
No public code execution, benchmark, provider service test or private-library inspection performed.

R06.summary: Local cross-platform duplicate-file reviewer with distinct exact-content, fuzzy-name, music-tag and perceptual-picture scan modes and protected keeper selection.
deployment: Windows installer and portable ZIP
macOS desktop application
Linux desktop packages/source
R06.storage_model: Scans user-selected existing folders in place. Picture analysis is cached in a local database; preferences, logs and other user state are stored in platform-specific application directories. Move/copy/delete operate on original files rather than an imported photo library.
R06.privacy_model: Documented workflows analyze local files without a hosted media account or mandatory upload. External applications can be invoked explicitly. The inspected material is not a formal network-privacy audit.
maturity_notes: Frozen master db097a030150b3d4ea9f492b85e7e4e4bcb3f789 is newer than latest manifest release 4.3.1 (2022-07-09).
README requests help maintaining macOS/Linux packaging and keeping documentation current; manuals contain legacy OS/edition terminology.
Release 4.3.1 fixes a serious standard-content false-duplicate bug present since 4.2.0 and recommends upgrading affected versions.

features.name: Selectable translated desktop interface
features.detail: General Interface preferences populate a language selector from supported locales, fall back to English for an unknown preference and require restart after changing language. French translations explicitly cover menus, duplicate-review labels and deletion dialogs; release 4.3.1 also updates Italian translations.

features.name: Windows desktop
features.detail: Release supplies installers and portable ZIPs; 4.3.1 packages require Windows 7 or later.

features.name: Portable Windows distribution
features.detail: ZIP distribution is offered alongside the Windows installer.

features.name: macOS desktop
