features.name: Windows executable
features.detail: README supplies a downloadable Windows .exe with prompted or command-line operation; it is an organization utility, not a desktop gallery viewer.

features.name: macOS executable
features.detail: README documents a downloadable macOS terminal executable and instructs Apple Silicon users to install Rosetta for the x86 build; native ARM64 distribution is not claimed.

features.name: Linux executable
features.detail: README documents a downloadable Linux binary and an AUR package, with interactive prompts or explicit CLI options for headless use.

features.name: Flatten and repair Takeout exports
features.detail: Processes manually merged extracted Takeout folders and assembles photo/video output with reconstructed filesystem modification times.

features.name: Optional year/month organization
features.detail: --divide-to-dates creates year/month structure, including within album outputs; unknown dates go into date-unknown even without date subdivision.

features.name: Move by default or preserve source with copy
features.detail: --copy avoids altering source file placement but needs additional space; default rename/move can leave a partly processed input on failure and does not support cross-drive moves.

features.name: Reconstruct album memberships
features.detail: Groups identical exported instances across year/album folders and merges their album associations before output.

features.name: Space-saving album links
features.detail: Default album strategy creates Windows .lnk shortcuts or Unix symlinks to originals using relative target paths; failed link creation falls back to materializing a file.

features.name: Portable album file copies
features.detail: duplicate-copy materializes files per album, trading substantially more space for portability across systems.

features.name: Export album-membership JSON
features.detail: json strategy puts all media including Archive/Trash in the general output and writes albums-info.json mapping output basenames to album lists; not a full metadata-preservation sidecar.

features.name: Ignore album-only assets
features.detail: nothing mode keeps year-folder photos without albums; documentation explicitly warns this omits Archive/Trash assets outside year folders.

features.name: Restore filesystem modification dates
features.detail: Priority is Google JSON, embedded EXIF, optional filename guess, then aggressive JSON matching. --fix recursively applies dates to an arbitrary photo/video folder without running Takeout organization.

features.name: Handle Takeout sidecar naming anomalies
features.detail: Matches photoTakenTime JSON through direct names, Google truncation, moved bracket suffixes, known edited suffixes and extension removal; last-resort aggressive suffix/digit removal is explicitly described as potentially dangerous in the pipeline.

features.name: Fallback to embedded image dates
features.detail: Within the size limit reads Image DateTime, then DateTimeOriginal, then DateTimeDigitized, normalizing separators; skips non-images and files above 64 MiB.

features.name: Size and SHA-256 grouping with size caveat
features.detail: Groups candidates by size and hashes equal-size groups with SHA-256; cached in memory. Critically, files larger than 64 MiB receive the same constant digest instead of content hashing, so exactness does not hold for those assets.

features.name: Collapse duplicate export instances
features.detail: Drops repeated candidates within each album/year set, then merges album representations by size/hash; selects the best date-extraction accuracy when merging. Subject to the oversized-file digest limitation.

features.name: Filter Google-generated extra images
features.detail: --skip-extras removes recognized edited/effects/smile/mix suffix variants in several languages, with Unicode normalization for macOS names.

features.name: Disambiguate output filename collisions
features.detail: Repeatedly appends (1) before the extension until the output path is free; same helper protects link destinations. Separate startup logic may offer cleaning a pre-existing output directory.

features.name: Prompted or scripted operation
features.detail: Interactive mode prompts for folders/date division/album strategy; explicit input/output/album switches support headless NAS use and automation, with --help argument documentation.

features.name: Write Takeout JSON back to EXIF
features.detail: README TODO explicitly lists JSON-to-EXIF writing as unimplemented in Dart; suggested ExifTool command is an external follow-up, not a built-in function.

features.name: Restore JSON GPS into EXIF
features.detail: README notes GPS transfer existed in older implementation but is missing in the Dart version.

features.name: Interactive Takeout ZIP extraction
features.detail: Current README and commented-out CLI blocks explicitly disable interactive unzipping; users must unzip and merge beforehand despite stale help text suggesting auto-extraction.

features.name: Local export processing
features.detail: Documented processing takes local input/output folders and operates on those files, without an upload step; downloading the initial Takeout remains external.

limitations.text: Files above 64 MiB have a constant digest rather than a content hash. Equal-size distinct large assets can be treated as identical by grouping; do not assume safe exact deduplication for large videos/photos.
Default moves alter the input and cross-drive moves fail; README recommends retaining original ZIPs and re-extracting after failure.
Windows output dates before 1970 are clamped to 1970-01-01. Undated output gets current modification time and a date-unknown folder.
Album links are not guaranteed portable across systems; source notes non-ASCII shortcut issues, with fallback materialization. nothing album mode omits Archive/Trash.
Filesystem date repair is not embedded metadata writing; current Dart EXIF/GPS write features remain TODO.
No persistent resume journal, file-content copy verification, full metadata round-trip or general gallery interface was established.

gaps: Documentation is concentrated in README and inline CLI help, so source files provide the detailed evidence.
Large-file hashing limitation is source-derived, not runtime-tested.
No gallery, AI recognition or map features are established.

R14.summary: Android gallery and detailed metadata explorer with strong geospatial browsing, media-format inspection and Android/TV integration.
deployment: Android and Android TV
Play, Izzy and Libre flavors through GitHub and their respective stores
R14.storage_model: Manages local device media with Android media permissions. Catalogue scanning derives media classifications. Vault items are app-private and can be lost when application data is cleared or the application uninstalled; a vault lock is not evidence of encryption.
R14.privacy_model: Policy says the developer does not receive personal photos/videos. Optional consent-based installed-app inspection improves album display; Play flavor offers optional Firebase Crashlytics. Internet access is used for maps and reverse geocoding. Libre excludes Google Maps and Crashlytics.
maturity_notes: Pinned develop commit 17a25dae9837d5a27d328b9c7d12b2a0f76b4c26; latest release v1.15.9 dated 2026-11-05.
Unreleased credential-section changes are separated from released C2PA display; v1.15.9 removes BMP export and v1.14.7 removes the dead OSM Liberty map layer.

features.name: Android/TV gallery
features.detail: Native Android application built with Flutter, including Android TV integration and media read/write permissions.

features.name: Local device media access
features.detail: Accesses/manages existing local photos/videos; Android 11+ uses MediaStore preferentially and requires Media Management permission for edits.

features.name: Calendar collection layout
features.detail: v1.15.4 adds calendar layout and a collection layout bar; later versions support Persian and Hijri calendars.

features.name: Photo spheres and 360 video
features.detail: Catalogues panoramas/photo spheres and 360-degree videos; released changelog also adds panorama audio playback.

features.name: Configurable video player
features.detail: Supports videos including older AVI; UI exposes autoplay, looping, resumption, background playback and picture-in-picture, plus seek/play gestures and brightness/volume swipes.

features.name: Slow-motion range control
features.detail: v1.14.6 adds detection/filtering of slow-motion clips and range control in the player.

features.name: Configurable slideshow
features.detail: UI settings include repeat, shuffle, fill-screen, animated zoom, transition, interval and video-playback behavior.

features.name: Customizable touch controls
features.detail: Reorder browsing/selection quick actions; long-press tag quick action supports applying multiple tags; video gestures are separately configurable.

features.name: Date ordering
features.detail: Date sorting is exposed; changelog specifically addresses mixed files with/without metadata dates.

features.name: Name and path ordering
features.detail: Sort options include name, path and album plus item title.

features.name: Size ordering
features.detail: Sort-by-size is an explicit user-interface option.

features.name: Duration ordering
features.detail: Sort-by-duration is an explicit option, separate from video playback controls.

features.name: Random collection order
features.detail: Random sorting is added in v1.15.9.

features.name: Metadata and missing-value facets
features.detail: Search includes metadata, dates and formats; filters identify undated, untitled, untagged, unrated and unlocated media, favorites and rejected ratings.

features.name: Country/state/place browsing
features.detail: Search facets cover countries, states, places and coordinates. Recent releases add state-level Brazil/Canada display and coordinate-center copying.

features.name: Tag and group navigation
features.detail: Tags are searchable/navigable; tag/group renaming is documented and album/country/tag text filters accept slash-wrapped regular expressions.

features.name: Rating filters
features.detail: Search contains ratings including unrated/rejected states; sorting by rating is also offered.

features.name: Special-media classification
features.detail: Filters distinguish images/videos, RAW, animations, Motion Photos, panoramas, slow motion, 360 video and GeoTIFF.

features.name: C2PA content credentials
features.detail: v1.15.9 displays credentials, overlays validity icons and filters unknown/invalid/valid/trusted states; removal of JPEG JUMBF credential metadata is supported.

features.name: Detailed embedded metadata explorer
features.detail: Info displays embedded metadata including distinct Exif SubIFD sections; changelog notes handling large GIF XMP and metadata capture dates.

features.name: Editable tags and groups
features.detail: Tag editing offers recent tags and country/state/place placeholders; tags and groups can be renamed directly.

features.name: Editable ratings
features.detail: Info offers a rating editor and collection badges; precise embedding formats are not established by the strings.

features.name: Favorites
features.detail: Add/remove favorites actions and favorite filtering are exposed.

features.name: Title and description editing
features.detail: Info provides Edit title & description; this establishes the edit affordance, not universal file-format write compatibility.

features.name: Capture date correction
features.detail: Set a custom date, shift timestamps, extract from filenames or copy another date field; v1.15.0 explicitly saves assigned undated-item dates to metadata.

features.name: Location editing
features.detail: Editor offers latitude/longitude, map selection, custom coordinates and removal of location.

features.name: GPX-based geotagging
features.detail: Location editor includes Import GPX and time-shift controls for associating locations with timestamps.

features.name: Selective metadata removal
features.detail: Removal actions include all metadata or selected categories/location/JUMBF. UI warns removing Motion Photo XMP can prevent embedded video playback.

features.name: Export metadata
features.detail: Info exposes an Export metadata action; the exact serialization and sidecar interoperability are not established here.

features.name: Optional metadata on conversion
features.detail: Export dialog offers Write metadata along with format, dimension and quality controls.

features.name: Pattern-based rename
features.detail: Multi-item rename offers a naming pattern, inserted counter/hash/name fields and a preview.

features.name: Local file relocation
features.detail: Changelog documents moving files from app-media directories and rename/move handling on SD cards; these are ordinary file operations, not a catalogue-only action.

features.name: SVG display
features.detail: README explicitly supports SVG and v1.15.9 improves malformed SVG rendering.

features.name: Multipage TIFF
features.detail: README specifically identifies multipage TIFF as supported media.

features.name: Motion Photo inspection/actions
features.detail: Detects Motion Photos and exposes still conversion, separate video opening and image-only/video-only sharing; rotation attempts to rotate the video component too.

features.name: GeoTIFF overlay
features.detail: Detects GeoTIFF and exposes Show as map overlay rather than merely treating georeferenced TIFF as an ordinary thumbnail.

features.name: Burst pattern handling
features.detail: Collection has configurable burst patterns; v1.15.6 adds Realme pattern recognition.

features.name: Rotation and flip
features.detail: Clockwise/counterclockwise rotation and horizontal flip are explicit actions.

features.name: Image conversion
features.detail: Convert/export exposes format, quality and width/height controls; v1.15.9 supports a single target dimension across mixed aspect ratios and removes BMP output.

features.name: Export dimension control
features.detail: Export controls width/height and supports mixed-aspect-ratio conversions by one target dimension.

features.name: Map browsing
features.detail: Maps integrate with album/tag/location navigation. Google Maps depends on Google Mobile Services and is excluded from Libre; base-layer options include Humanitarian OSM and Stamen Watercolor.

features.name: Network reverse geocoding
features.detail: README explicitly attributes INTERNET permission to map viewing and reverse geocoding; offline geocoding is not claimed.

features.name: Map paths
features.detail: v1.14.6 adds showing paths on the map; the changelog does not specify every track-import format for this overlay.

features.name: Recycle bin and restore
features.detail: UI confirms moving items to the recycle bin and offers Restore; changelog addresses recovery when the original directory is inaccessible. It is not treated as a durable operation journal.

features.name: Locked app-private vaults
features.detail: Vaults support pattern/PIN/password and biometric unlock, with optional lock when the screen turns off. Warning states app uninstall/data-clear loses vault items; encryption at rest is not established by these sources.

features.name: Local photo management
features.detail: Terms describe management of local media and state the developer never accesses photos/videos; map and opt-in diagnostics traffic are separate exceptions.

features.name: Opt-in crash diagnostics
features.detail: Play version can send anonymous error/diagnostic data to Firebase Crashlytics with consent; Izzy and Libre omit this capability.

features.name: Automatic settings export
features.detail: v1.14.6 introduces automatic settings export; subsequent releases improve export failure feedback and storage-access handling.

features.name: Geographic and tag statistics
features.detail: Stats show geolocated-item count and top countries, states, places, tags and albums.

features.name: Android launcher, viewer and search integration
features.detail: Provides launcher shortcuts and global search handling and can act as a media viewer for other Android apps; widget, picker and screensaver capabilities are recorded separately.

features.name: Android home-screen widgets
features.detail: README explicitly lists widgets among Aves' Android integrations. Widget layout, refresh frequency and parity across Android/Android TV are not specified by this source.

features.name: Android media picker
features.detail: README explicitly says Aves can serve as a media picker for Android applications, independently of opening media as a viewer; no cloud-provider or document-picker scope is inferred.

features.name: Android screensaver integration
features.detail: README lists a screen saver among the application's Android integrations, alongside Android TV support. This establishes a screensaver function, not desktop wallpaper scheduling or a separate casting protocol.

features.name: Clipboard and external application actions
features.detail: UI actions include copy to clipboard, open-with, set-as and opening coordinates in a map app; sharing and printing are recorded separately.

features.name: Share media to other apps
features.detail: Android viewer exposes Share plus image-only and video-only sharing actions for supported compound media. These are app sharing affordances, not hosted public links or automatic publication to a social network.

features.name: Print media action
features.detail: The Android media-action strings explicitly include Print. Printer compatibility, print-layout controls and platform-specific print-service behavior were not established by the inspected source.

limitations.text: Vault media is lost if app data is cleared or the app uninstalled. No encryption guarantee follows merely from biometric/PIN access controls.
Google Maps requires Google Mobile Services and is unavailable in Libre; online map/geocoding access remains distinct from local gallery privacy.
BMP conversion and OSM Liberty map layer were removed in documented releases.
Exact/perceptual duplicates, face recognition, cloud backup, multi-user sharing and universal RAW decoding/write-format coverage are not established in the inspected sources.

gaps: No broad standalone end-user manual found; current interface text supplies medium-confidence detail where implementation was not traced.
Historical changelog outside the cited recent range was not exhaustively read; no unsupported legacy feature claims are imported.

R15.summary: Cross-platform disk-space analyzer and safety-oriented cleaner; relevant to photo libraries chiefly for exact duplicate and large-file cleanup, not visual photo organization.
deployment: macOS 12.5+ desktop
64-bit Windows 10+ desktop
Linux .deb and AppImage, Ubuntu 22.04+ recommended, x64/ARM64
CLI packages for macOS/Windows; Linux CLI built from source
R15.storage_model: Analyzes existing filesystem roots and retains bounded scan/session indexes, local settings and operation history. Duplicate results use logical file length plus physical-allocation accounting. Cleanup directly deletes selected files; this is not a managed photo library.
R15.privacy_model: Core filesystem scanning is local and read-only until confirmed actions. Optional AI explanations send allowlisted metadata including full paths to an official or custom provider, not file contents. Official AI context/replies are retained for 30 days; custom-provider credentials are stored in plaintext local JSON. This is not a blanket offline/no-telemetry or encryption claim.
maturity_notes: Frozen main commit a512f290d63ff7863993b0cb999492070eaefb3b; release v1.2.3 dated 2026-11-06.
README's safety, speed and optimization assertions are project claims, not validation or benchmarks performed for this inventory.
Platform-specific cleanup and system tools vary; Linux standalone prebuilt CLI is explicitly not yet available.

features.name: Eleven offline UI locales
features.detail: Runtime registers English, Simplified/Traditional Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Russian, Turkish, Brazilian Portuguese, French, German and Spanish. Bundled message graph permits offline view-language switching; English is fallback and French/Russian have explicit plural rules.

features.name: Windows desktop
features.detail: Native Windows installer for 64-bit Windows 10+; WinGet and official download are documented.

features.name: macOS desktop
features.detail: DMG and Homebrew Cask distribution for macOS Monterey 12.5 or later.

features.name: Linux desktop
features.detail: x64/ARM64 .deb and AppImage distributions; Ubuntu 22.04+ recommended and other distro compatibility depends on libraries/desktop.

features.name: Scriptable cleanup CLI
features.detail: Shared cleanup engine offers scan-only default, --apply, selection policy, --dry-run, JSON output and --no-progress; non-interactive mutation additionally requires --yes.

features.name: Rule-based deep cleanup
features.detail: Scans system/user temporary data, application caches/logs/update packages, browser caches, package managers, IDE/compiler/Xcode data and inactive container build caches.

features.name: Rebuildable development-project cleanup
features.detail: Finds dependencies, caches and build directories across Node.js, Rust, Gradle, Swift, Python, .NET, Godot and CMake projects.

features.name: Local model and download cache discovery
features.detail: Surfaces large local AI models, cached downloads and temporary transfers as reclaimable-space candidates, not as photo-analysis models.

features.name: Large-file discovery
features.detail: Finds large installers, video files, archives and other bulky content for review without implying video playback or perceptual-video matching.

features.name: Content-hash duplicate detection
features.detail: Groups equal-size files by BLAKE3 content hash after sample filtering. Sample hashes alone do not establish equality; full hashing checks open-file identity/size/time and current path.

features.name: Aggregate duplicate directory trees
features.detail: Builds recursive fingerprints from file sizes/content hashes and child-tree fingerprints, sorting tokens without incorporating filenames. Skips empty trees, unreadable/unknown entries and link-like objects; this is content/tree equivalence, not identical names.

features.name: Selectable smart keeper rules
features.detail: Prefer shortest path by default, shortest filename, oldest modification or newest modification; deterministic tie-breaks handle equal/missing times. Protected copies become keepers automatically.

features.name: Protected reference roots
features.detail: Protected locations participate in matching but cannot be deleted. Directories containing protected descendants are also rejected; protection changes deletion authority, not scan coverage.

features.name: Duplicate scan exclusions
features.detail: Public product scan entry accepts exclusion options alongside typed cleanable/protected roots.

features.name: Minimum duplicate file size
features.detail: Duplicate scan APIs accept minimum_bytes to limit eligible files; no maximum-size selector is established here.

features.name: Clear a group's deletion selection
features.detail: Toggling an already-selected smart-selection group clears its paths while retaining selections in other groups.

features.name: Deleting every duplicate copy is rejected
features.detail: Both selection utilities and native validation require at least one remaining entry in every affected duplicate group.

features.name: Analyze multiple selected roots
features.detail: Duplicate scan takes a vector of filesystem roots, including separately protected descendants; this is scan scope rather than multiple photo catalogues.

features.name: Paged duplicate results
features.detail: Complete bounded duplicate results remain in Rust; only an initial page enters the WebView and later pages load on demand using a scan ID.

features.name: Storage-aware duplicate hashing
features.detail: Concurrency depends on available CPUs and volume scheduling; rotational, removable, network and unknown storage use one hashing worker to limit random-I/O costs.

features.name: Cooperative scan cancellation
features.detail: Hashing checks cancellation between reads/samples and recursive directory fingerprinting checks its operation guard; disk analysis also documents cancellation.

features.name: Treemap and sunburst disk analysis
features.detail: Switch visualization and depth while browsing folder/file lists; Standard measures physical allocated bytes, while Windows Fast uses logical lengths.

features.name: Explicit incomplete-scan reporting
features.detail: Reports omissions by permissions, read errors, exclusions, link/mount boundaries and unknown causes; unreadable is distinguished from measured empty directories.

features.name: Snapshot JSON/Markdown reports
features.detail: Exports current-directory analysis with depth 1–6, optional full paths, configurable entry limits and separate remainder/omission accounting; never silently rescans. Reports are evidence, not importable state or deletion authority.

features.name: Read-only scan phase
features.detail: Default scans do not modify files. Cleanup, uninstall and system changes require explicit review/confirmation; this is not an immutable library mode once actions are approved.

features.name: Review and native deletion preflight
features.detail: Native duplicate deletion verifies current-scan membership, expected size/modification and protected roots independently of UI selection; stale/foreign candidates are rejected.

features.name: Cleanup and change history
features.detail: Records completed cleanup/system changes, reclaimed space and failures. Duplicate deletion appends history after execution; this is not an undo-capable transactional operation journal.

features.name: Explicit permanent cleanup
features.detail: Duplicate and disk-analysis deletion directly remove selected files, report removed/already-absent/failed outcomes and reconcile scan caches. Analysis stops a batch on possible partial mutation or lost authority.

features.name: Atomic report publication
features.detail: Analysis export flushes and syncs a sibling temporary file before atomic publication; failed writes preserve the previous report destination. This is report safety, not copied-photo verification.

features.name: Browser and system trace cleanup
features.detail: Clears selected browsing history, searches, cookies, recent items and clipboard traces; this is an OS/application administration tool, not photo-metadata privacy or secure disk erasure.

features.name: Shrink supported application installations
features.detail: Deep Cleanup overview documents application optimization to reduce supported application size without affecting normal use; exact eligible apps and transformations are not specified there. This is not photo compression.

features.name: Uninstall applications and remnants
features.detail: Uninstalls applications and reviews associated caches/settings/leftovers, treating potential personal files cautiously. AI manual warns vendor uninstallers control their own final scope.

features.name: Disable and re-enable startup entries
features.detail: Manage startup registrations to reduce login/background load, with ability to turn entries back on.

features.name: Built-in system settings optimization
features.detail: Only built-in validated settings are accepted; no arbitrary commands/scripts/registry paths. Values are reread after changes and high-impact, elevated or restart-required actions are flagged.

features.name: Common system repair actions
features.detail: Documented maintenance targets missing search results, incorrect icons, sound and network issues; available operations depend on platform.

features.name: Windows Explorer menu management
features.detail: Since 1.2.3, browse by app/menu location, disable/restore/remove entries, configure file types, switch supported Windows 11/classic styles and optionally restart Explorer.

features.name: Windows file-oriented menu actions
features.detail: Add copy-path/name/image-dimensions, terminal-here, desktop shortcuts and system-tool shortcuts.

features.name: Live resource and hardware metrics
features.detail: CPU/GPU/memory/network/disk trends; supported devices also expose temperature, power, battery and disk-health information, with menu/taskbar/tray/floating displays. These are whole-computer metrics, not photo-library analytics.

features.name: Resource-heavy app and memory management
features.detail: Find and quit resource-heavy applications and free memory manually or automatically; performance improvements are project claims.

features.name: Optional item-level AI explanations
features.detail: Explains cleanup, privacy, startup, settings, maintenance, large/duplicate files and uninstall candidates on explicit request. Does not select items, change risk classification, execute commands or authorize cleanup.

features.name: Official or custom explanation provider
features.detail: Official builds offer a daily free quota; custom OpenAI-compatible endpoints can include local loopback services. Official initial policy is 20/day with 60-second cooldown and 30-day context/reply retention; provider settings and billing remain separate.

features.name: Retain tool results during navigation
features.detail: 1.2.3 scans uninstall/startup/privacy pages on first opening and preserves results, scroll position and category choices on page switches.

limitations.text: Cleanup, permanent deletion and uninstall may not be reversible; keep independent backups. Operation History is not proof of undo or OS-trash recovery.
Exact equality does not prove different application paths are interchangeable. AI explanations are advisory and cannot authorize deletion.

AI metadata can include full paths and installation identity; official service retains context/replies 30 days. Custom credentials are plaintext in local ai.json, and custom HTTP endpoints do not encrypt keys or requests.

Reports use retained scan data with limits and omission accounting, not an unrestricted fresh filesystem inventory. Windows Fast reports logical bytes, which can differ substantially from actual sparse/compressed disk usage.
Source inspection establishes hash matching, not byte-by-byte pair verification, perceptual image/video matching, hardlink replacement or a photo-viewing catalogue.
Linux prebuilt standalone CLI is not yet provided; build from source is documented.

gaps: No photo-specific EXIF/face/map/editor features established; scope is filesystem/system management.
No independent performance or safety validation performed and no public code executed.

R16.summary: Cloudflare Pages file host with Telegram or optional R2 storage, public upload links and an optional KV-backed administration interface; not a private local photo catalogue.
deployment: Cloudflare Pages with file-based Functions
Git-connected or Wrangler Pages deployment
Browser upload and optional administration UI
R16.storage_model: Default uploads are sent through a Telegram bot to a channel. Optional R2 stores new uploads in a bound bucket. Optional Cloudflare KV holds file metadata, moderation decisions and short-link mappings. Provider-specific IDs keep existing links readable after changing providers.
R16.privacy_model: Cloudflare handles requests and Telegram normally stores file content; R2 and Workers AI are optional Cloudflare services. Upload and dashboard authentication are disabled unless configured. Remote telemetry is opt-out. Dashboard libraries load from jsDelivr. No end-to-end encryption claim is established.
maturity_notes: Frozen main commit ef69018df1967708ec026a671e3976f5524ff490; manifest has no release.
Original Telegraph upload API is closed: deployments must configure Telegram or R2 instead.
The July 2026 README includes substantial storage, moderation, upload and interface changes; older Telegraph deployment guides are not equivalent.

features.name: Browser upload interface
features.detail: Cloudflare Pages serves the upload homepage; current homepage is dependency-free, while the older Nuxt page remains separately accessible.

features.name: Cloudflare Pages hosting
features.detail: Deploy through Git integration or Wrangler Pages; a free pages.dev hostname and custom domains are documented. This is a Pages Functions project, not a directly deployable Worker entry point.

features.name: Batch drag-and-drop and clipboard uploads
features.detail: Upload multiple files by selection, drag-and-drop or paste, with per-file progress.

features.name: Public uploads by default
features.detail: Anonymous uploads remain enabled unless both upload Basic Auth variables are configured.

features.name: Separate upload authentication
features.detail: UPLOAD_BASIC_USER and UPLOAD_BASIC_PASS protect both browser and multipart API uploads independently of dashboard credentials.

features.name: Direct file links and embed formats
features.detail: Upload returns a /file path; interface copies URL, Markdown, BBCode or HTML links.

features.name: Persistent configurable short links
features.detail: KV plus ENABLE_SHORT_URLS allocates short IDs of 4–16 characters, default six. Old long URLs continue to resolve.

features.name: Telegram channel storage
features.detail: A bot token and channel/chat ID route uploads into a channel where the bot is an administrator; source files reside on Telegram.

features.name: Alternative Cloudflare R2 storage
features.detail: An img_r2 bucket and STORAGE_PROVIDER=r2 redirect new uploads to R2. Self-describing provider IDs preserve access to old Telegram and R2 files across switches.

features.name: Multipart upload API
features.detail: POST /upload accepts multipart file and returns a JSON array containing src. It works with configurable upload clients such as PicGo.

features.name: Browser-native media and PDF previews
features.detail: Images, video, audio and PDF are served for inline browser opening rather than forced download; browser format support still applies.

features.name: Administrative grid and waterfall views
features.detail: Binding img_url KV enables dashboard grid/waterfall layouts, online image preview and batch record selection.

features.name: Administrative preview zoom and rotation
features.detail: Dashboard preview allows zooming in/out and viewer rotation; documentation does not establish rewriting the original image.

features.name: Cursor-paginated dashboard
features.detail: KV listing supports cursor/load-more and a limit defaulting to 100 and capped at 1000; internal short-link/cache keys are excluded from returned file keys.

features.name: Dashboard prefix search
features.detail: README describes server-side filename-prefix search; list endpoint passes the supplied prefix to KV rather than providing full-text catalogue search.

features.name: Dashboard rename
features.detail: Administration supports renaming listed files; July 2026 notes record a fix to this workflow. Physical Telegram object renaming is not established.

features.name: Recorded file total
features.detail: KV-backed administration displays total recorded images and each item's list/moderation state.

features.name: Optional administrative authentication
features.detail: BASIC_USER and BASIC_PASS enable dashboard login. Cloudflare Access is an alternative, with both /admin and /api/manage/* requiring protection.

features.name: File allow/block lists
features.detail: KV records can be blacklisted to block loading or whitelisted to bypass moderation; whitelist-only mode requires approval before serving.

features.name: Referer allowlist
features.detail: ALLOWED_REFERERS accepts exact and wildcard-subdomain hosts. Other referring sites receive 403, but absent referers and the host's own domain remain allowed; this is not private-link authentication.

features.name: Workers AI image review
features.detail: AI binding plus KV enables remote vision moderation; verdicts are cached per file. Adult-content classifications redirect to a block page. Review failures are explicitly fail-open.

features.name: Moderation model discovery and fallback
features.detail: Override the vision model or use a built-in fallback chain. Optional Cloudflare account credentials discover active vision models, exclude retired ones and cache the catalogue for six hours.

features.name: Legacy ModerateContent integration
features.detail: Existing ModerateContent keys remain usable only for old Telegraph-hosted files; new registrations are closed and Telegram Bot API files cannot be reviewed by this provider.

features.name: Deployment self-check
features.detail: Homepage identifies missing environment variables or bindings and tells operators where to configure them before the first upload.

features.name: Record-only administrative deletion
features.detail: Delete removes the dashboard record, not the Telegram/Telegraph original; later access can recreate a record. Blocking access uses the blacklist instead.

features.name: Telemetry opt-out
features.detail: disable_telemetry disables documented remote telemetry; file-serving middleware and upload handler otherwise call telemetry functions.

features.name: Environment-driven site customization
features.detail: Configure site/header name, title, background and hiding the dashboard entry via GET /api/config; hiding the entry does not make /admin inaccessible.

features.name: Optional fork auto-updates
features.detail: An enabled GitHub Actions upstream-sync workflow updates the fork hourly, after which connected Pages deployment can rebuild.

limitations.text: Focused interface-localization review found no explicit translated-UI capability in inspected primary feature/configuration documentation. English/Chinese README editions are not evidence of a language-switchable application; localization remains undocumented here.

Telegram uploads may accept approximately 50 MB, but Bot API getFile can serve only up to 20 MB: 20 MB is the documented practical file limit. Roughly 20 messages/minute/channel also constrains throughput. R2 avoids these Telegram limits, not all service quotas.

README's unlimited-image claim is qualified by Cloudflare request/KV/R2/AI quotas. It quotes 100,000 free Function requests/day, KV 1,000 writes/deletes/lists and 100,000 reads/day; these are project-documented quotas, not independently verified current pricing.
Dashboard login and upload protection default off. Record deletion is not erasure of hosted content. Moderation is fail-open and referer protection allows clients without a referer.
Environment/binding changes require redeployment. The dashboard can render blank when jsDelivr is unreachable. Regional Cloudflare performance is not guaranteed.
No inspected evidence establishes EXIF catalogue search, albums/people recognition, duplicate detection, local offline operation, encrypted storage or recoverable file-deletion history.

gaps: No standalone manual or release exists in the frozen manifest; comprehensive README feature/configuration/update sections and source were inspected.
No evidence for local-catalogue, deduplication, EXIF-management or encrypted-vault capabilities.

R17.summary: Discontinued open-source multi-user image host with configurable storage strategies, role-based upload policies, watermarking and an upload/management API. Commercial Lsky Pro+ is a separate edition.
deployment: Self-hosted PHP >=8.0.2 application with Imagick and required PHP extensions
MySQL 5.7+, PostgreSQL 9.6+, SQLite 3.8.8+ or SQL Server 2017+ per README
R17.storage_model: Managed upload objects on a configured storage strategy; database records track owner, album, paths, dimensions, hashes and upload IP. Within one strategy, matching MD5 and SHA-1 reuse the physical object while creating a new record. Processing may rewrite uploads before hashes are computed.
R17.privacy_model: Can use local storage or optional external cloud/network backends. Optional Alibaba/Tencent moderation sends images to providers; NSFW.js uses a configured service endpoint. Public links and original-protection settings are not E2EE; uploads record IP addresses.
maturity_notes: Pinned master 38d52c4609eb85236b45ac75acac2ced55174953 explicitly says open-source maintenance, new features and bug fixes have stopped.
Latest manifest release is 2.1 (2022-08-17); README warns master can include experimental/unreleased features.
Current docs.lsky.pro explicitly documents paid Pro+ 2.x; its commerce features are not attributed to this open-source repository.

features.name: Browser upload and administration interface
features.detail: The self-hosted PHP application exposes browser image upload, waterfall management and administrative role/storage settings; this is the discontinued open-source web interface, not a native desktop client or the separate paid Pro+ edition.

features.name: Self-hosted image hosting
features.detail: Browser upload/management application deployed on a PHP/Imagick server, not a local photo catalogue.

features.name: Multiple relational database engines
features.detail: README lists MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQLite and SQL Server with explicit minimum versions.

features.name: Cloud/object storage strategies
features.detail: Strategies support AWS S3, Alibaba OSS, Tencent COS, Qiniu, Upyun and Minio in addition to local files.

features.name: WebDAV storage backend
features.detail: WebDAV is explicitly a storage strategy, alongside FTP and SFTP; no automatic desktop-library sync is implied.

features.name: FTP storage strategy
features.detail: README explicitly lists FTP as a configurable remote storage backend; this is storage integration, not source-folder library synchronization.

features.name: SFTP storage strategy
features.detail: README explicitly lists SFTP as a configurable remote storage backend; release 2.1 updates its driver extension.

features.name: Managed image-upload inputs
features.detail: Drag-and-drop and pasted images enter managed storage, with dynamic selection of a storage strategy allowed for the uploader's group.

features.name: Upload multiple images
features.detail: README explicitly lists multi-image upload; role-group configuration additionally exposes a concurrent-upload limit.

features.name: Configurable guest uploads
features.detail: Ingestion checks a global allow-guest setting, assigns the guest role group and applies guest upload limits by IP.

features.name: Registered user accounts
features.detail: Upload checks user status, optional verified email, per-user capacity and default album/visibility settings.

features.name: Many-to-many groups and storage strategies
features.detail: Each role group can access multiple strategies, and each strategy can serve multiple groups; per-group policies control upload behavior.

features.name: Per-file and concurrent-upload restrictions
features.detail: Role group sets permitted extensions, maximum individual file size in KB and concurrent upload count; ingestion rejects unsupported extensions or oversized files. Total account capacity is a separate control.

features.name: Enforced per-account storage capacity
features.detail: Before accepting an authenticated user's upload, ImageService adds its size in KB to the sum of that user's existing image-record sizes and rejects the upload if the result exceeds the user's capacity. This establishes account-level recorded-storage accounting, not a physical-backend free-space measurement.

features.name: Multi-window upload limits
features.detail: Configurable minute/hour/day/week/month counts apply to a logged-in user or anonymous uploader IP, based on recent image records.

features.name: Rule-driven object names and folders
features.detail: Naming rules combine year/month/day, timestamp, unique/random tokens, original filename and user ID (zero for guests). These are upload-path rules, not capture-date organization.

features.name: Waterfall image manager
features.detail: README describes waterfall display, context menu, single/multiple selection and rename operations.

features.name: Managed user albums
features.detail: API lists/deletes albums and ingestion can assign a valid user-configured default album; no nested/smart album semantics are established.

features.name: Image square and image visibility
features.detail: README lists a public image square; ingestion defaults to private and honors a registered user's default image permission.

features.name: Copy generated image links
features.detail: Upload UI offers copying and one-click link copying; API returns computed links and storage paths.

features.name: Proxy-mediated original protection
features.detail: Group can enable original protection, withholding direct links and serving processed/cached responses through PHP with configurable image cache lifetime; not encryption.

features.name: Detailed text/image watermarks
features.detail: Supports text or image, tiled positioning, offsets and rotation; text has font/color/size and image has dimensions/opacity. Modes either overwrite stored image or generate dynamically.

features.name: Group-level upload conversion
features.detail: Role group selects saved format and quality; store applies processing before hashing, excluding ICO/GIF/SVG from this conversion path.

features.name: Reuse identical stored content
features.detail: Within a storage strategy, ingestion matches both MD5 and SHA-1 of post-processed upload bytes; matching content reuses path/name and creates only a new database record. No byte verification or visual similarity is claimed.

features.name: Optional image-content moderation
features.detail: Group selects Tencent, Alibaba or configured NSFW.js service; can flag unhealthy or delete/reject. NSFW.js threshold is configurable; PSD/ICO/TIF/SVG skip the examined scan path.

features.name: Generated thumbnails and processed cache
features.detail: Ingestion creates thumbnails; original protection/dynamic watermarking uses cached processed images with configurable TTL and explicit cache clearing.

features.name: Selectable cache drivers
features.detail: README lists file cache by default plus configurable Memcached, Redis, DynamoDB and relational database alternatives.

features.name: Versioned token upload and management API
features.detail: API v1 exposes upload, storage strategies and token issuance; authenticated routes list/delete images and albums, revoke tokens and fetch profile. Feature can be globally enabled/disabled.

features.name: Paginated image API
features.detail: Authenticated image listing uses pages of 40 and returns dimensions, MIME, extensions, sizes, hashes, timestamps and link fields.

features.name: Provider image URL parameters
features.detail: 2.1 adds per-strategy image URL parameters; docs recommend provider-side transformation rules for third-party storage to avoid heavy PHP processing.

features.name: Online incremental and cross-version updates
features.detail: README lists both upgrade modes as implemented; this is historical functionality and does not imply continued upstream updates.

features.name: Commercial Pro+ hosting business tools
features.detail: Current paid-edition documentation advertises plans, orders, tickets, feedback, announcements, coupons and Alipay/WeChat payments. These belong to separate Pro+, not demonstrated open-source repository functionality.

limitations.text: Open-source edition explicitly stopped feature development and bug fixes; master may contain unreleased experiments.
Current official documentation is paid Pro+ documentation. Paid commerce features are separated rather than counted as open-source core.
Dynamic watermark/original-protection processing loads cached responses into memory and has high server requirements; PHP upload/post limits also bound uploads.
Upload conversion or overlay watermarking can replace submitted image bytes; no archive-preserving copy workflow is established. Moderation may delete content.
Face recognition, EXIF catalogue editing, maps, existing-folder indexing, trash/undo, expiring/password shares and E2EE were not established by inspected open-source evidence.

gaps: Current commercial manual cannot establish legacy open-source behavior; used in-repository role help/forms and ingestion/API source instead.
No runtime deployment or provider integrations tested.

R18.summary: Self-hosted multiuser photo gallery with albums, fine-grained sharing, server import/sync and optional processing services; free, Supporter and Pro capabilities differ substantially.
deployment: Self-hosted PHP web application
Recommended Docker deployment with optional separate workers
Prebuilt releases or source installation
R18.storage_model: Database catalogue plus original files and configurable generated size variants; default images disk is local public/uploads, with configurable S3 storage. RAW conversion preserves the native source alongside display JPEG where supported. Current docs describe opt-in embedded metadata changes, so originals are not unconditionally immutable.
R18.privacy_model: Can use an operator-controlled server; self-hosting is not E2EE. Album access, download and full-original grants are distinct. Default storage configuration includes public visibility, so generic architecture prose claiming all originals are outside web root is not a guarantee. Optional face processing uses a separate self-hosted service with read-only shared photos and local embeddings, but downloads models initially; map/offsite-import and license services introduce external dependencies.
maturity_notes: Frozen commit ba1e7ef62b037fd29a3d6b8a52e1eae903c53d0d and latest release v7.13.0 (2026-11-09).
Current source/docs mix v7 and gated v8 development. Release notes explicitly label some additions v8. This inventory distinguishes implemented documented baseline from ambiguous upcoming modules.
Supporter Edition unlocks paid capabilities; Pro adds webshop functionality. Same MIT source license does not make all runtime edition gates free.

Facial recognition marketing, comparison table and how-to disagree on timing and edition: card says Free, table says Soon v8, how-to says SE settings. Face functionality is therefore recorded unclear rather than assumed released/free.

features.name: Browser gallery and administration
features.detail: Lychee runs on a server/web space and lets users upload, manage, view and share photos from a browser; no native desktop gallery is implied.

features.name: Docker server deployment
features.detail: README recommends published Docker images and Compose, including persistent uploads/settings-related storage and an optional separate background worker. This packages the web server, not a native desktop client.

features.name: Multilingual interface
features.detail: Official edition comparison explicitly includes multiple supported UI languages in both Free and SE. Its footnote warns that some languages remain untranslated, so complete translation coverage is not assumed.

features.name: Self-hosted web gallery
features.detail: Runs on the user's PHP server or supplied Docker images; current README requires PHP 8.4+ for source deployment and distinguishes latest stable from edge.

features.name: Browser and server imports
features.detail: Upload from a local computer or import server files through web UI/CLI; chunked upload and full directory-tree import are listed in the free edition.

features.name: Import remote image sources
features.detail: Official overview lists URL and Dropbox sources; provider-specific current authentication restrictions were not established.

features.name: Synchronize server directory trees
features.detail: Free comparison lists directory-tree import and optional removal of catalogue photos/albums no longer present in source directories; these are potentially destructive sync choices, not a read-only guarantee.

features.name: Duplicate-aware importing
features.detail: Free edition lists fast filename/title duplicate checks and separate content-hash duplicate detection. These are distinct matching modes; visual similarity is not established.

features.name: Content-checksum duplicate tools
features.detail: Edition table includes hash deduplication and administration duplicate finding. Current/original checksum tracking is documented; contradictory algorithm descriptions are not resolved into a specific algorithm claim.

features.name: Multi-album photo organization
features.detail: A photo can belong to multiple regular albums without duplicating files; album title, description, cover, header, sorting and layout can be customized.

features.name: Nested album trees
features.detail: Regular albums contain photos and child albums with subtree operations; tag and system smart albums are flat.

features.name: Tag-driven and system smart albums
features.detail: User-defined tag albums dynamically match tag combinations and are shareable; system albums include Recent, Highlighted, Public, Unsorted and On This Day. Arbitrary custom system-smart queries are not supported by this model.

features.name: On This Day collection
features.detail: Built-in smart collection selects capture dates matching today's month/day in earlier years, subject to permissions.

features.name: Configurable gallery layouts
features.detail: Justified, masonry and square layouts, album cover/header controls and customizable album thumbnail aspect ratio are free.

features.name: Timeline with direct date access
features.detail: Free standalone and album timeline views respect access control and offer date navigation; custom granularity/format are SE-only.

features.name: Custom timeline formats
features.detail: SE comparison separately gates custom timeline granularity, formatting and per-album timeline customization.

features.name: Album feed and frame display
features.detail: Flow page presents albums as a feed with access control and configurable base album; separate frame-display module is included free. Compact/extensively customized flow cards are SE.

features.name: Fullscreen viewing
features.detail: Official overview documents full-screen images and forward/backward keyboard navigation.

features.name: Photo and album slideshows
features.detail: Free edition includes photo slideshow and album previous/next slideshow.

features.name: Dark and light themes
features.detail: Both themes and multilingual UI are free edition features.

features.name: Independent album/photo paging
features.detail: Configurable 1–1000 item pages, defaults 30 albums/100 photos; choose infinite scroll, load-more or page navigation independently. Infinite scroll retains loaded pages and grows memory usage.

features.name: Basic gallery search
features.detail: Free feature table and overview establish basic photo searching; arbitrary technical-field query syntax is not established.

features.name: Tag browsing and autocomplete
features.detail: Tag listings and autocomplete accompany global tag rename/merge/delete management and dynamic tag albums.

features.name: EXIF extraction and display
features.detail: Extracts camera/lens/exposure, GPS/orientation and capture timestamps; display can hide sensitive metadata and manual catalogue values can override extracted values.

features.name: IPTC metadata support
features.detail: Official overview explicitly supports/display IPTC; processing guide states default metadata access is read-only rather than writing user changes into files.

features.name: Read embedded XMP
features.detail: Processing reference identifies EXIF/IPTC/XMP as read metadata sources; external sidecar matching is not established here.

features.name: Batch descriptive editing
features.detail: Desktop-like multi-selection and editing tags/metadata for selected photos are documented; baseline edits change catalogue data.

features.name: One-to-five-star ratings
features.detail: Edition comparison marks numeric photo ratings as a free v7 capability; optional embedded writing exports the owner's rating only.

features.name: Tags and highlighted photos
features.detail: Assign tags singly/in bulk and globally rename, merge or delete tags; highlighted photos feed a built-in smart album.

features.name: Personal favourites
features.detail: Personal favourites are specifically SE in the edition table and are separate from free photo highlighting/smart albums.

features.name: Opt-in metadata write-back
features.detail: Current reference documents disabled-by-default ExifTool queue jobs writing title/description/tags across EXIF/IPTC/XMP and owner's rating into original and preserved RAW files. Local disks only; S3 is skipped. Separate checksum-refresh option defaults on.

features.name: Apple Live Photo pairing
features.detail: Photo records associate still and video using content ID/checksum/path for motion viewing. v8 hover playback is version-specific rather than baseline UI.

features.name: Google Motion Photo extraction
features.detail: Current photo reference supports legacy MicroVideoOffset and Motion Photo 1.0/Ultra HDR embedded clips, plus artisan extraction for prior still-only imports; v8 grid badges/hover behavior is separately identified.

features.name: Preserve RAW and generate JPEG displays
features.detail: Imagick pipeline converts supported camera RAW/PSD sources to a JPEG display original and retains untouched RAW; conversion failure keeps source as-is with limited preview. RAW downloads have a separate default-off setting.

features.name: HEIC/HEIF conversion with original retention
features.detail: Current dual-variant pipeline lists HEIC/HEIF among Imagick-convertible source formats and retains native originals where conversion succeeds.

features.name: JPEG XL import and derivatives
features.detail: Requires Imagick/ImageMagick built with libjxl; accepts signatures and can write JXL variants. GD cannot handle it and unsupported browsers have no image fallback.

features.name: Multiple display derivatives
features.detail: Generates medium/small/thumb and high-DPI variants plus low-quality placeholders; dimensions/quality are configurable and original access is separately permissioned.

features.name: Choose derivative encodings
features.detail: Current processing settings offer original/JPEG/WebP/JXL variants, with codec dependencies for optional formats. Quality 0 requests lossless WebP/JXL; changing settings only affects new variants until old ones are regenerated.

features.name: Automatic orientation and rotation
features.detail: Free import auto-rotation is listed and edit grant includes photo rotation; no claim of a general nondestructive editor.

features.name: GPS map viewing
features.detail: Free GPS localization and map module plot media; no offline basemap or offline geocoder was established.

features.name: Album GPS/GPX tracks
features.detail: Regular albums can attach multiple GPS/GPX tracks displayed on the map; this does not establish automatic GPX-based geotag writing.

features.name: Public and unlisted albums
features.detail: Albums/photos can be public; link-required albums are not listed and require knowledge of the URL. Owners/admins alone control visibility/sharing.

features.name: Password-protected albums
features.detail: Album passwords are checked even for explicitly permitted users and unlocking persists for the session.

features.name: Separate per-album action grants
features.detail: View, full-original, download, upload, edit, move and delete rights are separate. Destination albums require edit; ownership-changing actions are constrained. Detailed grant section says permissions must be explicitly propagated to children, although a later legacy paragraph contradicts it.

features.name: Accounts, registration and invitations
features.detail: Unlimited users, registration, invite links, cross-user sharing, per-user trust level and WebAuthn/OAuth login are listed free.

features.name: Granted album contributions
features.detail: Upload and edit grants let selected authenticated users contribute or edit without permission to change sharing; upload moderation is available in v7.

features.name: Anonymous uploads
features.detail: Public-link upload grants require SE; public shares never grant edit, move or delete.

features.name: Total per-user storage capacity quotas
features.detail: SE's per-user upload quota is explicitly defined by the user manual as quota_kb, a storage limit in kilobytes tracking total photo storage for each user; further uploads are blocked when that quota is exceeded. This is account-capacity enforcement, not a per-upload file-size or file-count limit.

features.name: Manage user-group memberships
features.detail: SE includes named user groups for team/client/family access management; a user can belong to multiple groups and membership records carry a group role.

features.name: Delegate group administration
features.detail: Edition comparison explicitly lists group administrators for delegated group management as an SE capability, distinct from granting full-system administrator status.

features.name: Share albums through group permissions
features.detail: SE supports group sharing and per-album group access rights. AccessPermission can target a user group so album grants apply to its members; this is separate from free individual cross-user sharing.

features.name: Report storage usage per user
features.detail: Edition matrix separately lists per-user space usage for SE; reporting consumed storage is distinct from enforcing the account-capacity quota.

features.name: Internal user administration notes
features.detail: SE provides an admin note for each user; the user manual distinguishes this internal note from the user's public/profile description.

features.name: Multiple system administrators
features.detail: Edition matrix lists multi-admin support as SE; the user model's may_administrate permission grants full system administration, unlike a delegated group role.

features.name: Embed albums and publish RSS
features.detail: Edition table marks album embedding and RSS feeds as free modules.

features.name: AES-secured image links
features.detail: SE offers secured image URLs; this is link protection, not evidence of encrypted-at-rest media or end-to-end encryption.

features.name: Custom image watermarks
features.detail: SE supports watermark images with adjustable scaling, placement and opacity.

features.name: Extract dominant colors
features.detail: SE gates dominant color-palette extraction; photo model describes five stored colors. Search/theming use cases in architecture prose do not independently prove a complete color-search UI.

features.name: Library and usage analytics
features.detail: SE adds installation/library/photo/album statistics including downloads and shares; API v3 Insights also has an SE gate.

features.name: Import renaming rules
features.detail: Edition comparison specifically gates renaming rules on import/upload to SE; free UI retitling is a different operation.

features.name: Sell downloads and prints
features.detail: Pro addon above SE supplies pricing, size/license choices, basket/order administration, managed download links and Mollie/PayPal/offline payments. Print support does not integrate with printing services.

features.name: Configurable S3 storage
features.detail: S3 disk supports bucket, endpoint, region, root and path-style configuration; default image disk is local. Metadata write-back currently skips non-local variants.

features.name: Asynchronous processing workers
features.detail: Free worker mode uses a separately running queue worker/container for processing; face scans and metadata-embedding jobs rely on queues.

features.name: Original and album ZIP download
features.detail: Photo/album ZIP downloads are free but subject to download/full-photo grants; preserved RAW export additionally needs raw_download_enabled.

features.name: Diagnostics and maintenance tools
features.detail: Free logs, diagnostic checks, maintenance settings and CLI derivative regeneration are documented; optional JXL and face services expose health/configuration diagnostics.

features.name: Documented API and import CLI
features.detail: API documentation and CLI import are free; current repository has v2 and newer v3 routes, with v8-specific gates on some endpoints.

features.name: Optional sidecar face detection
features.detail: Concrete setup guide describes Python sidecar, queue worker, detection/size/blur thresholds and bounding-box overlays, but live table marks Soon v8 and edition claims conflict. Not counted as generally released.

features.name: DBSCAN face grouping
features.detail: How-to describes DBSCAN cosine-distance grouping of stored embeddings, noise labels and reviewable clusters; shares unresolved v8/edition availability.

features.name: Person matching and selfie claim
features.detail: How-to describes person profiles, similarity thresholds and selfie-based profile claims. Requires configured sidecar/model; exact current released entitlement remains contradictory.

features.name: Face assignment and maintenance
features.detail: Documented workflows assign/merge people, destroy dismissed faces/embeddings, reset failed/stuck scans and synchronize embedding stores. Four permission modes range from public to restricted.

features.name: Self-hosted face inference architecture
features.detail: Configured face service reads a shared read-only photo volume, stores SQLite/pgvector embeddings and downloads a model initially; publication/edition ambiguity remains, and this is not fully air-gapped setup.

features.name: Sensitive-content detection
features.detail: Comparison table explicitly labels sensitive-content detection Soon v8 and SE-only; existing manual sensitive-album flagging is separate.

features.name: Manually mark sensitive albums
features.detail: Free sensitive-album module and is_nsfw album field allow manual content marking; no automatic classifier is implied.

features.name: Opt-in versus automatic feed strategy
features.detail: Edition table explicitly labels custom Flow inclusion strategy Soon and SE rather than an already available core feature.

features.name: Customize album feed cards
features.detail: SE separately provides compact Flow cards and extensive card customization; the basic access-controlled feed is free.

features.name: Show tags on album view
features.detail: Edition comparison gates displaying tags directly on the album view to SE, despite free tag assignment, listing and tag-album creation.

features.name: White-label gallery branding
features.detail: SE v7 can remove Lychee branding; free users can separately hide SE promotional calls to action without obtaining white-label entitlement.

features.name: Gallery contact form
features.detail: Official edition matrix lists contact form as an SE-only v7 module.

limitations.text: Face recognition release/edition documentation conflicts: Free card, Soon-v8 table and SE-only setup settings. Face subfeatures remain unclear pending an authoritative release/entitlement statement.
Permission document's detailed current grants say no automatic child inheritance, while a later paragraph says permissions flow to children. The detailed rule is described but conflict is not hidden.
Metadata embedding changes file bytes and affects duplicate matching against untouched backups; default off, ExifTool required, local disks only.
JPEG XL requires codec-enabled Imagick and compatible browsers; no browser fallback. RAW conversion can fail gracefully and RAW downloads default disabled.

Architecture prose contradicts source on storage privacy defaults and differs on hash algorithm. Actual filesystem config uses a public uploads root/visibility by default; no universal private-original or persistent bit-rot verification guarantee is asserted.
No durable file undo journal, app trash/recovery guarantee, offline basemap or end-to-end media encryption was established.

gaps: v8 feature gates and facial-recognition edition/timing conflict are unresolved.
No exhaustive audit of 350+ individual settings; major user workflows, paid boundaries and relevant constraints were inspected.
No assertion of unverified security, encryption or offline-map guarantees.

R19.summary: Offline-first, folder-oriented desktop photo/video manager combining local AI search, culling, collections, broad decoding and cached access to disconnected storage.
deployment: macOS Apple Silicon/Intel DMG and Homebrew
Windows 10/11 x64/ARM64 MSI, currently unsigned
Linux x64/ARM64 DEB and AppImage; community Fedora packages; experimental unpublished Arch recipe
R19.storage_model: Originals remain ordinary existing files. SQLite/local configuration stores collections, tags, comments, favorites, ratings, culling decisions, smart albums, embeddings, faces and caches. These organization values are not written to EXIF/IPTC/XMP sidecars and do not accompany external file copies.
R19.privacy_model: Photo analysis and AI run on-device, without required upload/account. Maps fetch online tiles; updates use GitHub; optional multilingual models require downloads. Privacy policy states backend Aptabase start/exit events are enabled by default in release builds and contain version/platform/OS, not library contents.
maturity_notes: Pinned a0af23c4c4356e4cab2fbea2333f2398a6b03b50; latest release v0.3.3, 2026-10-12. Current main documentation can be newer than that release.
README claims optimization for 100k+ media files; not independently benchmarked.
AppImage playback depends on host GStreamer plugins; AppImage upgrades use replacement packages or external delta-update tools.
