features.name: Fifteen-language desktop interface
features.detail: v0.3.3 adds Hungarian, Italian, Dutch, Polish, Ukrainian and Traditional Chinese, bringing documented UI languages to fifteen; v0.3.2 adds a welcome-screen language selector. Date/time formatting follows the system region independently of UI language. This is separate from optional multilingual semantic search.

features.name: Folder-first originals
features.detail: Indexes existing ordinary files without mandatory managed re-import copies; uninstalling the app/catalogue does not delete original media.

features.name: Separate libraries
features.detail: Supports multiple libraries with management controls and per-library cache sizes/cleanup.

features.name: Folder hierarchy browsing
features.detail: Folder-based albums and cached subfolder trees reflect existing directories; subfolder refresh can update hierarchy without full media rescanning.

features.name: Rescan filesystem changes
features.detail: Rescans detect many external changes, and Live Photo associations update incrementally; external renames/moves can disrupt database-only organization.

features.name: Copy import
features.detail: Album import, drag/drop and clipboard workflows copy media into chosen folders, respect exclusions and update the library without a separate full scan.

features.name: Date-organized imports
features.detail: Choose YYYY/YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY/YYYY-MM, YYYY or one folder; uses capture date with modification-time fallback and preserves filenames.

features.name: Skip duplicate import content
features.detail: Import skips duplicate content and reports imported/skipped/failed counts; identical or nested source/destination paths are guarded.

features.name: Catalogue-aware file operations
features.detail: In-app rename/move/copy/delete updates catalogue records and carries supported grouped components together.

features.name: Native file export/drag-out
features.detail: Drag photos/videos into the OS file manager or other apps as actual files, up to 1,000 per operation; catalogue-only annotations do not travel with them.

features.name: Disconnected album browsing
features.detail: Keeps removable/network albums visible with cached metadata/thumbnails and an availability warning; operations needing originals are gated until reconnection.

features.name: Per-album exclusion preview
features.detail: Per-album file-type, small-image and folder exclusions have a scan preview; v0.3.3 replaces the previous global small-image filter.

features.name: Grid and filmstrip
features.detail: Toolbar switches mutually exclusive grid, filmstrip and map modes; configurable thumbnail badges expose format and exposure settings.

features.name: Calendar/date exploration
features.detail: Hierarchical Years/Months/Days navigation supplies localized month names and counts; grouping adapts to dates, folders, cameras, lenses or locations.

features.name: Virtualized large-library views
features.detail: v0.3.0 explicitly improves virtualized viewport loading and grouped/search result loading to reduce browsing work.

features.name: Four-pane culling comparison
features.detail: Compare up to four images side-by-side; optional navigator sharpness grid assists focus comparison, without documenting an automatic quality score.

features.name: Zoom navigator
features.detail: File Info preview has scroll zoom, double-click fit and a draggable full-image viewport navigator; video zoom pans around the cursor.

features.name: Keyboard navigation
features.detail: Page Up/Down navigation, viewer shortcuts and keyboard stepping for straighten are documented.

features.name: Filmstrip slideshow
features.detail: Release notes explicitly describe stopping slideshows when leaving filmstrip or entering map mode.

features.name: Video playback and previews
features.detail: Viewer and hover playback support videos and paired motion content. H.264 has compatibility processing when native playback is unavailable; HEVC/VP9 are natively supported on macOS and Linux depends on GStreamer plugins.

features.name: Filename/text search
features.detail: Regular filename, text and metadata result caps were removed in v0.3.2; in-view/sidebar search added in v0.3.3.

features.name: Metadata facets
features.detail: Browse/filter by date, camera, lens, location, tags, ratings and faces; camera/lens sidebar tabs include counts.

features.name: Media type filters
features.detail: AI Search and Smart Albums accept file-type constraints, including a combined Live & Motion Photos condition.

features.name: Local semantic search
features.detail: CLIP-based image/text similarity supports natural-language prompts and similarity cutoffs; the earlier 1,000-result cap was removed.

features.name: Optional multilingual search
features.detail: Optional downloaded model extends search to over 50 languages; download failures on slow connections are explicitly discussed in release notes.

features.name: Visual similarity search
features.detail: Local image similarity finds visually related media; it is separate from documented duplicate cleanup, whose exact detection algorithm is not established by these docs.

features.name: On-device analysis
features.detail: Semantic search, smart tags, face detection/clustering and video indexing execute locally along with thumbnail/RAW preview generation.

features.name: Smart subject tags
features.detail: Local smart tags and subject-based browsing/search are documented; user-managed tags are stored in the catalogue.

features.name: Face detection
features.detail: Privacy policy explicitly lists local face detection and storage of derived face data.

features.name: People clustering
features.detail: Locally groups faces and exposes a People list with incremental loading and person avatars; manual correction/naming specifics are not established here.

features.name: Persistent virtual collections
features.detail: Collections accept drag/drop across the library, reordering and duplicate-aware additions; removing membership does not move originals to Trash.

features.name: Rule-driven Smart Albums
features.detail: Saved rules include file types with configurable grouping/sorting/order; built-ins include Recently Added and On This Day.

features.name: Embedded technical metadata
features.detail: Reads capture time, camera, lens, orientation and GPS; video metadata includes Apple QuickTime tags and GPS where available.

features.name: Catalogue tags and groups
features.detail: Bulk tag management supports collapsible/reorderable groups and moving tags between groups, with a protected Default group. Groups are not documented arbitrary-depth tag hierarchies.

features.name: Local ratings
features.detail: Ratings support organization and filtering but remain in Lap's database, not embedded files or XMP sidecars.

features.name: Favorites
features.detail: Favorite state is exposed in library navigation and stored locally.

features.name: Local comments
features.detail: Comments are library-only metadata and do not automatically appear in other photo applications or exported copies.

features.name: Picks and rejects
features.detail: Local catalogue preserves culling states including Picks and Rejects, separate from file-embedded metadata.

features.name: Generated-image prompt import
features.detail: Scans PNG prompts from Automatic1111, InvokeAI, ComfyUI and NovelAI into empty comments without overwriting existing notes.

features.name: Batch metadata refresh
features.detail: Refresh file info rereads selected files together; unchanged cloud-only OneDrive/macOS dataless entries are detected without forcing downloads.

features.name: Scoped and library-wide duplicate review
features.detail: Duplicate scans can target a collection or selection; library-wide cleanup reports reclaimable space and bulk removes chosen copies. Sources do not specify hash versus perceptual equality.

features.name: Preserve per-set keep choices
features.detail: Bulk removal across duplicate sets explicitly preserves each set's keep choice.

features.name: RAW decoding and selectable previews
features.detail: Supports many camera RAW families; choose rendered or embedded previews, adjust render brightness and request full rendering when zooming. Preview fallback works both directions.

features.name: HEIC/HEIF/HIF
features.detail: Listed image formats include HEIC/HEIF/HIF with FFmpeg/ImageIO fallback decoding discussed per platform.

features.name: AVIF
features.detail: AVIF is explicitly included in supported image formats.

features.name: JPEG XL
features.detail: JXL is explicitly included alongside HDR/EXR/PSD and JPEG 2000 image formats.

features.name: Apple Live Photos
features.detail: Recognizes HEIC/MOV pairs, displays a LIVE badge and plays motion; companion MOV files are suppressed from ordinary lists.

features.name: Google Motion Photos
features.detail: Plays embedded video in supported Android/Google Motion Photo JPEGs and can recognize them in existing libraries.

features.name: RAW+JPEG/HEIC stacks
features.detail: Enabled pairs appear as one item with viewer switching between RAW modes and paired JPEG/HEIC.

features.name: Companion-aware operations
features.detail: Live Photo MOV, Apple AAE adjustment sidecars and enabled RAW companions stay together during rename/move/copy/delete.

features.name: Crop and straighten
features.detail: Crop includes arbitrary-angle horizon straightening with a zero-snapping ruler, keyboard stepping and live result preview.

features.name: Rotate and flip
features.detail: Built-in image editing supports rotation and flipping; saved edits write a resulting image to the selected destination.

features.name: Resize images
features.detail: Resize is explicitly included in built-in editing.

features.name: Basic image adjustments
features.detail: README documents basic image adjustments, without asserting a full RAW-development workflow.

features.name: Collage and print layouts
features.detail: Grid, justified mosaic and picture-pile layouts support layering/moving/rotating/scaling, randomization, backgrounds, spacing, borders and shadows; export from originals at full resolution or print at 300 dpi to configurable/A4/photo pages.

features.name: Filtered photo/video map
features.detail: Map follows current filters and can retain position/zoom across cluster exploration; map styles, density heatmap and nearby-photo panel are documented.

features.name: Clustered photo markers
features.detail: Clusters geotagged media and provides configurable photo-marker size.

features.name: Optional Tianditu provider
features.detail: Tianditu is available for China with the user's own API token; normal maps fetch online tiles, including OpenStreetMap.

features.name: Offline local library operation
features.detail: Core browsing and provisioned local AI are designed for offline use, but map tiles explicitly need Internet and update/telemetry/model requests are separate exceptions.

features.name: No required cloud library
features.detail: No forced cloud account or photo upload; policy says library paths, queries, annotations, embeddings and media are not sent in analytics.

features.name: Configurable cached thumbnails
features.detail: Thumbnail quality/resolution is adjustable up to documented 1024 px, with grid sizes up to 720 px and reduced-resolution RAW previews.

features.name: Cancelable imports
features.detail: Date-based import exposes progress, cancellation and continuation controls.

features.name: Continue import
features.detail: Documented import continuation works with duplicate skipping and imported/skipped/failed feedback; not claimed as a universal durable task journal.

features.name: Per-library thumbnail cleanup
features.detail: Manage Libraries shows cache sizes and removes thumbnails per library without implying removal of personal organization data.

features.name: Local database backup
features.detail: Settings > Storage controls database location and creates a backup; README recommends backing up database/configuration alongside originals.

features.name: Preserve corrupt catalogue
features.detail: Detects per-library corruption and prompts a library switch while preserving the original database instead of silently rebuilding it.

features.name: Multiple external applications
features.detail: Configure multiple external apps and a default; opening more than 100 files requires confirmation.

features.name: Set desktop wallpaper
features.detail: Wallpaper action supports macOS, Windows and GNOME Linux, including suitable paired RAW companion images.

limitations.text: Collections, annotations, tags, ratings, favorites and culling state are catalogue-only, not EXIF/IPTC/XMP sidecars. External file moves can break those associations.
Map tiles are online, and release builds enable Aptabase lifecycle events by default. Local-first is not synonymous with air-gapped operation.
Windows installers are unsigned; Linux/AppImage video playback depends on system multimedia plugins and codec support.
Duplicate matching algorithm, face correction/naming detail, OS-trash semantics, shared albums, end-to-end encryption and metadata sidecar import are not established by the inspected sources.

gaps: No runtime tests; 100k+ scalability remains a project claim.
Exact duplicate algorithm and metadata/face edge cases are deliberately not inferred from broad feature labels.

R20.summary: Android local-media browser and editor with folder-oriented management, configurable viewing and application-level privacy locks.
deployment: Android application; F-Droid build linked by README
Build flavours: foss, proprietary and prepaid
R20.storage_model: Browses existing Android media and folders rather than requiring a hosted photo library. Android MediaStore and permission differences affect access. Application cache and a 30-day recycle bin consume app storage; favourites can be exported as paths.
R20.privacy_model: Local gallery with no required upload documented. PIN, pattern and fingerprint controls restrict app/folder/action access; hiding uses .nomedia and is not encryption. Proprietary editor distribution differs from the FOSS build.
maturity_notes: Frozen master commit a3564013b7ac2828d3b0f11572ce225f094423ff; manifest latest release 6.28.1 dated 2023-10-09 and last push in August 2024.
This inventory concerns SimpleMobileTools/Simple-Gallery, not a feature union with the separate Fossify successor family.
README's general editor claims need build-flavour qualification: Gradle applies IMG.LY SDK only for proprietary tasks. Current commercial-store behaviour is not verified.

features.name: Translated Android interface
features.detail: Changelog repeatedly documents translation updates and explicitly adds an Android 13+ app-language picker in 6.25.0, with in-app language change in 6.26.9. This establishes localized UI without inferring an exact completeness/language count.

features.name: Android gallery
features.detail: Native Android application; version 6.26.0 raised minimum Android to 6 and README links the F-Droid package.

features.name: Browse existing device media
features.detail: Folder and All Files views operate on device media; no managed re-import is required. Android 11+ storage permissions affect visibility.

features.name: Recursive folder inclusion and exclusion
features.detail: Manage Included Folders adds missed locations; exclusions are recursive and affect only this app. An included folder wins when also excluded, allowing a root exclusion plus selected inclusions.

features.name: Folder navigation and ordering
features.detail: Switch folders/all-files, group direct subfolders, pin multiple folders, select a default folder and reorder folders by dragging.

features.name: Configurable thumbnails
features.detail: Square cropping, rounded or square corners, spacing, horizontal scrolling, file-type labels, duration labels and folder media counts are configurable.

features.name: Date-grouped media thumbnails
features.detail: Group by capture date or last modification, daily or monthly, with optional per-section counts; grouping and sorting are independent.

features.name: Sort by date taken
features.detail: FAQ documents date-taken sorting and its associated date-fix action for copied files.

features.name: Device-wide visible-file search
features.detail: Main screen can search files rather than folders and switch to searching across all visible folders; destination picker also supports search.

features.name: Media-type filtering
features.detail: Filters distinguish images, videos, GIFs, RAW, SVG and portrait categories; thumbnails can also be grouped by type or extension.

features.name: Customizable fullscreen viewer
features.detail: Hide system UI, choose black background or maximum brightness, select orientation policy and configure visible bottom actions and extended details.

features.name: Deep and one-finger zoom
features.detail: Options include one-finger zoom, deeper zoom, 1:1 zoom with two double taps and highest-quality image rendering to reduce banding.

features.name: Gesture-controlled viewing
features.detail: Vertical swipes adjust photo brightness or video volume/brightness; rotation gestures, edge taps and downward dismissal are configurable.

features.name: Configurable video player
features.detail: Supports autoplay, looping, remembered playback position, double-tap seeking, separate-screen horizontal gestures and double-tap video zoom.

features.name: Mixed-media slideshows
features.detail: Choose photo/video/GIF inclusion, interval, random or reverse ordering, looping and fade/slide/no transition.

features.name: Panoramic photo support
features.detail: README explicitly lists panoramic photos among supported media; spherical metadata requirements are not specified.

features.name: Theme and interface customization
features.detail: README allows appearance customization; release history adds automatic and Material You themes, with Material You default on Android 12+.

features.name: RAW photo support
features.detail: README lists RAW and media filters provide a separate RAW category; individual camera decoder coverage is not specified.

features.name: SVG viewing
features.detail: README and file-type filters explicitly support SVG images.

features.name: HEIC display and zoom
features.detail: Version 6.21.0 includes HEIC zoom fixes, establishing the supported viewing path without a conversion claim.

features.name: AVIF on Android 12
features.detail: Version 6.23.2 adds .avif support specifically on Android 12.

features.name: Animated image viewing and thumbnails
features.detail: Supports GIF, WebP thumbnail animation including folder thumbnails in 6.28.0, and APNG from 6.21.0.

features.name: Move and copy device files
features.detail: Copy/move destination picker remembers the last folder, can show excluded folders and supports SD-card paths subject to Android permissions.

features.name: Rename media and folders
features.detail: Release history documents file renaming and resizing-with-renaming; FAQ describes renaming dot-prefixed hidden folders. Batch-rename templates are not established.

features.name: Remove folders emptied by deletion
features.detail: Settings can delete empty folders after deleting their contents; this is not a whole-disk empty-folder scanner.

features.name: Favourites with path export/import
features.detail: Mark favourites on thumbnails, toggle in the viewer and export/import favourite file paths; this export is not a full media backup.

features.name: Repair date-taken values
features.detail: Select thumbnails and use Fix Date Taken when copied files sort incorrectly; exact embedded-versus-MediaStore write semantics are not documented by the FAQ.

features.name: Basic cropping
features.detail: Editor offers draggable corners and free, fixed and custom aspect ratios.

features.name: Rotate and flip
features.detail: Rotate left/right/180 degrees and flip horizontally or vertically in the editing workflow.

features.name: Single and batch resize
features.detail: Set width/height with aspect preservation or batch-resize selected images by a factor between 10% and 90%; batch resizing appears in 6.26.9.

features.name: Advanced SDK filters and adjustments
features.detail: Proprietary build conditionally includes IMG.LY advanced editor. UI defines exposure, highlights, shadows, clarity, gamma, colour, blur-focus, overlays, text and sticker controls; these must not be attributed to every FOSS build.

features.name: Advanced video trimming and merging
features.detail: Video Trim UI and 6.26.4 merging belong to the Advanced Editor; its SDK is conditional on the proprietary flavour.

features.name: Share a resized version
features.detail: Viewer includes a dedicated Share a resized version action rather than requiring full-size transmission.

features.name: Home and lock-screen wallpaper
features.detail: Set home, lock or both wallpapers with portrait/landscape and adjustable aspect ratios.

features.name: Folder photo widget
features.detail: Widget settings select the displayed folder and whether to show its name.

features.name: Open media location on a map
features.detail: UI exposes Show on map and an unknown-location state. An integrated offline basemap or geocoder is not established.

features.name: PIN, pattern and fingerprint protection
features.detail: README documents app-level, selected-media and function locks; excluded-folder visibility can also be password protected. Locked folder copies require unlocking in 6.27.1.

features.name: Hide with .nomedia or app-only exclusions
features.detail: Hide creates a removable .nomedia marker recursively; Exclude hides only within Simple Gallery. Hidden access requires All Files permission on affected Android versions.

features.name: Application recycle bin
features.detail: Deleted items can be restored for 30 days, after which automatic deletion occurs. Restoration falls back to Pictures when the original folder is inaccessible; recent versions allow bypassing the bin.

features.name: Deletion review
features.detail: Version 6.23.8 adds the size of items to be deleted to the confirmation dialog.

features.name: Image-loading cache
features.detail: FAQ describes up to 250 MB of cache for faster image loading; recycle-bin media adds further application storage.

features.name: Speed versus validity/quality controls
features.detail: Settings expose file-loading priority choices including speed, compromise and avoiding invalid files, plus high-quality deep-zoom rendering.

limitations.text: App/folder locks and .nomedia hiding are not encrypted storage. The FAQ permits resetting a forgotten app password by clearing application data or reinstalling without deleting media.

Android 11+ storage restrictions affect hidden folders and real-path inclusion. All Files and Media management permissions, Android version and distribution flavour change behaviour; older restrictive FAQ text is supplemented by later All Files support.
Recycle-bin contents are automatically removed after 30 days and deletion can bypass the bin; it is not guaranteed permanent recovery.
Advanced proprietary editing is separated from core FOSS functionality. Exact current paid entitlement and store build parity are not established.
No inspected evidence establishes face recognition, semantic search, duplicate detection, metadata sidecars, E2EE or cloud-library backup.

gaps: Modern commercial-store behaviour not verified; profile is pinned repository and released-history evidence.
No broad AI, duplicate-cleanup or hosted-library capabilities established.

R21.summary: CLI/Python toolkit for querying, exporting, importing and repairing Apple Photos/iPhoto libraries, with unusually rich metadata/template preservation and optional direct original-file writes.
deployment: macOS command-line tool/Python package
Standalone macOS Intel/Apple Silicon executables
Linux export/query and Python API subset; Photos-app-dependent commands unavailable
R21.storage_model: Reads a copy of the Apple Photos SQLite catalogue into in-memory structures; queries existing Photos libraries rather than creating a replacement gallery. Exports copy original/edited/companion files into chosen directories and track state in .osxphotos_export.db. Optional hardlink exports share underlying files. Import/edit/sync commands operate on the open Photos library; explicitly dangerous commands can change originals or database fields.
R21.privacy_model: Local library queries/exports need no third-party photo hosting. iCloud download-missing explicitly requires Apple Photos, network and an iCloud-synced library. OCR uses Apple's local Vision framework on supported macOS. Export databases/sidecars can expose person names/GPS and should not be casually shared. User-configured post-functions/commands can run arbitrary integrations; none were executed in this research.
maturity_notes: Frozen main 2bb7b0d896c8233068196acdd3c47b489ba3efef; latest release v0.78.1 dated 2026-11-08.
README says Photos libraries across supported macOS versions can be read on another supported system, with limited iPhoto 9.6.1 support and incomplete testing of newer versions.
README explicitly cannot read shared albums on macOS 26.x; audio-only assets are not handled.
Uses reverse-engineered Apple database structures; v0.78.1 documents a schema compatibility fix and iPhoto sync-export support. Future Apple schema changes may break compatibility.

features.name: Photos-library command-line toolkit
features.detail: Commands cover query/export/import, batch edits, timewarp, sync/compare, metadata inspection, orphan discovery, library inventories and interactive help/template tools.

features.name: Python catalogue/export API
features.detail: PhotosDB, PhotoInfo, QueryOptions, PhotoExporter and comparison objects expose structured metadata and programmable export rather than requiring GUI automation for reads.

features.name: macOS CLI distribution
features.detail: macOS supports Photos-app interactions and Python/tool-manager or standalone Intel/Apple Silicon distributions.

features.name: Standalone executable
features.detail: Prebuilt macOS binaries do not require a separate Python install, but README warns they are not notarized.

features.name: Linux read/export subset
features.detail: Query, export and Python API can operate on copied Photos libraries on Linux; macOS-specific CLI commands are omitted.

features.name: Explicitly select Photos catalogues
features.detail: --library selects among distinct Photos libraries; absent that, uses last-opened or System Photo Library. Compare/sync accepts separate source catalogues.

features.name: Legacy iPhoto library access
features.detail: Limited iPhoto 9.6.1 support includes export/query metadata; v0.78.1 adds iPhoto support to sync --export.

features.name: Export original images and video
features.detail: Copies original media out of Photos using original import names by default, with selectable inclusion of related versions/companions.

features.name: Export edited versions separately
features.detail: Defaults to original and edited versions with a configurable edited suffix; can skip edits or export only edited when one exists.

features.name: Export derivative previews
features.detail: API exposes ordered preview paths and optional preview export/suffix, including derivative stills/video previews when available.

features.name: Date-organized exports
features.detail: --export-by-date organizes by capture year/month/day; template directories can choose arbitrary date formats.

features.name: Preserve folder/album hierarchy on export
features.detail: folder_album templates reproduce Photos nested albums; multi-album/multi-keyword templates can export multiple copies and filters can restrict chosen hierarchy branches.

features.name: Metadata-driven exported names
features.detail: Directory/filename templates support defaults, nested conditionals, multi-valued fields and filters; use title, date, place, album, keyword or original name without renaming Photos originals.

features.name: Update an existing export
features.detail: SQLite export state enables --update to export only new/changed files. --only-new ignores removed prior exports; --ignore-signature avoids replacing externally edited output merely because file size/mtime differs.

features.name: Download missing originals from iCloud
features.detail: --download-missing asks Photos via AppleScript or optional PhotoKit to obtain originals before export; requires network and iCloud sync, may restart Photos after crashes, and does not retrieve all burst companions.

features.name: Optional hardlink export
features.detail: Exporter supports creating hardlinks instead of copies. These share the underlying file and are not an independent backup.

features.name: RAW+JPEG companion handling
features.detail: Exports associated RAW and JPEG components with skip controls; import groups paired assets on macOS 11+ and API distinguishes RAW-as-original from standalone RAW.

features.name: Live Photo paired-media export/import
features.detail: Exports still plus live video and imports recognized pairs together on macOS 11+; optional auto-live creates pairing metadata for same-basename non-Apple pairs, modifying inputs.

features.name: Burst companion preservation
features.detail: Default export includes burst photos unless skipped; macOS 11+ import groups burst members, unlike older versions. Missing iCloud bursts remain a documented limitation.

features.name: AAE edit round-trip
features.detail: Export AAE adjustment files and re-import with original/edited companions to preserve non-destructive edits when Photos naming conventions match; unmatched edits become separate assets.

features.name: JPEG conversion on export
features.detail: Convert non-JPEG images such as RAW/HEIC to JPEG with quality 0–1 and extension normalization; README says conversion requires a Mac GPU and may fail in VMs.

features.name: Preserve Photos metadata in exported media
features.detail: With separately installed ExifTool, writes Photos keywords, persons, GPS and other metadata into exported files, optionally merging existing keywords/persons and deriving hierarchical tags from albums.

features.name: XMP/JSON metadata sidecars
features.detail: Export XMP or ExifTool-compatible JSON without installing ExifTool; configure extension-dropping and keyword/description templates.

features.name: Selective metadata export
features.detail: Exporter options control inclusion of location/persons, replacement/merging of keywords and generated metadata; this does not automatically remove every pre-existing embedded field.

features.name: Finder tags/comments and Spotlight attributes
features.detail: Write keywords to Finder tags and template-driven author/comment/copyright/description/headline attributes without altering image bytes.

features.name: Export filesystem date adjustment
features.detail: --touch-file sets exported file modification time to photo date; separate from changing embedded EXIF or Photos capture time.

features.name: Read stored EXIF and optional full file metadata
features.detail: Photos 5+ API exposes the EXIF subset cached by Photos; a separately installed ExifTool reader provides complete file metadata when the original is locally available.

features.name: Read Photos person/face records
features.detail: Expose names, face/person objects and region metadata from Apple's catalogue. This is not an independent face-recognition engine.

features.name: Expose Apple's hidden classification labels
features.detail: Read normalized labels produced by Photos image categorization and use them in queries or export keyword templates; labels originate from Photos, not a new OSXPhotos classifier.

features.name: Read stored aesthetic/curation scores
features.detail: Photos 5+ ScoreInfo exposes overall, composition, blur/focus, noise and other existing scores; the author explicitly has not fully decoded their semantics. Not claimed as newly computed culling or best-shot inference.

features.name: Read Apple-generated captions
features.detail: PhotoInfo exposes mediaanalysisd metadata and an AI caption when one exists; OSXPhotos is reading existing analysis, not generating captions itself.

features.name: Local Apple Vision text recognition
features.detail: On macOS 10.15+, detected_text runs Vision on edited/original/preview fallback with confidence thresholds and cached results; explicitly distinct from Monterey Live Text.

features.name: Filename and template-path queries
features.detail: Query original/media names and match regular expressions against template values such as full folder/album hierarchy.

features.name: Rich catalogue queries
features.detail: Search title, description, album/folder, EXIF values, UUID and Photos labels; support query expressions/functions for custom predicates.

features.name: Capture/import time filters
features.detail: Filter capture start/end/year and added-before/after/recent intervals; tutorial also documents time-of-day selection.

features.name: Photo/video and subtype filters
features.detail: Filter photos/movies, UTI, RAW companions, live/burst/HDR/portrait/panorama/screenshot/selfie/slow-motion/time-lapse states.

features.name: Size filtering
features.detail: Query minimum/maximum original size, e.g. select large videos and add them to an album.

features.name: Named-person filters
features.detail: Search people identified by Photos and combine them with export/query constraints.

features.name: Keyword filters
features.detail: Query repeated keywords and absent-keyword state; export only matching media.

features.name: Place and GPS-presence queries
features.detail: Query Photos reverse-geocoded place names and presence/absence of location/place data; no offline-map UI implied.

features.name: Combined query semantics
features.detail: Different query options combine as AND; repeated keyword values combine as OR. Regex/template and custom function/expression hooks support more specific selection.

features.name: Find missing/edited/cloud/deleted assets
features.detail: Query missing originals, referenced versus managed, iCloud-managed/synced, hidden, favorite, edited/external-edit, in/no album, deleted and missing descriptive metadata states.

features.name: Saved export/query option configurations
features.detail: Save and reload export options, including filters/templates, as TOML configuration files for repeatable workflows.

features.name: Fast possible-duplicate candidates
features.detail: PhotoInfo.duplicates matches original byte size, creation time, height and width—not hashes or byte comparison—and works even with iCloud originals missing. Results are expressly only possible duplicates.

features.name: Stored original-content fingerprints
features.detail: Expose Photos' stored hash of original file for cross-library matching, distinct from the metadata-based duplicates property.

features.name: Import into Apple Photos
features.detail: Import files/directories into the most recently opened Photos library, optionally recursively and with glob filtering. Ordinary assets import individually, affecting Photos Imports grouping.

features.name: Skip or confirm duplicate imports
features.detail: Choose Photos' dialog-based duplicate checks or OSXPhotos --skip-dups. Default matching uses photo fingerprint, but video fallback uses lowercase filename+size; custom signatures compare with library state at import start.

features.name: Reuse existing duplicate in target albums
features.detail: --dup-albums adds an existing matched asset to the albums skipped import would have created, preserving folder-to-album organization without extra copies.

features.name: Google Takeout JSON metadata import
features.detail: Import sidecar support recognizes standard and supplemental-metadata.json Takeout names; UTC-only sidecar dates can be ignored to preserve more accurate embedded timezone information.

features.name: Restore metadata from sidecars/export state
features.detail: Read JSON/XMP sidecars or OSXPhotos export database for title, description, keywords, GPS, albums and date/time. XMP parsing needs ExifTool; JSON wins if both sidecar types are found.

features.name: Infer import dates from names/directories
features.detail: Parse strptime-like filename or folder patterns and supply timezone overrides; missing components fall back to Photos' date behavior. Direct named-timezone writes carry an undocumented-database risk.

features.name: Import folders into album hierarchy
features.detail: Album templates and split-folder delimiter create nested Photos folders/albums; multiple target albums and relative-to path templates are supported.

features.name: Batch Photos metadata editing
features.detail: Selected/query-matched assets can receive template titles/captions/keywords, GPS and favorite flags; an open album with no selected photos targets all its photos unless queries are provided.

features.name: Add or replace keywords
features.detail: Batch-edit adds keywords by default with an explicit replacement switch; import can merge rather than overwrite existing keywords.

features.name: Set/clear favorites and rating mapping
features.detail: Batch set/clear favorite; import optionally maps an XMP star-rating threshold to favorite. Native numeric ratings are iPhoto-specific, not Apple Photos ratings.

features.name: Assign GPS in Photos
features.detail: Batch/import set explicit latitude/longitude; add-locations fills missing GPS using nearby geotagged captures rather than a GPX track.

features.name: Time-nearest photo GPS propagation
features.detail: Find the nearest geotagged photo within a configurable ±time window (default one hour) and copy its location; assumes correct capture times and offers dry run.

features.name: Timewarp capture-time correction
features.detail: Set or offset date/time, parse filenames, assign named IANA/UTC-offset zones and optionally preserve wall-clock time with --match-time; named zones account for DST.

features.name: Adjust Photos added/imported date
features.detail: Set date-added independently or copy capture date to added date, useful for removing old scans from Recents without changing their capture timestamp.

features.name: Compare/pull/push EXIF dates
features.detail: With ExifTool compare Photos versus embedded timestamps, collect mismatches in an album, pull metadata into Photos or push it into originals; missing EXIF can fall back to file time.

features.name: Explicit original-file metadata writes
features.detail: push-exif uses separately installed ExifTool to write keywords, GPS, face regions/persons, timestamps, titles/descriptions into originals and optionally edits. Compare/dry-run and change tracking reduce repeated writes; this is intentionally destructive to original bytes.

features.name: Set or merge metadata across libraries
features.detail: Sync matched assets using original filename/fingerprint from another library/database or exported SQLite metadata. Set overwrites chosen fields; merge preserves/combines them, and album sync only adds memberships.

features.name: Compare two Photos libraries
features.detail: Compare identifies assets unique to each catalogue and same/different pairs, accepts custom signature functions/templates, outputs CSV/TSV/JSON and offers nonzero-difference exit status.

features.name: Find and recover orphan candidates
features.detail: Compare UUID-named files in originals/renders/derivatives/shared scopes against catalogue IDs including trash and burst members. List candidates or copy them to a destination with collision-safe names; not automatic deletion.

features.name: Prune an export mirror
features.detail: --cleanup deletes files not in the current export set, including unrelated user files unless protected by .osxphotos_keep/keep rules; dotfiles are excluded. Explicit dry run is recommended.

features.name: Undo last metadata batch edit
features.detail: Batch-edit keeps prior values in a local store and --undo restores last metadata changes, but cannot undo album additions; this is not a general crash-safe file-operation journal.

features.name: Reset original capture timestamp
features.detail: Timewarp --reset restores original recorded date/time/timezone only on macOS 13+ and only where Photos stored those original values.

features.name: Preview imports, exports and edits
features.detail: Export/import/batch/sync/geotag/push-exif support dry-run paths; import also validates/render-checks templates and checks already-imported versus not-imported files without importing.

features.name: Increment export names on collision
features.detail: API exporter defaults overwrite=false and increment=true; it can instead fail on collision when increment is disabled. Orphan recovery increments names as well.

features.name: Resume tracked import/export
features.detail: Import --resume skips files recorded in an import database; export database permits restarting/updating prior exports. Reports are not equivalent to transactional rollback.

features.name: Retry unreliable exports
features.detail: --retry sets export retry attempts for failures such as intermittent NAS connections.

features.name: Local or RAM export-state database
features.detail: Place export state on a faster local disk or use RAM then flush on completion; RAM mode can improve NAS workloads but loses progress if interrupted.

features.name: Threaded export integration
features.detail: API documents concurrent export using threads on Python 3.11+; PhotosDB cannot be pickled for multiprocessing. This is an API/example capability, not a claimed default CLI speedup.

features.name: Structured action reports
features.detail: Export/import/sync/push-exif reports support CSV/JSON/SQLite outcomes including new/updated/skipped/missing/errors; import/sync can append reports. These logs are not crash-recovery journals.

features.name: Post-export commands and import functions
features.detail: Export executes template-based commands by output category; import can call configured Python post-functions, and timewarp accepts a custom timestamp function. External scripts are user-controlled executable integrations.

features.name: Selected-photo and template inspection
features.detail: CLI provides inspect, UUID, show, REPL and interactive template commands for exploring selected Photos items and developing repeatable workflows.

limitations.text: Inspected CLI/help/API documentation does not establish translated interface languages. Locale-aware month names/date formatting in export templates are data formatting, not UI localization; no positive localization capability is inferred.

Many commands require macOS and the Photos app; Linux covers export/query/API subset. Classic shared albums cannot be read on macOS 26.x, iPhoto coverage is limited, and Apple schema changes can break parsing.
Audio-only assets are not supported. Missing-iCloud burst export retrieves only the primary member; some tilted-face coordinates may be incorrect.

Metadata duplicate candidates use size/date/dimensions rather than content verification. Import video duplicate fallback uses name/size; custom-signature import does not detect duplicates newly introduced within the same input batch. Sync merges indistinguishable duplicate/edited-copy metadata.
batch-edit --library controls the query source but changes always target the library currently open in Photos; users must ensure they match. No-selection album workflows can affect the entire album.

push-exif changes original files, is discouraged for iCloud-managed libraries because bytes may not resync, and skips classic shared albums. auto-live modifies source pairing metadata; direct named-timezone database writes use undocumented behavior and carry corruption risk.

Export cleanup can remove unrelated destination files. Target volumes are expected to be case-insensitive; case-sensitive NAS/drives can cause unexpected duplicate/missing results. Hardlinks are shared files, not backup copies.
Export state contains sensitive GPS/person metadata; RAM-state exports lose progress on interruption. Cached EXIF/Apple-derived AI data may be stale or have only partially understood semantics.

Batch undo does not reverse album additions; reports/import/export databases do not establish atomic per-file-operation recovery. No complete GUI gallery, encrypted vault, social hosting or independently trained face/caption model is established.

gaps: Very large API manual inspected by complete relevant sections rather than every trivial property/example; all principal end-user command families were checked.
No code or library was executed; Apple OS/schema support and external tool behavior remain documented claims.
Existing Apple labels/scores/captions/face records are explicitly distinguished from OSXPhotos' own Vision OCR and from independent ML inference.

R22.summary: Android local photo/video gallery with folder-oriented browsing, media playback, basic editing, privacy controls and a recoverable app recycle bin.
deployment: Android app distributed through Google Play, F-Droid, IzzyOnDroid and GitHub releases
R22.storage_model: Browses device media and folders rather than requiring cloud import. Android MediaStore/scoped-storage permissions affect access; app keeps cached media, favorites/settings and an app-managed recycle bin. Saved edits can target a new file or overwrite with confirmation.
R22.privacy_model: README advertises no ads and user-controlled EXIF removal and PIN/pattern/fingerprint access protection. Hidden folders use .nomedia and exclusions affect only this app; neither is encryption. FAQ says clearing app data resets the password without removing media, so app lock must not be represented as an encrypted vault.
maturity_notes: Manifest release 1.14.2 (2026-11-07), pinned main 2688360242468f1d591eddf23740c879616bb828; release notes are translation updates.
Some retained strings mention Pro/advanced editor and older Android limitations; they are not evidence of a current paid edition. Current behavior is qualified with permission-dependent paths.

features.name: Native Android gallery
features.detail: Distributed through Android stores/repos and GitHub; registers as image/video viewer, picker and editor.

features.name: Browse existing device media
features.detail: Reads device folders/MediaStore with manual inclusion for missing folders; permissions and Android version restrict hidden/path access.

features.name: Folder navigation and pinning
features.detail: Folder or all-content views, grouped direct subfolders, pinned/default folders and custom drag order are documented.

features.name: Configurable thumbnails and list view
features.detail: Grid/list layout with configurable column count, horizontal/vertical scrolling, square/rounded thumbnails, spacing, filenames and folder counts.

features.name: Date-grouped media
features.detail: Group by capture date or last modification daily/monthly; also by folder, media type or extension. Grouping and sorting are independent.

features.name: Configurable fullscreen viewing
features.detail: Options include hidden system UI, black background, brightness, keep-screen-on, extended details and configurable bottom actions.

features.name: Deep and gesture zoom
features.detail: Settings offer deep zoom/highest quality, one-finger zoom, two-double-tap 1:1 zoom and video double-tap zoom.

features.name: Touch navigation and media gestures
features.detail: Side taps change media, down gesture closes viewer, vertical gestures adjust photo brightness or video volume/brightness, and video supports horizontal seeking.

features.name: Mixed-media slideshows
features.detail: Choose interval, photos/videos/GIF inclusion, random or reverse order, loop and none/fade/slide animation.

features.name: Built-in or external video player
features.detail: Select in-app/default player; autoplay, looping, remembered position, playback speed, seek gestures and durations are exposed.

features.name: RAW image viewing
features.detail: README lists RAW and UI has a RAW filter; camera-specific decoding coverage is not enumerated.

features.name: JPEG XL images
features.detail: README explicitly supports JPEG XL and manifest registers .jxl content handling.

features.name: AVIF images
features.detail: AVIF is explicitly listed among supported formats.

features.name: SVG viewing/filter
features.detail: SVG is listed in README and filter UI.

features.name: Animated GIF browsing
features.detail: GIF filter, animated thumbnails and GIF inclusion in slideshows are user options.

features.name: Ultra HDR rendering option
features.detail: In-app setting explicitly enables showing Ultra HDR photos in HDR; device/version support is not fully specified by this source.

features.name: Cross-folder filename search
features.detail: SearchActivity performs case-insensitive name containment across fetched visible media and prioritizes names starting with the query; not semantic or metadata search.

features.name: Media category filters
features.detail: Filters include images, videos, GIFs, RAW, SVG and portraits.

features.name: Name/path sorting with numeric option
features.detail: Sort by name or full path, optionally numeric/natural value, ascending/descending; preferences can be global or per-folder.

features.name: Sort by file size
features.detail: Size ordering appears alongside filename, dates, random, folder count and custom folder order.

features.name: Capture/modification date sort
features.detail: Sort by Date Taken or last modified independently of grouping, with ascending/descending and folder-specific settings.

features.name: Single and multiple file rename
features.detail: One selected item uses RenameItemDialog; multiple items use RenameDialog. Android 11 SD/OTG root rename needs all-files access.

features.name: Copy/move selected media
features.detail: Invokes file destination workflow, rescans source/destination, fixes date values and updates favorite paths on moves; moving directly from recycle-bin paths is blocked.

features.name: Favorites across paths
features.detail: Batch add/remove favorites, display favorite marks and maintain favorite paths after moving files.

features.name: Export/import favorites
features.detail: Settings expose favorite path import/export; export selects a .txt destination and confirms overwriting an existing file. This is not a full database/photo backup.

features.name: Repair Date Taken values
features.detail: Selected-media action repairs Date Taken used for ordering, especially after copying; source calls fixDateTaken rather than establishing arbitrary EXIF timestamp editing.

features.name: Remove EXIF metadata
features.detail: README explicitly offers stripping sensitive EXIF including GPS and camera details; exact field-by-field scope is not documented.

features.name: Crop with aspect ratios
features.detail: Basic editor crops by dragging corners and supports fixed/free/custom aspect ratios.

features.name: Rotate and flip
features.detail: Editor offers horizontal/vertical flips; media selection routes support 90/180/270-degree rotations.

features.name: Single/batch resizing
features.detail: Resize dimensions with aspect-ratio lock or batch scale factor between 10% and 90%; settings also advertise sharing a resized version.

features.name: Drawing and filters
features.detail: README explicitly includes drawing and image filters in the basic editor; no professional RAW processing is implied.

features.name: Save edited output separately
features.detail: Save-as dialog chooses directory, basename and extension, optionally adds _1, validates names and asks before overwrite. Also exposes overwrite-original option, so edits are not universally nondestructive.

features.name: Save-as collision confirmation
features.detail: SaveAsDialog calls ensureWritablePath with confirmOverwrite=true; favorite-text export also explicitly prompts on collision.

features.name: App recycle bin
features.detail: Deleted photos/videos can be restored. FAQ says bin contents count toward app storage and automatically expire after 30 days; deletion can explicitly bypass bin.

features.name: Deletion review and optional password
features.detail: Delete dialog shows item count/size and bin-versus-permanent action; user can remember skip-confirmation or bypass bin. Password-protected deletion is a separate path.

features.name: PIN/pattern/fingerprint access protection
features.detail: README advertises locking media or app; FAQ permits reset via reinstall/clear data without media removal, so not an encrypted vault guarantee.

features.name: Hide versus exclude folders
features.detail: Hide recursively creates .nomedia affecting other galleries; Exclude hides only within Fossify. Included folders override recursive exclusions; Android permissions can restrict both.

features.name: Local image cache
features.detail: FAQ documents up to 250 MB app cache for quicker image loading, separately from recycle-bin storage.

features.name: Cached results before refresh
features.detail: Search loads cached media into its adapter before starting asynchronous media fetch and stops the current fetch when destroyed/replaced.

features.name: Custom colors, themes and controls
features.detail: Dynamic Material themes and custom themes, launcher colors, bottom action visibility and thumbnail styling are documented.

features.name: Share selected media to apps
features.detail: Single and multiple selections route through Android media-sharing helpers; not a hosted public-link service.

features.name: System viewer/editor/picker integration
features.detail: Manifest registers PICK/GET_CONTENT for image/video, VIEW, photo EDIT/CROP and camera review intents.

features.name: Set device wallpaper
features.detail: Set a photo as home-screen, lock-screen or both wallpapers, with aspect-ratio controls; manifest registers wallpaper activities and SET_WALLPAPER permission.

features.name: Configurable home-screen folder widget
features.detail: Widget settings select the displayed folder and whether to show its name; manifest registers the widget configuration activity and app-widget provider.

limitations.text: Android 11+ scoped storage limits hidden files/folders and some rename/include actions; all-files/media-management permissions enable broader operation, and some system folders cannot be hidden.
App password can be reset by clearing app data/reinstalling without removing media; .nomedia hiding and in-app exclusion are not encryption.
Recycle-bin items auto-delete after 30 days and may be bypassed; save/edit operations can overwrite originals with confirmation.

AI recognition, duplicate matching, embedded map/offline tiles, cloud backup, durable operation journal and encrypted vault were not established. A Show on map label alone does not establish an integrated map.
Format support depends on actual media/device capability; README's broad format claims are not a tested codec matrix. Retained Pro strings do not establish paid functionality.

gaps: Used in-app FAQ/settings as primary manual; source-backed settings-only capabilities carry limited device guarantees.
No merged-manifest/network audit or device tests; no absolute air-gap claim.

R23.summary: Extensible self-hosted web media library with hierarchical albums, strong batch management and sharing; many advanced DAM, playback and contribution workflows require named plugins or Cloud plan entitlements.
deployment: Self-hosted PHP/MySQL or MariaDB web application
Documented Docker installation
Commercial Piwigo Cloud
Separate Android/iOS upload clients
R23.storage_model: Server-hosted originals, database catalogue and on-demand configurable image derivatives. FTP synchronization maps files under galleries into physical albums; normal uploads use managed storage. One asset can belong to multiple virtual albums without file duplication. Extra file formats can be attached to a primary image.
R23.privacy_model: Self-hosting allows chosen infrastructure; Cloud is a separate operated service with advertised French hosting and backups. Access uses public/private albums, user/group permissions, per-image privacy levels and download controls. Optional external video embeds, social scripts and AI integrations contact other services; no E2EE or air-gap guarantee is established.
maturity_notes: Frozen commit 7547b1bdb00a531a613042b9142493f19f64c6ce; latest frozen release 16.4.0 (2026-05-03).
Official live documentation mixes self-hosted and Cloud. Team/Enterprise restrictions quoted here apply to Cloud plans, not automatically to self-hosted plugin licensing.
Release 16.4.0 includes API-key and original-URL fixes plus other fixes; live manuals can describe features beyond the frozen release.
Marketing advertises AI tagging/OCR/captioning and maps without fully establishing installation/edition conditions; these are not silently attributed to repository core.

features.name: Browser media library
features.detail: README defines Piwigo as a photo gallery for the web; official manuals document its browser gallery and online administration panel.

features.name: Documented Docker installation
features.detail: README explicitly offers a Docker installation guide for the self-hosted web server; Docker availability does not establish a native Windows/macOS gallery application.

features.name: Android companion application
features.detail: Official feature overview links a separate Piwigo Android mobile app for uploading phone photos to the server; it is a companion, not part of the PHP browser UI.

features.name: iOS companion application
features.detail: Official sources document the separate iOS upload app, including converting MOV videos to MP4 during transfer; mobile companion availability is distinct from the server's web deployment.

features.name: Per-user multilingual interface
features.detail: Official manual documents over 70 interface languages. Administrators enable/disable languages and select the default; users choose a saved personal language that immediately translates menus/buttons. Database titles/descriptions are not automatically translated.

features.name: Quick interface-language selector
features.detail: Language Switch adds a flag selector for one-click switching among enabled gallery languages; base per-user language preference works without this convenience plugin.

features.name: Language-specific titles and descriptions
features.detail: Extended Descriptions provides manually authored photo/album title and description variants selected by visitor language, with default/all-language fallbacks. This is separate from translating UI and is not automatic machine translation.

features.name: Localized EXIF presentation
features.detail: Exif View translates displayed EXIF values into the gallery language; it does not rewrite the photo's underlying metadata into a different language.

features.name: Self-hosted web library
features.detail: PHP web application with MySQL/MariaDB and GD or recommended ImageMagick; README links manual and Docker installation.

features.name: Managed Piwigo Cloud
features.detail: Separate hosted offering supplies operated infrastructure, backups and standby replication; advanced features differ by Team/Enterprise/VIP plan.

features.name: Web uploads and application imports
features.detail: Web administration uploads media; official overview also lists external clients such as digiKam, Lightroom and Shotwell, which are companion integrations rather than built-in editors.

features.name: Android/iOS upload companions
features.detail: Separate mobile apps send photos to the server; cited overview establishes upload, not unrestricted automatic background camera-roll backup.

features.name: FTP folder-to-album synchronization
features.detail: Self-hosted galleries scan the galleries directory to create albums at arbitrary nesting depth; database sync is required after filesystem changes. Cloud does not offer this method.

features.name: Scoped filesystem and metadata resync
features.detail: Synchronize directories only or directories+files, optionally restrict to an album/subtree, include previously synced metadata or overwrite with empty values.

features.name: Preview synchronization
features.detail: Simulation-only mode reports prospective filesystem/database synchronization without applying changes; distinct from a general undo journal.

features.name: Many-to-many album membership
features.detail: Place one file in several albums without duplicated storage, select representative images and customize ordering.

features.name: Unlimited album hierarchy
features.detail: Albums/sub-albums can be nested and independently public/private; folder-backed albums have more restrictive physical rename/move workflows.

features.name: Scheduled rule-based albums
features.detail: SmartAlbums combines all/any criteria including tags, dates, source album, name, dimensions, author and view counts. Defaults to three-day refresh, with manual or after-upload regeneration; not real-time by default. Cloud requires Enterprise+.

features.name: User-owned reusable selections
features.detail: User Collections lets logged-in users maintain unlimited selections separate from albums; admins search/edit/export collections as CSV. Cloud Enterprise+.

features.name: Manage tags and keywords
features.detail: Assign existing/new tags singly or in batch, combine tags for navigation and optionally map incoming metadata into keywords.

features.name: Descriptions and discussion
features.detail: Editable title/author/description properties accompany optional photo-page comments; visual rich-text editing and multilingual descriptions use FCKEditor/Extended Description plugins.

features.name: User photo ratings
features.detail: Official overview includes file rating as a collaboration mechanism; numeric scale details were not established here.

features.name: Personal favorites
features.detail: Photo-page heart saves favorites, browsable from Explore/Discover and available as a batch-manager prefilter.

features.name: Read and display EXIF
features.detail: Imports technical metadata; default display includes camera make/model, capture time and aperture, with configurable additional fields and ability to hide EXIF.

features.name: Import IPTC metadata
features.detail: Supports IPTC field mapping into author/title/description/keywords; IPTC display is not enabled by default and requires configuration.

features.name: Write properties into IPTC
features.detail: Write Metadata writes title, description, authors and tags back into file IPTC; normal property changes are catalogue edits. Cloud Team+.

features.name: Multi-criteria bulk management
features.detail: Batch manager filters then offers whole-page/set/invert/none selection and bulk delete, album association/move/dissociation, tags, author/title/date/privacy and metadata/derivative regeneration; single mode edits per-item values.

features.name: Stage files for later batch actions
features.detail: Administrators add individual photos or whole albums to a persistent caddie while browsing, then manage that set through batch manager.

features.name: Edit catalogue creation dates
features.detail: Creation date can be edited/unset individually or set in batches; changing upload/post date instead requires Posted Date Changer.

features.name: Typed custom properties
features.detail: Manage Properties Photos adds text/select/radio/date/EXIF/IPTC-derived properties, ordering/visibility and batch edits; Properties Mass Update adds CSV changes. Cloud Enterprise+.

features.name: License and expiry workflows
features.detail: Copyrights defines selectable rights; Expiry Date can leave, archive or delete expiring files and notify downloaders/admins before/on expiry. Expiry Date is Cloud Enterprise+.

features.name: Search filenames and descriptive fields
features.detail: Quick search covers title, filename, description, tags and photo ID; matching albums/tags appear as navigation results. Users can choose searched fields and all/any words.

features.name: AND/OR tags and related-tag browsing
features.detail: Filter on all or any selected tags, combine with albums/authors, and search inside an existing album or tag selection.

features.name: Capture and upload date filters
features.detail: Preset and custom year/month/day ranges have result counts; capture and post dates are independent filters.

features.name: Filter media extensions
features.detail: Multi-criteria bar includes file type, uploader and author alongside album/tag criteria.

features.name: Filter dimensions and aspect ratio
features.detail: Width/height bounds and portrait/square/landscape/panorama ratios are available in gallery and batch filtering.

features.name: Filter minimum/maximum file size
features.detail: Size sliders restrict selection and combine with other criteria; gallery remembers visible filter controls per user, not a documented saved query library.

features.name: Search mapped metadata properties
features.detail: Raw displayed EXIF/IPTC is not searchable by default; configuration can map metadata such as camera model to tags/properties for filtering.

features.name: Color-palette search
features.detail: Color Palette extracts a configurable number of colors and finds images sharing selected colors. Palettes are lazily generated when photos are viewed, so initial coverage is incomplete.

features.name: Checksum duplicate filtering
features.detail: Pinned batch-manager source supports md5sum matching alongside filename/date/dimension options and excludes null checksums; this goes beyond the manual's older name-only description.

features.name: Attribute duplicate candidates
features.detail: Duplicate prefilter can group matching filenames, capture dates and dimensions, independently or together with checksums; these are not perceptual or necessarily exact duplicates.

features.name: Paged batch selection
features.detail: Batch results default to 20 files with 50/100/all options and page controls.

features.name: Fullscreen selection slideshow
features.detail: Photo toolbar starts fullscreen slideshow over current album/tag/search selection, rather than always using the entire library.

features.name: Magnifying photo detail
features.detail: Loupe adds hover magnification with mouse-wheel zoom; availability is explicitly an installed plugin.

features.name: On-demand image sizes
features.detail: Stores originals and generates configured square/thumbnail/medium and optional sizes on request, with editable dimensions/quality; batch manager can delete/regenerate derivatives.

features.name: Control derivative crop focus
features.detail: Center-of-interest tool marks the important region to retain in square/other cropped derivatives; this is not a full destructive original-image editor.

features.name: Watermark gallery renditions
features.detail: Configuration selects a custom watermark image and position, commonly transparent PNG, for gallery presentation.

features.name: Rotate images
features.detail: Rotate Image adds a Rotate tab to the photo editor.

features.name: Replace media while keeping properties
features.detail: Photo Update replaces an original or a non-image representative thumbnail while retaining catalogue properties.

features.name: HEIC ingestion and previews
features.detail: Since v14 supports HEIC with generated browser-compatible preview; self-hosting must enable all-type upload/extensions and have supporting server codecs.

features.name: Animated GIF/WebP media
features.detail: GIF originals animate while thumbnails can use the first frame; WebP support dates to v14 and may require config/server updates, especially animation.

features.name: Browser video playback
features.detail: VideoJS required on self-hosted servers, preactivated in Cloud; listed formats include MP4/M4V/WebM/OGG and configurable player preload/autoplay/loop/style. Uploaded MOV is not generally browser-playable.

features.name: Audio player
features.detail: VideoJS also exposes audio playback (including MP3) represented by an icon rather than a video frame.

features.name: Multiple formats per image
features.detail: enable_formats plus format_ext associates files such as CR2, CMYK JPEG or ZIP in pwg_format with one image. Cloud offers this from Enterprise; storing RAW companions does not prove RAW decoding.

features.name: Document previews and PDF reader
features.detail: Configured PDF/SVG/EPS/TIFF/PSD/AI types can have generated previews; v15 adds an inline PDF reader. Other office formats may be downloadable only with generic icons. Cloud premium formats require Team+.

features.name: 180/360 panorama navigation
features.detail: Panoramas selects special viewing using configurable filename markers, default _180 or _360.

features.name: Double-sided image pairs
features.detail: Back2Front links a reverse-side photo to a front ID, can hide the back from album listings and exposes See back in the viewer.

features.name: Users and groups
features.detail: Official feature overview documents unlimited user accounts and permission assignment per user or group. Accounts are not separate user-selectable catalogues.

features.name: Album permissions and image privacy levels
features.detail: Public/private albums, user/group access and independent Everybody/Contacts/Friends/Family/Admin image privacy levels combine; original download rights are separately controllable.

features.name: Scoped contributor uploads
features.detail: Community grants selected users/groups upload destinations/subtree access, album creation and photo/storage quotas. Low-trust uploads require approval; contributors manage their own pending photos/tags. Cloud Team+.

features.name: Anonymous uploads with moderation
features.detail: Community can permit any visitor, including anonymous users, with low/high trust, per-user limits and administrator approval notifications.

features.name: Share private-photo or collection links
features.detail: Private Share generates scoped photo URLs and emails them without granting general gallery access; User Collections separately shares personal selections. Ordinary public galleries remain core.

features.name: Password-protected collection links
features.detail: User Collections permits a password on generated public collection links; Cloud Enterprise+.

features.name: Expiry and revocation of shares
features.detail: User Collections has expiry dates; Private Share offers 1/2 weeks or 1/3 months and admin history/revocation controls.

features.name: Original downloads with permissions
features.detail: Photo download returns original by default if user has Download permission; toolbar can be hidden and viewer sizes restricted.

features.name: Download selected rendition size
features.detail: Download by Size adds size selection to the download action using configured derivatives.

features.name: Embed hosted videos
features.detail: Embedded Videos imports URLs or embed code from YouTube/Vimeo/Dailymotion and others, with optional title/tag extraction and player settings; playback depends on those external services.

features.name: Social sharing buttons
features.detail: Social Buttons (or Bootstrap Darkroom theme) offers platform sharing; docs warn disabling light mode introduces platform tracking cookies.

features.name: Extensible themes and plugins
features.detail: Repository advertises extension ecosystem; manuals name function-specific plugins, and release upgrade tool warns about version incompatibilities.

features.name: Automation API and external connectors
features.detail: Official overview exposes API/script integrations; v16.4 fixes API-key token handling and original-protected URL responses. Lightroom/WordPress/auth providers require companion connectors.

features.name: Visits and activity reporting
features.detail: Official overview describes day/month/year visit graphs, activity search and upload/edit/delete logs. These are audit analytics, not rollback-capable file journals.

features.name: Location browsing
features.detail: Official feature page advertises map display and manual coordinates but inspected implementation-specific manuals do not settle plugin/edition/provider requirements.

features.name: AI-generated indexing tags
features.detail: Official page advertises tagging through Piwigo-operated AI and separately mentions Imagga/Azure integrations; repository-core availability and entitlement are not established.

features.name: Generated descriptions
features.detail: Official feature page advertises editable AI descriptions but does not clarify whether this is a Cloud entitlement or self-hostable module.

features.name: Extract text from images
features.detail: OCR is advertised alongside AI indexing with insufficient deployment/edition detail to count as core.

features.name: Recognize and group people
features.detail: Official feature page explicitly says face recognition is coming soon.

limitations.text: Self-hosted defaults accept only JPG/JPEG/GIF according to format manual; other types need configuration/codecs, multimedia playback needs VideoJS and MOV often needs conversion or download.
FTP import is self-hosted only, requires database synchronization after changes and restricts file/directory names to letters, digits, hyphen, underscore and dot.
Displayed EXIF/IPTC fields are not searchable by default; map them into searchable properties. Source-file name editing needs Edit Filename rather than normal retitling.
Duplicate source query warns GROUP_CONCAT truncation can omit members of large groups (roughly 250+ under the documented default); hash filtering needs stored checksums.
SmartAlbums are scheduled, not immediately live by default; color palettes cover only photos processed/viewed since enabling the plugin.
Trash-can icon documentation proves delete action, not recoverable application trash. RightClick plugin explicitly does not guarantee image security.
AI and map availability/edition details remain unresolved; face recognition is explicitly upcoming. Cloud backup promises are not automatic self-hosted backup functionality.

gaps: No claim to inventory every third-party plugin; inspected official manuals identify principal advanced workflows and gates.
Current AI service entitlement and map-plugin/provider details are unresolved.
No E2EE, offline maps, perceptual duplicate detection or undo journal established.

R24.summary: Local image/video similarity scanner with desktop, CLI and LAN web interfaces, audio clip detection and optional neural matching for transformed or silent partial copies.
deployment: Windows, Linux x64/ARM64 and macOS Intel/Apple Silicon desktop GUI
Self-contained CLI and web-server archives
Docker web image for linux/amd64 and linux/arm64
R24.storage_model: Scans existing paths, storing reusable fingerprints in ScannedFiles.db and optional dense visual embeddings in DenseEmbeddings.db. Database can live beside the executable or OS state directory; settings/auth live separately. Docker recommends separate persistent config/state volumes and read-only media mounts.
R24.privacy_model: Classic and optional AI processing run locally; AI uses CPU ONNX/DINOv2 and downloads components once on enablement. FFmpeg may auto-download. Web access has a password but is explicitly for local/Docker use, not public Internet exposure.
maturity_notes: Pinned master 4ab0e821e941acebffefcc18484e9e1ca406e6cb; stable v4.1.1 is built from 21ec967, so the pinned README/source may describe post-release changes.
Rolling 4.1.x assets change on commits; numbered releases are immutable. Final classic UI remains in 4.0.x, with settings/database compatibility both ways.
3.x databases auto-migrate; image hashes recompute after moving image processing to FFmpeg, video hashes remain, and downgrade is not recommended.
Speed, 50 ms/file and embedding footprint numbers are project claims, not reproduced measurements.
