features.name: Windows desktop
features.detail: Installer and portable ZIP are documented; current guide warns built releases may no longer run on Windows 10.

features.name: Linux desktop
features.detail: Ubuntu-built archive and source execution; other distributions may need dependencies or source installation.

features.name: macOS source execution
features.detail: Current guide says source installation is the only macOS option; discontinued Intel .app is not claimed as a current native binary distribution.

features.name: Third-party browser clients
features.detail: The inspected Client API guide explicitly names Hydrus Web (floogulinc/hydrus-web), Hydrui and hyAway as actual web interfaces. These separately installed clients require an enabled API and running hydrus desktop client; the API welcome page and repository server are not counted as a built-in gallery UI.

features.name: Third-party Android clients
features.detail: Official integration guide explicitly lists hydit and aether as Android clients connecting to hydrus through Client API. These are separate user-created projects, not an official bundled hydrus Android application; current release compatibility was not tested.

features.name: Third-party Hydra Vista macOS client
features.detail: Client API guide names Hydra Vista (konkrotte/hydravista) as a separate macOS client. This does not revive the discontinued official Intel app or change the official source-only macOS installation guidance; companion availability/compatibility was not live-tested.

features.name: Optional file/tag repository server
features.detail: Bundled hydrus_server executable can be hosted on the user's own machine to provide file/tag repository services with accounts. It is not required for local use and does not provide the separately documented third-party browser gallery UI.

features.name: Portable application data
features.detail: Default settings, databases, media and subscriptions remain under the install directory; portable archive can move across paths/machines with path adjustments.

features.name: Managed copy import
features.detail: Drag files/folders or use import dialog; originals stay untouched by default while copied files receive content-addressed managed names. Optional delete-source-after-import must be explicitly enabled.

features.name: External in-place originals unsupported
features.detail: FAQ explicitly declines tracking source files in place; after import the original path is never used again.

features.name: Skip exact repeat imports
features.detail: Exact byte-identical repeat files are not stored again; visually similar but byte-different files remain separate for duplicate review.

features.name: SHA-256 file identity
features.detail: SHA-256 identifies managed files and exact repeats regardless of original filename; no pairwise byte-comparison verification is claimed.

features.name: Size, dimensions and deleted-file import policies
features.detail: Import options include min/max size, resolution and whether to reimport previously deleted files; optional pre-import tagging parses filenames/folders.

features.name: Automated import/export folders
features.detail: Configured folders run on schedules, importing tags/URLs/notes via sidecars and exporting selected files with naming patterns/metadata.

features.name: Export stored original bytes
features.detail: Drag/drop, clipboard-copy or explicit export returns managed files; filename patterns can use tags/hash and create subfolders.

features.name: Overlapping local file subsets
features.detail: Create separate searchable file-domain lists, add/move membership and intersect with tag domains without duplicating payloads. These are not independent databases or user accounts.

features.name: Independent selectable database instances
features.detail: Create shortcuts using different --db_dir values to run separate catalogues from one install, even concurrently. This is distinct from overlapping file domains within one database.

features.name: Managed storage across multiple volumes
features.detail: Distribute managed media over weighted locations with approximate maximum sizes and separate thumbnail placement; not indexing arbitrary originals in those locations.

features.name: Missing managed volumes block startup
features.detail: Migration guide says all managed file subfolders must be located before the client can boot; it is not an offline-volume catalogue workflow.

features.name: Inbox-to-archive curation
features.detail: New imports enter inbox; archive marks keepers without moving folders. Fast archive/delete filter supports skip/back and commits decisions at completion.

features.name: Thumbnail collection browser
features.detail: Imported thumbnails stream into pages; selections show counts/total size and preview pane, with multi-select context actions.

features.name: Multiple search and downloader pages
features.detail: Create search/special/downloader pages from keyboard chooser, close via middle click and organize subscription landing pages into pages-of-pages.

features.name: Media viewer and fullscreen toggle
features.detail: Double/middle click opens media viewer; F toggles frame/fullscreen and hover panels expose tags, navigation and ratings.

features.name: Wheel zoom and synchronized duplicate comparison
features.detail: Ctrl-wheel zooms normal viewing; duplicate review locks relative zoom and position while switching the compared files.

features.name: Extensive keyboard curation
features.detail: Page navigation, F3 tags, F4 ratings, F7 archive, Shift+Delete undelete and configurable duplicate-filter shortcuts.

features.name: Embedded video playback
features.detail: mpv embed on compatible Windows/Linux or Qt player; supported containers include MP4/WebM/MKV/AVI/MOV/WMV and others. Wayland/mpv and macOS limitations are explicit.

features.name: Audio playback
features.detail: MP3/OGG/FLAC/M4A/WAV and others play through available media backend; guide says it is not a typical playlist music manager.

features.name: Open unsupported viewers externally
features.detail: Any managed file can be launched with the OS default application; import support alone does not imply internal rendering.

features.name: Group thumbnails by namespace/rating
features.detail: Collect-by combines results into groups according to selected tag namespaces or rating services, independent of file folders.

features.name: Autocomplete namespaced tag search
features.detail: Tag prefix autocomplete displays counts, resolves aliases and supports wildcard * patterns and namespace-oriented retrieval.

features.name: Composable AND, exclusion and OR predicates
features.detail: All ordinary predicates must match; leading hyphen excludes tags, Shift builds OR chains and advanced OR accepts system predicates.

features.name: System metadata predicates
features.detail: Combine technical metadata, inbox/archive, local/deleted domains and file relationships with tag predicates.

features.name: File-size restrictions
features.detail: Editable filesize predicates can be combined with system:limit to retrieve a bounded largest-file work queue.

features.name: Dimension predicates
features.detail: Duplicate-rule examples use width and height predicates to exclude tiny images; ordinary predicate searches are reused there.

features.name: Media MIME/type predicates
features.detail: Filter JPEG/PNG/image/PDF and other types, including separate predicates for each side of a duplicate pair.

features.name: Search rating services
features.detail: system:rating filters like/dislike and configured numeric rating services.

features.name: Favourite searches
features.detail: Save common predicate searches with the star control instead of keeping large pages open.

features.name: Independent file and tag domains
features.detail: Choose local/trash/known-file domain and specific tag service, including union of several file domains; current/pending tags can be searched separately.

features.name: Sort and limit by file size
features.detail: Simple sort such as size/import time is applied before system:limit; complicated tag sorts may instead sort a random limited sample.

features.name: Tag-namespace ordering
features.detail: Configure namespace-based sorting and collection rules; limit semantics differ from simple metadata sorts.

features.name: Private namespaced tags
features.detail: Default my tags/downloader tags remain local; create namespaces such as creator/series/person and customize namespace colours.

features.name: Aliases and parent implications
features.detail: Siblings provide reversible tag aliases; parents imply additional tags. Each tag service has its own rules, with configurable cross-service precedence.

features.name: Custom rating services
features.detail: Like/dislike/unrated, customizable integer-star scales including optional zero, and increment/decrement counters; several services can coexist with configurable shapes/colours.

features.name: Default favourites rating
features.detail: New clients include a favourites like/dislike service, functioning as an editable lightweight curation label.

features.name: Bulk tag and rating edits
features.detail: Apply tag edits to selected files and F4 ratings to many thumbnails; viewer tag editor can remain open while navigating and applies immediately.

features.name: Named editable notes
features.detail: Downloaders can capture creator comments/text as notes, visible in the viewer; named notes also import/export through sidecars.

features.name: Retain source and known URLs
features.detail: Known URLs stay attached to content hashes, support downloader skip/refetch decisions and can be exported or used for recovery.

features.name: TXT/JSON metadata export
features.detail: Routers export filtered/converted tags, URLs and named notes to TXT or nested JSON; repeated JSON exports update keys rather than replacing unrelated content.

features.name: Configurable TXT/JSON sidecar parsing
features.detail: Import multiple sources into tag/URL/note destinations with filename rules, delimiters, string processing, JSON formulas and live preview; sidecars are not the internal store.

features.name: Export hash-to-tag archives
features.detail: Tag migration can export a Hydrus Tag Archive of queried hash-to-tag mappings independently of media bytes.

features.name: View embedded EXIF presence/content
features.detail: Maintenance descriptions establish EXIF detection, media-viewer display and system:has exif search. This is not a camera-centric EXIF editing suite.

features.name: Embedded XMP display/presence search
features.detail: XMP presence is detected, viewable and searchable with system:has xmp; arbitrary XMP sidecar import is not established by TXT/JSON routing.

features.name: Embedded IPTC display/presence search
features.detail: Maintenance task and label expose IPTC metadata detection and system:has iptc; detailed field indexing is not claimed.

features.name: Display human-readable embedded prompts
features.detail: Human-readable embedded metadata can include AI prompts and is shown in viewer; search is documented for presence, not natural-language full-prompt search.

features.name: Perceptual duplicate candidates
features.detail: 64-bit pHash with VP-tree Hamming-distance search finds shape-similar still images in the background; adjustable distance trades recall for false positives.

features.name: Exact decoded-pixel matches
features.detail: Distinguishes same-resolution/pixel-content matches even when metadata or file encoding differs; pixel hashes can be regenerated independently.

features.name: Pair comparison with synchronized view
features.detail: Toggle A/B with locked zoom/position; show filesize/resolution/age/tags, estimated JPEG quality and more expensive visual-comparison statements.

features.name: Best-file keeper and quality scoring
features.detail: Choose better/same-quality relations and whether to delete the worse file; configurable comparison scores suggest order, while each duplicate group maintains a best-file king.

features.name: Keep alternatives or equal-quality copies
features.detail: Relationships need not delete either file; same-quality/alternate classifications can retain both when desired.

features.name: Persist duplicate/alternate/false-positive relations
features.detail: Confirmed relationships stop ordinary re-presentation and imply transitive relations; false positives are remembered across runs, without a complete per-decision audit log.

features.name: Merge metadata into keeper
features.detail: Configure transfer/merge of tags, ratings, archive status, URLs and notes, with defaults or per-action customization; content merges are not fully undoable.

features.name: Independent queries for pair sides
features.detail: Require one side, both sides or different searches per side, plus maximum Hamming distance and require/exclude pixel matches; mixed-pair or full-group review modes.

features.name: Rule-driven duplicate resolution
features.detail: Rules combine pair searches, ordered comparisons and actions. Semi-automatic queues require approve/deny; fully automatic rules can delete and merge without per-pair approval.

features.name: Preview duplicate rule effects
features.detail: Preview matched/failed pairs and resulting content updates before saving rules; ambiguous A/B ordering is flagged for better-than rules.

features.name: Metadata-aware automated comparisons
features.detail: Rule comparators can protect EXIF/XMP/IPTC/human-readable/software metadata and ICC presence; they check presence flags, not equality or richness of contents.

features.name: External video-deduplication integration
features.detail: Official docs point to Hydrus Video Deduplicator, which discovers video pairs and queues them through Client API; native still-image pHash is not video matching.

features.name: Rich alternate categorization
features.detail: Basic alternate relationships exist, but ordered WIP/recolour labels and richer presentation are explicitly future work; large alternate sets currently scale poorly.

features.name: HEIC/HEIF import and viewing
features.detail: Format matrix marks HEIC and HEIF as importable, thumbnail-capable and viewable.

features.name: AVIF images and sequences
features.detail: AVIF stills and AVIF sequences have thumbnails and internal viewing in format matrix.

features.name: JPEG XL images
features.detail: JXL is explicitly importable, thumbnail-capable and internally viewable.

features.name: Animated images and Ugoira
features.detail: GIF/APNG/WebP and HEIC/HEIF/AVIF sequences; Ugoira ZIP can use embedded animation.json or note-provided frame delays, otherwise defaults to 125 ms.

features.name: Creative-project preview support
features.detail: Krita/OpenRaster/PSD display embedded previews; Clip Studio and Procreate have thumbnails but no direct viewing, and XCF/SAI2 are import-only.

features.name: SVG thumbnails only
features.detail: SVG import and thumbnails are supported; format matrix explicitly says SVG is not directly viewable inside hydrus.

features.name: Document/archive cataloguing
features.detail: Can import PDF/Office/ebook/archive formats with differing previews; PDF thumbnails except encrypted PDFs and CBZ identification do not imply internal document reading.

features.name: Content-based filetype detection and override
features.detail: Detects type by inspecting content rather than trusting extension/MIME; users can force a type from context menu.

features.name: Gallery, URL and simple-page downloading
features.detail: User-installed downloader definitions parse gallery searches, file/post URLs or simple page links; fresh installs contain no downloaders. Tags/notes can accompany files.

features.name: Adaptive repeating gallery queries
features.detail: Subscriptions detect new URLs, adapt interval to source velocity, stop dead queries and publish to grouped landing pages; they do not reliably backfill old gaps.

features.name: Imageboard-thread watcher
features.detail: Installed watcher definitions repeatedly check a thread, adapt to incoming frequency and stop at inactivity/404; not filesystem watching.

features.name: Context-aware download throttling
features.detail: Global, domain/subdomain and downloader/subscription/watcher contexts all must permit each request; review usage and customize limits, with conservative defaults.

features.name: Pause and resume network queues
features.detail: Subscriptions resume where they stopped after cancellation/global pause; normal downloading/import queues can also be paused.

features.name: Cancel expensive searches
features.detail: Slow tag/system searches display a stop button; subscriptions expose cancellation and global pause controls.

features.name: Optional shared tag repositories
features.detail: Sync all repository hash/tag metadata into a local cache; uploads are explicitly queued/pended and removals may require janitor petitions. Supports multiple repos.

features.name: Self-run file/tag repository server
features.detail: Bundled separate server can host multiple services with registration tokens, accounts, uploader/downloader/admin permissions and server backups; designed for delayed sync, not live LAN browsing.

features.name: Opt-in Client API
features.detail: Enable a port and per-program access keys; active only while desktop client runs. Default HTTP/local policy can be changed to remote/HTTPS, with operator security responsibilities.

features.name: Third-party API workflow extensions
features.detail: Official API guide lists Hydrus Companion browser upload/cookie helpers, Hyshare small-gallery sharing, kaimen virtual FUSE search folders and other workflow tools. Separate browser/Android/macOS client deployment is recorded in its own platform findings; these extensions are not bundled core features.

features.name: External AI taggers
features.detail: API guide links DeepDanbooru and model-based taggers, separate projects not authored/guaranteed by hydrus. No built-in face recognition or semantic photo search is inferred.

features.name: Searchable application trash
features.detail: Deleted media enters a trash domain, can be searched and undeleted, and is automatically permanently removed after configurable time. Files leave local storage only after no local domain retains them.

features.name: OS recycle-bin handoff
features.detail: Documentation says final physical deletion tries the OS recycle bin by default, providing another possible recovery stage, not a universal guarantee.

features.name: Undo limited curation actions
features.detail: Inbox/archive and trash can be reversed; duplicate filters allow going back before commit. Auto-resolution undo explicitly cannot reverse metadata merges.

features.name: Immutable managed media bytes
features.detail: Stored originals are expected not to change; editing requires export, external edit and reimport. Metadata remains in catalogue/exports rather than in-place media edits.

features.name: Integrated backup of normal installations
features.detail: Set backup location then lock and mirror database/media, copying changes thereafter. Distributed storage disables simple backup and needs a coordinated external backup with client shut down.

features.name: Scheduled file-content integrity tasks
features.detail: Maintenance tasks check expected presence/content to discover corruption or external changes, optionally move bad bytes aside, remove records or enqueue URL redownload; heavier than presence-only checking.

features.name: Reconcile missing and orphaned files
features.detail: Queue missing-file checks/redownload from known URLs, export hashes/tags/URLs for recovery, and move orphaned payloads to a review location for deletion/reimport.

features.name: Rebuild derived metadata selectively
features.detail: Regenerate metadata, thumbnails, supplementary MD5/SHA1/SHA512, pHash, pixel hash, blurhash and embedded-metadata presence flags independently.

features.name: Offline local archive
features.detail: Default client connects to no repository and searches local databases; network downloading/sharing is optional.

features.name: No mandatory media upload
features.detail: Every upload requires a conscious action according to introduction; the project states it never phones home.

features.name: Delayed repository account anonymisation
features.detail: Repository content attribution is reassigned to a null account after default 90 days, configurable by operator; does not eliminate IP/content inference or malicious-server risks.

limitations.text: Hydrus copies originals into managed hash storage and will not index them in place. Filename/folder context can be imported as tags but is not preserved as its primary organization.

Local file domains are overlapping membership lists; independent catalogues require separate database directories. All managed media subfolders must be located before boot, so disconnected-volume browsing is unsupported.

Large catalogues may contain millions of files, but docs warn that roughly 40,000 files on one page or 150,000 in a session can cause lag; hardware varies. PTR processing is heavy and recommended only with SSD.
No fully headless client is currently supported; a user-reported offscreen workaround is not an official headless mode. macOS lacks mpv and current packaged .app; Wayland has mpv/UI caveats.
Store SQLite locally, not on unreliable network locking or live cloud-sync folders. External backup must capture all related databases together while the client is stopped.

Deleting a file does not erase tags/ratings/notes/URLs and historical records; comprehensive purge is still being developed. Drive encryption must come from the OS/external storage tools, not an asserted built-in vault.

Automatic duplicate rules may delete/merge without review; undo does not undo metadata merge. Pairwise visual confidence is not mathematical identity; detailed relationship history/UI remain incomplete and giant alternate sets scale poorly.
Downloader credentials are not securely stored; simple login scripts are described as old and fragile. API defaults to HTTP and network services disclose data to configured endpoints.
Repository synchronization usually propagates on roughly 100,000-second periods, not instant sharing. Subscriptions assume newest-first listings and may miss late-tagged content or historical gaps.

Native face recognition, GPS photo mapping, RAW camera decoding, general photo editing and a durable per-file-operation crash-recovery journal are not established. External AI/video tools are recorded only as plugins.

gaps: Third-party integrations not executed or exhaustively inventoried as core features.
No public code run, benchmark or security audit; older example/UI wording is qualified against current platform and release notes.

Focused localization/translation documentation search and inspected manuals did not establish translated application UI; arbitrary-language tags and third-party tools are not counted as UI localization.

R31.privacy_model: Core browsing/file operations address on-device media. Hidden-album and delete password/fingerprint gates are UI authorization, not established file encryption. Static maps send coordinates to Google, Mapbox or Tyler/Stamen services; their legacy endpoints were not tested.

Frozen dev cfec78746776ed4bbccf9387bfc3f6ba1bb2c181; latest manifest release v0.6-beta-1 dates to 2016, while root changelog describes v0.7 features.

limitations.text: Unmaintained source and very old release; development-branch features are not guaranteed in the downloadable v0.6-beta-1 APK or on modern Android storage restrictions.
Date sorting is modification-based, while date repair is explicitly unfinished. Search is marked coming soon; affix availability is uncertain.
Map implementations request remote URLs containing coordinates, including legacy HTTP endpoints; no offline-map or provider availability guarantee is established.
Password/fingerprint checks gate actions but do not establish encryption of originals. Media deletion invokes filesystem removal and MediaStore deletion; no recovery journal was established.

gaps: No substantive end-user manual in repository; complete source handlers and both changelogs were used.
Development-source implementation was not built or executed; hidden/unfinished actions are not counted as present.

features.name: Command-line duplicate workflow
features.detail: Accepts multiple directory arguments and reports duplicate groups; deletion is a separately requested mode.

features.name: Scan files in place
features.detail: Searches supplied filesystem paths directly, with no managed import or image-format requirement in the matching pipeline.

features.name: Size and MD5 matching
features.detail: Candidate files are compared by size and MD5 signatures before normal final byte comparison; this is byte-content matching, not perceptual similarity.

features.name: Verify candidate equality byte by byte
features.detail: Ordinary duplicate detection confirms hashes using a byte-by-byte comparison. Quick summary explicitly bypasses this stage.

features.name: Control recursion per directory argument
features.detail: --recurse traverses all supplied roots; --recurse: traverses only roots positioned after that option, permitting mixed shallow/deep scans.

features.name: Optional symlink traversal
features.detail: --symlinks follows symlinked directories; manual warns that keeping a link while deleting its target can lose the usable file.

features.name: Choose whether existing hard links count
features.detail: Multiple names pointing to the same disk area normally do not count as duplicates; --hardlinks includes them. This option does not create hard links.

features.name: Minimum and maximum file sizes
features.detail: --minsize and --maxsize restrict candidates inclusively using byte counts.

features.name: Exclude hidden and empty files
features.detail: --nohidden excludes hidden files and --noempty excludes zero-length files; arbitrary scan-time path glob exclusions are not established by this manual.

features.name: Require matching ownership and permissions
features.detail: --permissions prevents files with different owner, group or permission bits from being considered duplicates.

features.name: Persistent signature database
features.detail: --cache reuses signatures between comparisons; manual explicitly says availability depends on the system/build.

features.name: Manage cached signatures
features.detail: Cache supports readonly, orphan pruning, clearing and vacuuming. Maintenance can run without directory arguments and still takes effect with readonly; operation order is clear, prune, update, vacuum.

features.name: Text duplicate-group reports
features.detail: Default output separates groups by blank lines; --sameline places a group on one line and escapes spaces/backslashes. Options omit the first member and include size or modification time.

features.name: Duplicate summary and quick estimate
features.detail: --summarize reports duplicate information; --quicksummary skips the slower byte-verification phase and must not be treated as fully verified equality.

features.name: Interactive keeper selection
features.detail: Keep/delete tags can be set for individual files, lists of indices, or selected subsets; prune can process reviewed subsets incrementally.

features.name: Keep an entire group
features.detail: The interactive all command tags every member of the current group for keeping.

features.name: All-copy deletion refused in screen mode
features.detail: Interactive prune refuses groups with every file tagged for deletion; at least one member must be tagged for keeping.

features.name: Path and regex-based review selection
features.detail: Select/deselect by substring, prefix, suffix, exact path or PCRE2 expression; clear or invert selections within affected sets before tagging them.

features.name: Noninteractive and immediate deletion
features.detail: --delete --noprompt retains the first ordered member and removes others. --immediate deletes as matches arrive without collecting groups and implies no prompt.

features.name: Deterministic output and keeper ordering
features.detail: Order by modification time (default), status-change time or filename, with reversal; changelog documents ctime tie-breaking for mtime.

features.name: Defer verification until deletion
features.detail: --deferconfirmation postpones byte-level equality checks in interactive mode until immediately before deletion.

features.name: Review tags before pruning
features.detail: Interactive mode separates tagging from deletion via DELETE/prune, while plain line prompts remain available; --noprompt and --immediate deliberately bypass review.

features.name: Recheck changed files before removal
features.detail: Version 2.2.0 documents checking whether files marked duplicate changed during execution before deleting them; this is not a permanent integrity journal.

features.name: Log deletion choices
features.detail: --log writes file-deletion choices to a chosen logfile; documentation does not describe rollback or saved file contents.

features.name: Keyboard-driven terminal review
features.detail: Screen mode supports paging, file/group navigation, selected-group jumps, direct goto, keep/delete hotkeys and command help; --plain or unsupported screen builds use line prompts.

limitations.text: Deleting while traversing symlinks can retain a link but remove its target; specifying a directory repeatedly can make a file appear as its own duplicate.
Quick summary skips byte-level confirmation. Cache and screen-mode availability vary by build/system.

Inspected documents do not establish trash/undo, perceptual matching, image previews, metadata editing, hard-link replacement, or scan-time arbitrary path exclusion; --hardlinks only changes treatment of existing hard links.

gaps: Photo-specific capabilities are not documented; this profile intentionally inventories the duplicate CLI rather than inferring a media manager.
No runtime or platform compatibility tests were performed.

R33.summary: Android gallery combining local/removable/cloud media, optional on-device semantic search and people grouping, encrypted vaults, advanced photo/video editing and provider-aware backup workflows.
deployment: Android APKs via GitHub/F-Droid/Obtainium
Paid Google Play distribution supporting development, not a separately documented feature tier

Optional self-hosted ReFra Handover inference companion
R33.storage_model: Browses Android-indexed device/removable media in place, with app databases for collections, extracted metadata, people corrections and search indexes. Cloud account listings, cached previews, downloaded originals and backed-up device originals are distinct states. Vault files are encrypted; private folders are ordinary files hidden with .nomedia. Current editor writes copies; legacy editor can overwrite with a retained edit backup.
R33.privacy_model: Local AI can run entirely on-device after models are installed or bundled. Offline builds remove network permissions, cloud and interactive maps. Standard optional features can send query text to Immich, thumbnails/sampled frames to self-hosted Handover, or an image/decrypted vault copy to an external visual-search app. Vault backups contain decrypted media inside optionally encrypted archives; logs can contain paths/server addresses despite release shorthand about anonymization.
maturity_notes: Pinned website manuals describe current implementation including newer editor/remote-inference/search-engine behavior; do not assume all current-branch capabilities shipped in 5.2.2. Explicit legacy editor pages are kept separate.
README still says minimum Android 11; 5.2.2 release says Android 10/API29. Trash and some replace flows still explicitly require Android 11+.
Current docs list CLIP and EmbeddingGemma 2; model accuracy/speed/language comparisons are project claims, not tested benchmarks.
Google Play payment is a distribution/support choice; free builds are also documented.

features.name: Cross-folder media-type albums
features.detail: Virtual Photos/Videos/GIF/RAW albums cover all folders and can be shown/hidden as a Library section.

features.name: RAW+JPEG display stacks
features.detail: Timeline groups related RAW/JPEG members into a stack cell with access to members; not duplicate deletion.

features.name: Burst and edited-copy grouping
features.detail: Optional smart grouping collapses burst shots and edited copies into timeline stacks without implying an automatic best-shot/culling score.

features.name: Filename and description search
features.detail: Without AI, queries match stored filename/description; matching category/place/album shortcuts and removable search history appear during typing, excluding locked albums.

features.name: On-device descriptive search
features.detail: Installed CLIP indexes images; current EmbeddingGemma 2 engine also indexes sampled video content and is documented as multilingual. Results sort by accuracy/date and show indexing progress; engine changes rebuild index.

features.name: Image/video example search
features.detail: Choose an example from timeline/albums for similarity-ranked results; current video-aware engine can sample several frames from a video query. Distinct from sending data to Google Lens.

features.name: Metadata discovery categories
features.detail: Discovery exposes locations, media types, camera models, special modes and groupings; release notes add synced server tags into metadata search.

features.name: Timeline media filters
features.detail: Timeline controls filter type, favorite state, year or album, independently of descriptive AI search.

features.name: Install feature-specific local models
features.detail: Intelligence Hub manages separate search (~150–320 MB), face (~131 MB) and cutout (~44 MB) packs. Bundled builds can restore without downloads; scan-only-while-charging and skip-hidden settings are available, while locked albums are never scanned.

features.name: Detect local face regions
features.detail: Face model pack enables detected-face strips, face scanning and editor blur/mosaic actions; current Standard tier uses UltraFace plus ArcFace.

features.name: Deterministic person grouping
features.detail: Local scan groups faces into New/Named people; regroup can rebuild after new media or mistaken merges. 5.2 release identifies deterministic batch clustering.

features.name: Identity matching across photos
features.detail: Recognition models match recurring faces into person groups; 5.2.2 rescans preserve names using face matching rather than recreating unnamed groups.

features.name: Name and personalize people
features.detail: Name people, store birthdays and choose face covers; local/cloud person sources can be selected independently.

features.name: Correct and suppress person groups
features.detail: Confirm/reject possible duplicates, merge groups, remove individual faces/photos from a person, hide/unhide and delete a person while suppressing those faces from future grouping; photos themselves remain.

features.name: Blur a person's faces in copies
features.detail: Blur everywhere creates new copies of photos containing the selected person; face models also enable local blur/mosaic editor tools.

features.name: Custom semantic collections
features.detail: Define categories with text description, optional example photos and Broad/Balanced/Strict/Exact preference; preview matches, pin/set cover and optionally exclude videos. Categories classify locally but do not imply embedded tag writing.

features.name: Interactive subject segmentation
features.detail: Model-backed long-press or editor Cutout/Remove background uses include/exclude points with undo/redo/refinement; copy/share/save transparent PNG while keeping original.

features.name: Optional self-hosted Handover engine
features.detail: Companion server receives resized JPEGs/video sample frames, not originals, and returns embeddings; choose device/server/both index placement and remote ranking. Bearer/HMAC authentication, per-user indexes, chunked background jobs and retries are documented; HTTP warns of unencrypted traffic.

features.name: Delegate search to connected server
features.detail: Cloud smart-search setting lets capable servers, currently Immich, answer queries; separate provider-type switches download thumbnails for local indexing, including NAS providers without their own AI.

features.name: Image handoff to Lens-like apps
features.detail: Separate Visual search shares current image/video frame with chosen installed app, can convert unsupported formats and needs explicit vault-item allowance because temporary decrypted data is exposed.

features.name: Alternative face model quality tiers
features.detail: Fast and Accurate face-grouping tiers are explicitly Coming soon; Standard is the available tier.

features.name: Resume and retry Smart scans
features.detail: Incremental refresh preserves valid results, skips failures, supports paused/resumable states and retries failed items; cancelling keeps completed work.

features.name: Selective metadata/AI rebuilds
features.detail: Independently refresh metadata, embeddings, categories or people, or run all in sequence; full refresh deliberately reprocesses complete items. Category reset deletes custom categories but not photos.

features.name: Detailed media metadata viewer
features.detail: Displays label/path, capture time, dimensions/size, video duration/fps/format, print density when present and complete metadata list, with cloud/encryption state badges.

features.name: Edit labels and descriptions
features.detail: Media Info edits labels/descriptions; video descriptions remain only in the app database rather than embedded file metadata. Direct filename rename is a separate action.

features.name: Correct capture dates with explicit fallback
features.detail: Date/time edits drive capture-sorted timeline. Unsupported formats offer a dated PNG copy instead, warning that PNG flattens animation/HDR/layers/RAW; original can be kept or explicitly trashed.

features.name: Selective lossless metadata sanitization
features.detail: Remove all or selected found categories: location, dates, device/owner, captions/authorship, camera, people, edit history, credentials, thumbnail. Supports JPEG/PNG/WebP/GIF/JP2/JXL/HEIF/AVIF/MP4/MOV/3GP; preserves media data, orientation, profiles, HDR gain maps and motion clip.

features.name: Verify sanitization and restricted moves
features.detail: Sanitization re-reads output to check removed/retained metadata and exact media payload before saving; restricted Android-folder moves copy/verify before requesting deletion permission. This is operation-specific, not perpetual integrity checking.

features.name: Device and cloud favorites
features.detail: Favorite badges/filtering span local/cloud library; release routes supported local favorites through Android request APIs and backup can restore matched favorites.

features.name: Interactive media location map
features.detail: MapLibre-based map reads existing media GPS after permission, not live tracking; display follows app/light/dark styles and can need a CARTO key. Offline build substitutes place list without tiles.

features.name: Map clusters linked to media grid
features.detail: Nearby markers form numbered clusters, tapping zooms or opens a colocated-photo sheet; marker selection and grid scrolling stay linked.

features.name: City/country/trip browsing
features.detail: Places list groups by cities/countries with photo/place/country counts, per-location timelines and recent trips when available, including builds without interactive map.

features.name: Manual coordinate editing
features.detail: Map manual explicitly says no in-app coordinate editing; removing existing location metadata is supported separately.

features.name: RAW previews and development
features.detail: Viewer previews camera RAW; current editor develops DNG/CR2/CR3/NEF/NRW/ARW/RAF/ORF/RW2/PEF/SRW. Viewer format support alone does not mean every editor accepts the file.

features.name: RAW sensor development controls
features.detail: White-balance presets/custom temp/tint; exposure/tone; sharpening; Linear/VNG/PPG/AHD/DCB demosaic; denoise and half resolution; sRGB/AdobeRGB/Wide/ProPhoto output; clip/blend/rebuild highlights. TIFF 8/16 export only holds development, not additional crop/markup/look edits.

features.name: HEIC/HEIF and HDR images
features.detail: HEIC/HEIF viewing includes supported HDR/gain-map paths; 5.2.2 adds bundled deep-12-bit decoding fixes. Display HDR remains device-dependent and editing may flatten it.

features.name: AVIF viewing
features.detail: AVIF is a supported viewer format, including 12-bit decoding fixes in 5.2.2.

features.name: JPEG XL viewing and conditional export
features.detail: JXL viewer support and persistent heavy-format thumbnails are documented; exporting JXL from current editor additionally depends on encoder availability.

features.name: Animated image viewing
features.detail: GIF/animated WebP/APNG full-resolution rendering is in 5.1 release; moving GIF thumbnails can be disabled. Editing/export does not guarantee preserving animation.

features.name: SVG and design-image previews
features.detail: Viewer opens SVG, flattened PSD and JP2/J2K; SVG is rendered as pixels and PSD layers are not editable merely because the file previews.

features.name: Embedded Motion Photo playback
features.detail: Detects embedded clips, exposes Motion toggle and frame strip; listed families include Google Motion Photos/Samsung Live Photos/Micro Videos. This is not a claim of Apple image+MOV pairing.

features.name: Extract motion clips or selected frames
features.detail: Save embedded motion as a separate video or use frame picker for stills without changing source. Editing its still creates a separate image copy.

features.name: Photo tone, color and effects
features.detail: Current tool catalogue includes light/color/curves/white balance, looks/detail/vignette/lens blur/grain/tone/posterize/edges/borders, with histogram channels and clipping display.

features.name: Crop, straighten and perspective
features.detail: Current editor includes crop/straighten/perspective tools, with on-canvas grid and explicit Apply/Reset recipe steps.

features.name: Layered photo compositing
features.detail: Up to sixteen JPEG/PNG image layers, locked base, reorder/duplicate/hide/lock, transforms, five blend modes, opacity, clipping and erase/paint masks; output flattens visible layers and missing source media can be relinked on recovery.

features.name: Photo markup tools
features.detail: Current catalogue includes Markup; with face models, blur/mosaic face operations are available. Detailed brush shapes are not inferred.

features.name: Compare edited and original images
features.detail: Hold canvas to view original or drag split-view divider; geometry changes switch to whole-original comparison because alignment no longer matches.

features.name: Current editor saves new copies
features.detail: Current photo/video editor never alters opened originals; outputs go to Pictures/ReFra or Movies/ReFra with randomized edited suffix. Unsaved changes/export cancellation require confirmation.

features.name: Editing undo and original restoration
features.detail: Current recipes/layer actions have undo/redo and recover committed edits if Android stops app. Legacy editor can revert overwrite only while its separate original edit backup remains; not a general file-operation undo.

features.name: Explicit copy export formats
features.detail: Current editor exports JPEG/PNG/WebP and encoder-dependent HEIF/JXL; Original copy preference retains JPEG quality or PNG losslessness. Removed-background copies become PNG. Legacy editor has different format/overwrite behavior.

features.name: Multitrack video editing
features.detail: Current MP4/QuickTime editor supports frame-precise in/out trims, split/delete/duplicate/reorder, ripple insertion, linked audio, snapping, multiple tracks and overlays.

features.name: Per-clip video picture changes
features.detail: Transform/crop Fit/Fill/Crop, scale/rotation/position/horizontal flip/background plus per-clip light/color/curves and opacity.

features.name: Export H.264/AAC MP4 copies
features.detail: Current export summary specifies size, constant fps, H.264/automatic bitrate and stereo 48 kHz AAC when audio reaches mix, with progress/retry and untouched source.

features.name: Voice-over and multitrack audio
features.detail: Import audio, record local voice-over or extract clip sound; mix gain/pan/fades/mute/solo/master limiter, channel routing/mono downmix, sidechain ducking and three-band EQ/high-pass.

features.name: Encrypted multiple vaults
features.detail: Create multiple encrypted vaults with device security or custom PIN/pattern/password and timed lockout; optional list gate/one-lock mode. Encrypt & Keep retains plaintext originals; Encrypt & Delete removes them explicitly.

features.name: Locked but unencrypted private folder
features.detail: Choose internal/SD/USB directory and optional device/custom gate; .nomedia removes files from normal scans. Files remain readable by direct-storage tools; removal of configuration can keep or remove hiding marker.

features.name: Android trash with restore
features.detail: On Android 11+ supported device media normally has roughly 30-day provider-controlled retention, individual/all restore or permanent empty. Disabling trash, unsupported sources and private-folder deletes are permanent.

features.name: Provider-aware delete review
features.detail: 5.2.2 lets backed-up selections target device/cloud/both with remembered preference and warns when sources lack trash. Trash confirmations can be enabled; remote-backup-row deletion has an explicit no-extra-confirmation exception.

features.name: Local and cloud file transfers
features.detail: Copy/move picker supports new folders, device/removable/cloud destinations and authentication for locked albums. Read-only targets are disabled; partial transfers report retained sources.

features.name: Rename original files
features.detail: Viewer Rename changes actual filename with Android write permission as needed; distinct from description/label editing. Inspected docs establish individual rename, not batch templates.

features.name: Number cloud destination collisions
features.detail: Folder-based WebDAV/SMB/NFS transfer collisions create numbered filenames rather than overwriting; current editor outputs also use random suffixes.

features.name: Multi-account server media access
features.detail: Connect Immich, Nextcloud, ownCloud, WebDAV, SMB or NFS depending on build; local/cloud listings merge but capabilities vary. Google Photos is explicitly not supported.

features.name: WebDAV and DAV-based providers
features.detail: WebDAV/Nextcloud/ownCloud accounts browse/upload alongside SMB/NFS; server-side people/search/archive/memories cannot be assumed on simple shares.

features.name: Per-account album backup
features.detail: Background upload selects local albums and destination accounts, separate cellular rules for photos/videos, charging requirement, album synchronization and account/video/per-album folder overrides; Immich manages its own physical layout.

features.name: Scheduled listing sync and optional deletion propagation
features.detail: 15-minute to daily approximate Android schedules, Wi-Fi-only auto sync, unrestricted manual sync and cold-start sync; opt-in remote deletions remove only app-downloaded copies, not arbitrary local originals.

features.name: Manage Immich albums
features.detail: 5.2.2 populates shared/v3 albums and allows owned-album rename/share/delete/member removal. Same-account Copy adds membership; Move is explicitly unsupported because albums are not folders.

features.name: Reuse identical downloaded copies
features.detail: 5.2.2 links identical existing local files instead of re-downloading Immich assets and places downloads in account/album folders, not the server's internal storage tree.

features.name: Free space only after backup verification
features.detail: Scan verified backed-up originals, retain favorites and choose age threshold (default Never); daily/three-day/weekly auto cleanup can run, but without All Files Access requests review instead of silent deletion.

features.name: Bound global cloud preview cache
features.detail: 256/512 MB or 1/2/5 GB global cache limits evict oldest cached items; pin whole accounts for previews, cache while browsing and optionally Wi-Fi only. Preview cache is not downloaded originals.

features.name: Offline browsing of cached remote previews
features.detail: Force offline uses only cache; account pinning downloads thumbnails/previews with partial-progress/retry status, and per-account/auto-only cache clears retain accounts/listings.

features.name: Persistent heavy-format thumbnails
features.detail: 5.2.2 persists JXL/PSD/JP2/TIFF/RAW/deep-bit-depth HEIF thumbnails to disk rather than regenerating each launch.

features.name: Manage existing Immich shared links
features.detail: Shared Links lists existing provider links, copies URLs, edits description/download/upload/metadata permissions and revokes links without deleting media. Current app has no create-link screen.

features.name: Set password on existing cloud shares
features.detail: Where Immich share-management exposes it, edit a pre-existing link's password; creation remains in server UI.

features.name: Edit cloud-share expiry
features.detail: Existing link expiry choices range from one day to one year or never; app can revoke with confirmation, contingent on provider support.

features.name: LAN photo/video casting
features.detail: FCast-compatible receiver required, discovered by mDNS or entered manually at default port 46899; remote pause/seek/speed controls depend on receiver codec support. No Chromecast protocol is involved.

features.name: Photo and grid home-screen widgets
features.detail: Single photo or size-dependent 2x2/4x4/6x6 grids with original, black-white or icon/emoji presentation; tap opens exact photo, styles do not edit files. Widget image has no separate unlock gate.

features.name: Accept external Android edit requests
features.detail: Current editor accepts JPEG/PNG/video edit intents and returns the saved copy to caller while also retaining it in ReFra output folders.

features.name: Selective app-state export and merge restore
features.detail: Archive settings, favorites, cloud configs, groups/collections/categories, metadata/locations, people corrections and optional edit originals/vaults; merge restore keeps existing data and resumes after restart. Ordinary photos outside vaults and biometric/semantic embeddings are excluded.

features.name: Password-protected backup archive
features.detail: Optional archive password protects exported vault media, which is decrypted inside archive; vault custom credentials are included only with protected archives. Without archive password restored vault uses device lock.

features.name: Conservative app-data health cleanup
features.detail: Daily/on-library-change or manual cleanup removes orphaned extracted data/memberships/edit backups, preserving cloud cache rows and user definitions such as people/collections/vaults.

features.name: Session and crash logs
features.detail: Hidden Developer menu exposes grouped/recent logs, severity/date search, breadcrumbs, crash reports, ZIP/copy export and clear/disable controls. Docs warn filenames, paths and server URLs may remain; not an operation-recovery journal.

limitations.text: Current-branch manuals include newer editor/Handover/EmbeddingGemma behavior not proven shipped in 5.2.2; legacy and new editor storage/overwrite behavior differ.
README minimum Android 11 conflicts with newer 5.2.2 Android10 requirement; Trash and sanitizer Replace original require Android11+. Provider/private-folder exceptions can permanently delete.

Vault Encrypt & Keep leaves plaintext originals; sharing/visual search decrypts readable copies. Backup carries vault contents decrypted and excludes ordinary photos, so unpassworded archive exposes those vault files.
Metadata cleaner excludes TIFF/RAW/PSD/SVG/BMP/MKV/WebM; some video GPS telemetry cannot be removed. It does not erase visible faces or identifying filenames.
No manual GPS editing, projection selector/VR panorama mode, Google Photos cloud provider or in-app share-link creation. Same-Immich-account Move and mixed local/cloud batch Move are unsupported.

Cloud sync generally refreshes listings, pinned offline cache holds previews, and ordinary app backups exclude media originals. These operations must not be mistaken for full independent photo backups.
Media Info backup-row deletion permanently removes that remote copy immediately without an additional confirmation or Trash step.

Current RAW TIFF export supports only development, not added crop/markup/look changes; unsupported date writes use PNG copies that flatten animation/HDR/layers/RAW. Viewing support does not guarantee editing/encoding support.

Offline NoML cannot fetch missing models. Face Fast/Accurate tiers remain planned. Remote search/Handover/Lens deliberately send queries or derived media elsewhere, and logs need review before sharing.
No exact duplicate-cleanup tool, durable file-action crash journal, general E2EE cloud sync or bundled offline basemap was established; similar-media search is not exact deduplication.

gaps: Release-to-current-branch feature boundary is not fully mapped; current manuals and legacy pages are explicitly distinguished.
Individual cloud-provider credentials/authorization and every appearance/accessibility preference were not exhaustively audited.
No runtime performance, cryptographic implementation or file-safety tests were performed; claims are documentary.

R34.summary: High-throughput file-content deduplication CLI with inspectable reports, replica-count policies and filesystem-aware linking/deduplication; not a visual photo manager.
deployment: Native command-line executable on Linux, macOS and Windows
Linux Snap, Homebrew, release binaries and Rust source distribution
Separate fclones-gui project, not part of this inventory
R34.storage_model: Reads arbitrary existing files in place; optional persistent hash database in the user's OS cache directory. Reports separate discovery from deletion/move/link/reflink actions.
R34.privacy_model: Documented filesystem-local pipeline; external preprocessing commands are optional and have their own behavior. No cloud account or upload is required by the documented workflow.
maturity_notes: Pinned a74f90d293e05856d19a4c0ac2b29b46ef16cf23; latest release v0.35.0, 2025-03-03.
README says Linux is best supported and some optimizations are Linux-only. Published benchmarks concern older releases/hardware and were not reproduced.

features.name: Composable command-line workflow
features.detail: group emits reports; remove, move, link and dedupe consume previous discovery results. Input paths can come from arguments or stdin for composition with tools such as find.

features.name: Content-hash duplicate groups
features.detail: Groups by length, file identity, prefix hash, suffix hash and finally whole-content hash. Default MetroHash128 can be replaced by xxhash3, BLAKE3, SHA-256/512 or SHA3-256/512.

features.name: Bytewise verification
features.detail: Algorithm documentation explicitly says no byte-by-byte file comparison is performed; identity relies on size and hashes.

features.name: Unique and under/over-replicated files
features.detail: Can report unique files or groups below/above a chosen replication factor, rather than only pairs of duplicates.

features.name: Multiple scan roots
features.detail: One invocation accepts multiple files/directories and recursively scans directories with a configurable depth limit.

features.name: Match only across independent trees
features.detail: --isolate counts matching content within one root as one replica, distinguishing cross-tree backups from repeated paths inside a tree; removal can retain/drop a root's matching files together.

features.name: Glob/regex inclusion and exclusion
features.detail: Filename/path patterns, excluded paths, case-insensitive mode and Perl-compatible regex alternatives constrain scans. Hidden files and .gitignore/.fdignore matches are skipped unless overridden.

features.name: Minimum/maximum size
features.detail: Inclusive byte-size bounds accept decimal/binary units; minimum defaults to one byte.

features.name: Single-filesystem matching
features.detail: --one-fs skips nested mount points and cross-filesystem symlinks and avoids matching across devices/filesystems.

features.name: Existing-link accounting
features.detail: Normally counts multiple links to the same underlying file only once. Flags independently control following/reporting symbolic links, matching links and isolated-root replica semantics.

features.name: Keeper and replica policies
features.detail: Default report order preserves earlier entries; priorities can instead select removal by creation/modification/access time, Unix status-change time or nesting depth. At least one retained replica is required by the action CLI.

features.name: Protected file/path patterns
features.detail: --keep-name and --keep-path prevent matching entries being removed; action --name/--path restrict the eligible deletion set.

features.name: Reviewable machine-readable reports
features.detail: Exports default text with hashes/sizes, fdupes-compatible text, CSV or JSON. Removal tools accept default and JSON reports, allowing manual editing before action.

features.name: Non-mutating action preview
features.detail: --dry-run emits planned filesystem operations instead of executing them; output can be redirected with the CLI output option.

features.name: Hard-link replacement
features.detail: link defaults to replacing redundant copies with hard links to retained content.

features.name: Symbolic-link replacement
features.detail: link --soft replaces redundant files with symbolic links; link-following/matching combinations require care to avoid leaving dangling references.

features.name: Filesystem-native copy-on-write dedupe
features.detail: dedupe shares underlying file data without removing filenames on supported filesystems. This feature is explicitly unavailable on Windows.

features.name: Move redundant copies
features.detail: move sends selected redundant files to a target directory instead of deleting or linking them; this is not described as an OS trash integration.

features.name: Delete redundant files
features.detail: remove permanently removes selected redundant entries using the separately reviewed report and keeper policies.

features.name: External preprocessing before matching
features.detail: --transform invokes an external program per file, with pipe or $IN/$OUT support. Documentation demonstrates stripping EXIF with exiv2 before matching, not perceptual image matching.

features.name: Protect originals during transforms
features.detail: $IN transformations use a temporary copy by default; --no-copy deliberately permits the external command to modify the original and is warned as data-loss-prone.

features.name: Changed-file action guards
features.detail: Actions check sizes against the report unless disabled, lock files unless --no-lock is selected and can skip whole groups if any file changed after --modified-before. Transformed reports automatically disable size checks.

features.name: Persistent reusable hash cache
features.detail: --cache stores hashes with identity, size and timestamps; unchanged files reuse hashes even after typical renames/moves. Metadata-stable modifications can make the cache stale.

features.name: Reuse interrupted hashing work
features.detail: README recommends persistent caching to resume large jobs quickly after interruption; it is hash reuse rather than a transactional deletion journal.

features.name: Storage-adaptive parallel processing
features.detail: Parallel directory traversal and staged hashing use separate per-device random/sequential pools, automatically tuned for HDD/SSD/removable/unknown devices and overridable with --threads.

features.name: Compressed paths for large trees
features.detail: README attributes low memory use on millions of paths to prefix-compressed representations; this is a project claim, not a measured result here.

features.name: Linux-specific I/O optimization
features.detail: Orders accesses by physical placement and uses page-cache drop-behind on Linux; documentation says these optimizations are unavailable on other platforms.

features.name: Optional partial-hash-only matching
features.detail: --skip-content-hash bypasses whole-file hashing, with explicit false-positive warnings and advice to enlarge prefix/suffix samples. This mode is not safe exact-content verification.

features.name: Terminal-aware progress
features.detail: Reports scan/grouping progress; v0.35.0 limits default progress output to terminal stderr for cleaner redirected workflows.

features.name: Shell completion generation
features.detail: complete prints setup scripts for Bash, Zsh, Fish, Elvish and PowerShell; installation into the shell is manual.

features.name: Filesystem-local operation
features.detail: Documented core workflow reads local/mounted paths and writes local reports/actions; no hosted service is required.

limitations.text: Translated command-line help/output or a selectable UI language is not established by the inspected manual and CLI definitions; localization is left undocumented rather than marked unsupported.
No bytewise comparison is performed; skipping full-content hashes further weakens duplicate certainty.
Reflink deduplication is unsupported on Windows; physical-placement and cache-drop optimizations are Linux-only.
Combining --match-links with --symbolic-links can delete the only regular file and leave orphan symlinks. Cached hashes can be stale when changes preserve recorded metadata.

Photo display, perceptual near-duplicate detection, face/EXIF catalogue search, albums, maps and recoverable trash are not documented; arbitrary-file support must not be interpreted as media playback.

gaps: No standalone photo-oriented manual; the extensive README is the primary user manual, supplemented by CLI declarations and release notes.
No runtime/platform validation or benchmark reproduction.

R35.summary: On-device semantic and image-to-image search over an Apple Photos library, rather than a general-purpose photo catalogue.
deployment: iPhone and iPad, iOS 18 or later
App Store application
Buildable Swift/Core ML source; model bundles downloaded separately for development
R35.storage_model: Originals remain in the Apple Photos library. Asset IDs and 512-dimensional image embeddings are stored in the application's Documents directory using a binary main file, incremental append journal and deletion tombstones. This journal concerns the search index, not reversible file operations.
R35.privacy_model: Image/text inference and similarity search execute on-device. Photo requests disable network access during indexing; users can explicitly enable downloading full-resolution iCloud photos in the viewer. Optional sharing and feedback links leave the offline workflow. No encryption guarantee is established.
maturity_notes: Frozen manifest commit 19825faac5d1ea6da7a65fc4d6255ce785a09e2c on main; manifest contains no GitHub release.
Current README uses MobileCLIP S2, superseding the earlier OpenAI CLIP model. Older linked articles and model-export notebooks describe the legacy implementation.

The settings help describes paid App Store distribution; the repository itself is MIT-licensed. Android PicQuery and macOS Searchable are separate projects, not native distributions of this repository.

features.detail: Current README specifies iPhone/iPad on iOS 18 or later; source builds require separate MobileCLIP S2 model bundles.

features.name: Paid packaged App Store distribution
features.detail: In-app privacy guide describes paying for the application instead of a free app with network-dependent in-app purchases; this does not change the MIT source licence.

features.name: Search existing Apple Photos library
features.detail: Search controller opens the system user-library smart album and references PHAsset identifiers without importing originals into a second managed store.

features.name: Natural-language photo retrieval
features.detail: Encodes a text description and ranks saved image vectors by similarity; default top result count is 120 rather than an exact-keyword matching guarantee.

features.name: Search with an existing photo
features.detail: Swipe upward in a photo viewer to compare its stored embedding against the library and display similar photos; this is semantic similarity, not exact duplicate identification.

features.name: Adjust result set size
features.detail: Settings exposes a persisted 10–1000 result slider in increments of ten; actual results are bounded by indexed library size.

features.name: Multiple query languages
features.detail: In-app guide lists English, French, German, Spanish and Italian input and explicitly says English works best; comparative accuracy is not independently verified.

features.name: Bundled on-device image and text encoders
features.detail: MobileCLIP S2 encoders run through Core ML locally; model files are bundled in the installed app rather than retrieved for each search.

features.name: Offline indexing and search
features.detail: Indexing forcibly disables network photo requests and the guide describes airplane-mode use. iCloud-only originals may remain low-resolution until a user permits download.

features.name: No mandatory photo upload
features.detail: README says photos are not uploaded for search; inference and persisted vectors remain on-device. User-invoked sharing is separate.

features.name: Opt-in iCloud original retrieval
features.detail: A cloud-download button for a lower-quality asset enables network access and requests its maximum-size image. Offline operation remains available if declined.

features.name: Index only newly seen photo IDs
features.detail: Compares current asset IDs with saved embeddings and offers an Update index action for new photos. Collection observation does not itself imply automatic embedding generation.

features.name: Persist partial indexing progress
features.detail: Saves embeddings every 5,000 accumulated results, at completion and on caught indexing errors; later indexing skips already persisted IDs. Unsaved work may need repetition.

features.name: Batched on-device indexing
features.detail: Fetches images concurrently in batches of 32, performs batch Core ML prediction and falls back to single-image encoding if a batch fails.

features.name: GPU-accelerated embedding search
features.detail: Metal/MPSGraph multiplies normalized Float16 embeddings using persistent buffers and a cached graph; the controller provides CPU cosine-similarity fallback when GPU search is unavailable.

features.name: Incremental local index compaction
features.detail: Appends new embeddings and records deleted IDs, migrates the older archive format and compacts after a journal exceeds five million bytes or tombstones exist.

features.name: Ranked photo result collection
features.detail: Displays a prominent best match followed by the remaining photo collection and opens individual results in the photo viewer.

features.name: Zoom result photos
features.detail: Viewer wraps the image in a scroll view with 1×–20× zoom and displays the asset creation timestamp.

features.name: Share a viewed image
features.detail: SwiftUI ShareLink exports the displayed image with the search text used as its share preview; original-byte or EXIF preservation is not established.

features.name: Toggle Apple Photos favourite
features.detail: Viewer invokes the asset favourite update; this UI is conditional on the saved network-permission flag in the inspected implementation.

features.name: Delete a photo from results
features.detail: Viewer delegates deletion to the photo asset and removes its search embedding. The inspected viewer does not establish a separate application trash or operation journal.

features.name: Location display deliberately omitted
features.detail: The in-app privacy guide explicitly says photos do not show location information because the developer avoids its network requirement.

limitations.text: Indexing is a prerequisite; new photos may require manually updating the index. This is not a full background cloud library sync.
iCloud-only photos may be shown at lower quality until network download is authorised; offline operation does not guarantee offline availability of every original.
Settings warns of device-specific Core ML crashes or abnormal results. No accuracy or large-library benchmark was performed here.
Exact duplicate cleanup, face identity recognition, OCR, folder management, metadata editing, video playback and recovery guarantees are not established by the inspected sources.
App Store price/version parity with this unreleased branch snapshot is not verified; external Android/macOS projects must not be counted as this repository's shipped clients.

gaps: No GitHub release in frozen manifest; current branch and in-app documentation used.
Broader DAM and recovery features not established; no equivalence to external sibling products claimed.

R36.summary: Archived legacy PHP/MySQL image-sharing site for personal use and small communities; a deliberately reduced fork of Chevereto 3.16.2, not the current Chevereto product.
deployment: Self-hosted PHP 7.4 web application
MySQL 5.7/8 or MariaDB 10
Apache or Nginx with URL rewriting
R36.storage_model: Local uploads are registered in a relational database, with configurable flat or year/month/day storage and generated thumbnails/medium images. Public IDs are encoded. External-storage references remain in inherited documentation/schema but the release explicitly removes that feature.
R36.privacy_model: Can run as a public community or login-required private site, with album-level owner-only, link-accessible or password-gated content. These access controls and encoded URLs are not encrypted media storage. Optional CDN, spam checking, CAPTCHA, comments or analytics can involve outside services.
maturity_notes: Frozen 1.6 branch ee91365ae837c6159e2377dfe74ad97bf6f58382; latest release 1.6.2 dated 2022-01-07; repository archived.
Official status page states there will be no further fixes and advises migration to newer Chevereto. Current README says the projects must not be conflated.

Critical edition check: release-1.6.2 README explicitly lists removed/missing features. Official legacy docs contain inherited settings for some of these; the explicit release exclusion takes precedence.
PHP 8 is explicitly unsupported; neither current Chevereto V4 capabilities nor paid successor services are credited to this repository.
