features.name: Multiple UI languages in Free edition
features.detail: The 1.6.2 edition-scope README explicitly lists Multi-language Support among features removed from Chevereto-Free. Translated upstream resources or successor documentation do not establish this capability in the reduced fork.

features.name: Self-hosted image sharing
features.detail: Run the legacy PHP/MySQL application on one's own server; PHP 7.4 is required and PHP 8 is not supported.

features.name: Browser upload and gallery
features.detail: Web uploader, public explorer, image viewer and administrative dashboard are part of the legacy application.

features.name: Community accounts or personal mode
features.detail: Site can use community or single-user personal mode; administrators can enable/disable public registration.

features.name: Login-required private site
features.detail: Private website mode requires login and can force owner-only or link-accessible content policy per album.

features.name: User albums
features.detail: Images are organized into owner-associated albums with descriptions, image counts and editing tools.

features.name: Image/album links and embed codes
features.detail: Share viewer URLs and generated embed codes; IDs are encoded per installation and album sharing respects configured privacy.

features.name: Password-gated albums
features.detail: Album route implements password gates, session password checks and optional CAPTCHA after failed attempts; owners/content managers bypass the gate.

features.name: Guest uploads
features.detail: Enable guest uploading separately from authenticated uploads and apply a separate guest file-size maximum.

features.name: Remote URL image upload
features.detail: URL upload is configurable and API accepts remote source URLs; 1.6.2 specifically fixes its SSRF handling.

features.name: Concurrent browser uploads
features.detail: Upload UI can be embedded on-page or routed to /upload and uses configurable parallel upload threads.

features.name: Managed date folders or flat storage
features.detail: Configure nested YYYY/MM/DD or direct layout for future uploads; changing the setting does not relocate existing images.

features.name: Upload filename policies
features.detail: Choose original name, randomized name, original-plus-random or encoded ID naming; original-name collisions are randomized.

features.name: Original-name collision handling
features.detail: Documented original-filename upload mode randomizes colliding names rather than reusing the path.

features.name: Duplicate-upload acceptance control
features.detail: Enable or disable accepting duplicate uploads; inspected settings alone do not establish perceptual matching or a general duplicate-review interface.

features.name: Expiring hosted images
features.detail: Enable expirable uploads that are removed after a selected date and configure automatic guest-upload deletion. This deletes hosted content, not merely a share token.

features.name: File size and flood limits
features.detail: Separate guest/user file-size limits are bounded by PHP settings; flood protection controls minute/hour/day/week/month upload thresholds.

features.name: Web image formats
features.detail: Documented upload formats are JPG, PNG, BMP, GIF and WebP; this does not establish RAW/video playback.

features.name: Downscale oversized images
features.detail: Maximum pixel dimensions downscale larger uploads; thumbnail dimensions and medium-image fixed width or height are configurable.

features.name: Image watermarking
features.detail: Configure watermark image, position, relative size, opacity/margins, minimum image dimensions and applicable users/formats.

features.name: Configurable EXIF handling
features.detail: Site controls image EXIF handling and whether users can choose their own handling setting; no broad EXIF-write editor is inferred.

features.name: Site image categories
features.detail: Categories classify images and create category listings with name, URL key and description.

features.name: Tiled or masonry listings
features.detail: Fixed or fluid image listings with device-specific column counts and minimum image count for album exploration.

features.name: Classic or endless pagination
features.detail: Configure items/page and traditional page navigation or XHR-based endless append; not asserted as DOM virtualization.

features.name: Listing lightbox viewer
features.detail: Optional listing viewer provides full-screen image browsing.

features.name: Random public-image browsing
features.detail: Enable random public-image fetching independently of Explore and guest Explore.

features.name: Search images, albums and users
features.detail: Search route accepts image/album/user categories and query parameters; semantic/face/OCR search is not established.

features.name: Date ordering
features.detail: Album/search listing routes support date sorting and ascending/descending order; EXIF capture-date semantics are not established.

features.name: Size ordering
features.detail: Album/search listings support size ordering.

features.name: Popularity ordering
features.detail: Album/search listings support view-count sorting.

features.name: Manual NSFW display controls
features.detail: Hide or blur manually flagged NSFW content in listings, control inclusion in random results and lock user flag changes. This is not automatic moderation.

features.name: Expiring IP bans
features.detail: Ban IPv4/IPv6 addresses or ranges with an optional expiration date.

features.name: Signup and profile controls
features.detail: Configure email confirmation, minimum user age, profile-avatar/background size limits and whether users may delete their own content.

features.name: Signup/flood email notifications
features.detail: Configured mail can notify operators about signup or detected upload flooding.

features.name: Single-key upload API v1
features.detail: API v1 only uploads as guest, accepts file/URL/base64 sources and returns JSON, plain URL or redirect. Per-user attribution requires a custom route override; no dedicated API rate limiter beyond site flood limits.

features.name: External-editor popup uploader
features.detail: Embed PUP JavaScript in another site to upload without leaving its editor and automatically insert URL/HTML/BBCode/Markdown; supports named forum vendors, custom selectors, styles and dynamic editors.

features.name: ShareX capture/upload client
features.detail: Separate ShareX application has a Chevereto destination or custom uploader using API v1; guest attribution remains the default.

features.name: External comments
features.detail: Configure Disqus or arbitrary HTML/JavaScript comments on image views; not a native comments-store claim.

features.name: Optional spam/CAPTCHA services
features.detail: Legacy docs configure Akismet, StopForumSpam and reCAPTCHA thresholds; provider availability was not tested.

features.name: Static-resource CDN and analytics hooks
features.detail: Configure a pull-CDN URL for local static resources and analytics HTML in all views; neither is a claim of external original-image storage.

features.name: External storage servers
features.detail: 1.6.2 README explicitly removes External Storage Servers despite inherited docs/schema references.

features.name: Social-network login
features.detail: Explicitly removed from this Free fork; inherited social-signup settings must not be counted.

features.name: Moderation
features.detail: Explicitly removed from Free; inherited manual sections for upload approval/ModerateContent do not establish available moderation.

features.name: Likes and followers
features.detail: Explicitly removed from this fork.

features.name: Bulk content importing
features.detail: Release README explicitly removes bulk content import, distinct from ordinary parallel browser uploads.

features.name: Nested albums
features.detail: Listed among later Chevereto changes missing from Free.

features.name: 360-degree viewing
features.detail: Listed among successor features missing from Free.

features.name: CLI API
features.detail: Release README explicitly lists CLI API as absent; HTTP upload API is separately available.

limitations.text: Archived with no future security/bug fixes, and PHP 8 unsupported. Successor Chevereto capabilities and subscriptions must be evaluated separately.

Official legacy docs overstate this reduced fork in places: social login, external storage and moderation are explicitly removed; release README also excludes banners/multilanguage and later ImageMagick, nested albums, 360 viewing, UI/sharing upgrades and CLI API.
API v1 is a single-key, guest-attributed upload bridge intended for one's own applications, not a full public account/album API. User-targeted upload needs a code override.

Encoded identifiers and login/password gates are not E2EE or at-rest image encryption. No inspected evidence establishes recoverable deletion, operation journaling, face recognition, RAW processing, video playback or managed local-folder indexing.

gaps: Legacy docs retain upstream-only settings; explicit release exclusions take precedence, with core album/API/search checked in full source.
No current successor/paid-service claims or runtime provider compatibility tests are included.

R37.summary: Legacy self-hosted photo catalogue with locally run recognition, date/place/person/event groupings and experimental analytics; development moved to LibrePhotos.
deployment: Docker Compose with separate Django backend, React frontend, reverse proxy, PostgreSQL and Redis
R37.storage_model: Administrators assign filesystem scan directories per user. Models retain original image paths and database metadata, generate multiple thumbnail sizes and face crops, and serve originals through protected proxy routes. Nextcloud scanning copies remote contents to backend storage.
R37.privacy_model: Photo analysis uses server-local face_recognition and Places365 code; Mapbox reverse geocoding requires an external API key and sends location lookups. Self-hosting is not E2EE. Deployment examples contain placeholder admin credentials and secrets that must be changed.
maturity_notes: README explicitly labels this the old project for archive only and directs users to LibrePhotos; manifest has no release and last push in 2022.
Profile is confined to pinned dev 180de5746468ec64b725723e03657dc21317f3a9, not features of current LibrePhotos.

README describes a very early-stage experiment. Its sharing roadmap is stale relative to implemented backend handlers; code-supported capabilities below do not establish a polished or currently deployable UI.

features.name: Legacy browser photo-library frontend
features.detail: OwnPhotos documents a React frontend served separately from its Django REST backend and connected through a proxy. The browser library interface belongs to this archived-lineage experiment, not the current LibrePhotos frontend.

features.name: Self-hosted browser service
features.detail: OwnPhotos runs a backend API and separate browser frontend behind a proxy; Compose includes PostgreSQL and Redis.

features.name: Compose deployment
features.detail: Recommended deployment uses host mounts for source photos, protected thumbnails and logs plus a persistent database volume.

features.name: Scan original directories
features.detail: Library dashboard starts filesystem scanning of an admin-assigned per-user directory; Photo retains image_path and protected-media handler resolves original files.

features.name: Per-user libraries
features.detail: Admin area manages users and their scan directories; photos and albums carry ownership and manual-album titles are unique per owner.

features.name: Admin-controlled source access
features.detail: Only administrators may set filesystem scan roots, including their own; ordinary users may configure their own Nextcloud source instead.

features.name: Nextcloud directory import
features.detail: Users configure a Nextcloud endpoint/account and top-level folder, then explicitly scan; README says backend copies that folder's contents, not remote-only indexing.

features.name: Date-grouped browsing
features.detail: README advertises grouped-by-date photos; AlbumDate stores dated and no-date groups and returns descending EXIF time.

features.name: Virtualized photo frontend
features.detail: README explicitly identifies react-virtualized as its frontend optimization; no independent scale benchmark is asserted.

features.name: EXIF, capture time and GPS extraction
features.detail: Extraction saves serializable EXIF, DateTimeOriginal and latitude/longitude with hemisphere signs.

features.name: Infer missing dates from filenames
features.detail: If EXIF timestamp is unavailable, the model tries fuzzy date parsing of the filename and assigns UTC; this is inference, not a confirmed capture time.

features.name: Favorite photos
features.detail: Photo has a favorite field and API registers favorite-list and bulk favorite-edit routes.

features.name: Hide photos from normal browsing
features.detail: Photo has a hidden flag and dedicated hidden-list/hide endpoints; hiding is not evidence of encryption.

features.name: Face regions and crops
features.detail: face_recognition detects locations/encodings on thumbnails and persists face coordinates, encodings and JPEG crops.

features.name: Manually label people
features.detail: Selected face IDs can be assigned a person's name; manual labels are marked non-inferred with confidence 1.

features.name: Train classifier from labeled faces
features.detail: README describes labeling a sample and training a classifier to name remaining faces; training handler queues a per-user task.

features.name: Face-clustering endpoint
features.detail: Registered clusterfaces handler invokes cluster_faces for the requesting user; README identifies scikit-learn classification/clustering. No specific clustering accuracy is established.

features.name: Relabel or remove face detections
features.detail: Owner-checked handlers relabel selected faces or delete their face records without deleting the parent photograph.

features.name: Browse by identified person
features.detail: README explicitly supports viewing photos by people; person model obtains photos through face associations scoped to owner.

features.name: Automatic scene and content descriptions
features.detail: Active Places365 path stores attributes, scene categories and environment words in search_captions and creates thing albums. Densecap is named in README but disabled in the default caption-generation method.

features.name: Server-local recognition
features.detail: Photo methods call local face_recognition, Places365 inference and Im2Vec(cuda=False); this establishes local processing paths, not all-service offline operation.

features.name: Experimental on-demand im2txt captions
features.detail: A routed owner-checked handler calls _generate_captions_im2txt, but automatic im2txt and densecap paths are explicitly disabled and deployability/model availability was not established.

features.name: Backend image-similarity search
features.detail: Authenticated similar endpoint accepts an existing image hash and calls search_similar_image; Photo stores Im2Vec encodings. Algorithm/ranking and frontend availability were not established; not exact duplicate detection.

features.name: Custom albums
features.detail: README supports custom albums; AlbumUser stores owner, photos, cover photos and title independently of the source folders.

features.name: Automatic event albums and titles
features.detail: Queues event generation and title regeneration; title model combines weekday/time, common places and people, with special multi-day and weekend wording.

features.name: Place-level collections
features.detail: Mapbox location features create owner-scoped place albums at different geographic levels with up to four selected cover photos.

features.name: Automatic thing and scene albums
features.detail: Places365 attributes and categories each generate owner-scoped AlbumThing collections with representative cover photos.

features.name: View photos on a map
features.detail: Map viewing is listed as implemented; stored GPS coordinates and location-cluster endpoint support geographic browsing.

features.name: Mapbox reverse geocoding
features.detail: Requires a Mapbox API key; returned location feature text is persisted for search and album generation. Historical free-tier numbers in README are not a current pricing guarantee.

features.name: Location text search
features.detail: README lists location search; geocoding appends returned search_text to the photo's searchable location field.

features.name: Photo and album sharing to users
features.detail: Despite stale README roadmap, pinned backend has share/unshare handlers for photos and user albums plus shared-to/from-me routes; original access checks recognize these memberships.

features.name: Public photo access
features.detail: Owner-checked makepublic operation and media handler permit unauthenticated access to photos explicitly marked public; password/expiry semantics are not documented.

features.name: Multiple persisted thumbnail variants
features.detail: Produces tiny, small, medium and big proportional and square JPEG thumbnails, correcting EXIF orientation, plus face crops in protected media storage.

features.name: Queued analysis and progress records
features.detail: Scanning, event generation, title regeneration and face training enqueue asynchronous jobs; LongRunningJob tracks status, times and target/current progress.

features.name: Backend count and distribution endpoints
features.detail: Registered handlers expose library counts, monthly/country counts, location timeline/sunburst and search-word-cloud helpers; UI completeness and helper accuracy were not independently verified.

features.name: People graph endpoints
features.detail: Backend routes socialgraph and egograph to graph-building helpers, with person_id for ego view; these code paths are more specific than the old README's generic planned graphs.

features.name: REST and JWT API
features.detail: Django routes expose library, face, album, job and user operations with JWT obtain/refresh endpoints; this is an application API, not a stable-version guarantee.

features.name: User photo rotation/editing roadmap
features.detail: README lists basic editing such as rotation as longer-term work. Automatic EXIF orientation of thumbnails is implemented but is not a user editing feature.

features.name: Add undetected faces roadmap
features.detail: Tagging an undetected face is explicitly listed as upcoming, distinct from naming an already detected face.

limitations.text: Old project is retained for archive only; README recommends LibrePhotos and warns this code is early-stage experimentation.
Mapbox reverse geocoding requires an external key/service; Nextcloud import copies files and is not in-place remote browsing.
README sharing/graph roadmap conflicts with later backend implementation. Core labels based on code mean implemented backend paths, not verified frontend release behavior.
Natural-language caption generation is disabled in default automatic paths; a separate im2txt endpoint exists but its deployability is not established.
Hash storage does not establish a duplicate-review or deletion workflow. Trash, sidecar export, video playback, E2EE and current operational compatibility were not established.

gaps: No dedicated current manual/release exists in the manifest; inspected README setup plus pinned backend/deployment source.
Legacy frontend repository and runtime behavior not inspected; code-only capabilities are qualified.
Similarity/graph helper internals were not fully traced.

R38.summary: Go/Vue image-hosting gateway that routes uploads among local and third-party hosts and offers stable dispatch links, administration and local backup of remotely hosted images.
deployment: Self-hosted Go server with web UI and MySQL
Documented Linux VPS installation
Source build targets Linux, macOS and Windows; these are server deployments, not native gallery clients
R38.storage_model: MySQL tracks users, providers, image URLs/deletion tokens/local paths and dispatch records. Local uploads use upload-date folders and random names; remote adapters store images on external hosts. Optional synchronization downloads remote images into local backup records.
R38.privacy_model: Remote-provider uploads disclose image bytes to chosen hosts and dispatch can replicate them elsewhere. Local storage can avoid those uploads when chosen. User/IP records, authentication and upload restrictions exist, but no encrypted media/private-album model is established. Demo moderation statement is not proof of available local AI.

features.name: Stable redirect URLs over changing hosts
features.detail: V2 uploads to selected root, creates a dispatch/hash URL, starts secondary upload asynchronously and serves cached/provider redirects. Stable URL can outlive a provider target change.

features.name: Ranked redispatch and root fallback
features.detail: Dispatch checks target availability and attempts another ranked host, falling back to root when destinations are exhausted. Source contains TODO failure handling, so this is designed behavior rather than proven reliable failover.

features.name: Enable, reorder and weight providers

features.name: User accounts and administration
features.detail: README marks user system complete; admin API lists/deletes users and associates image records with uploading users.

features.name: Per-provider account requirements
features.detail: Provider Auth setting distinguishes guest, any signed-in user and administrator-only use; this is upload-provider access, not password-protected photo albums.

features.name: Configurable upload size and type restrictions
features.detail: Server enforces configured maximum size and allowed filename/MIME suffix combinations; this is not evidence of full decoding, malware scan or content-safety recognition.

features.name: IP-based upload blocking
features.detail: Configurable enabled middleware tracks attempts/time, temporary block period and threshold for persistent blocks; release 2.3.9 includes IP-block fixes.

features.name: Paged image and backup lists
features.detail: Admin lists image/dispatch/backup records with page/limit, provider filtering and ascending/descending ID order.

features.name: Download hosted images into local backups
features.detail: Admin-selected remote URLs are concurrently downloaded to server files and linked backup records; source uses a task lock and reports progress/completion or a 60-second inactivity timeout.

features.name: Asynchronous dispatch and synchronization
features.detail: Goroutines perform secondary host upload and multi-image local synchronization; no durable queue/checkpoint recovery is established.

features.name: Cache dispatch targets
features.detail: Dispatch stores URL targets with a 3600 cache duration and redirects directly on cache hits; release notes identify Redis cache fixes.

features.name: Clear all server caches
features.detail: Admin action calls ClearAll; group-selective cache clearing remains a TODO.

features.name: Image and usage dashboard
features.detail: Reports include images by provider, last-seven-day all/local image counts, recent registrations and API information, rendered as dashboard charts.

features.name: Admin logs and task events
features.detail: Paged logs and synchronization progress/completion messages expose operational status. These logs are not rollback/crash-recovery file journals.

features.name: Delete image and local-backup records
features.detail: Admin accepts ID lists; model deletes associated local paths and database rows. Inspected delete path does not establish revocation of every third-party hosted copy.

features.name: Content moderation
features.detail: README says the public demo has strict image moderation, but inspected CheckImage hook is empty and shared upload pipeline does not establish a configured classifier. Not counted as working core AI.

features.name: Automatic API documentation
features.detail: README unchecked roadmap item; manually written V1 API instructions already exist.

features.name: Internationalized interface
features.detail: README lists internationalization as unchecked TODO, not currently completed multilingual support.

features.name: Scheduled task execution
features.detail: README lists scheduled task dispatch as an unchecked roadmap item; asynchronous immediate work is separate.

limitations.text: Latest release is from 2019 and many adapters use old third-party endpoints. No assertion is made that any external host still accepts uploads or retains files indefinitely.
Provider descriptions themselves mention anti-hotlinking, moderation/cleanup, geographic reachability and unstable response formats; remote services control availability.
Application deletion removes catalogue/local files in inspected source but does not establish removal of all remote replicas; dispatch and sharing are not privacy-preserving cloud storage.
README demo moderation statement is not backed by a functioning inspected moderation implementation.
No EXIF organization, face recognition, similarity deduplication, photo albums, encrypted vault, durable job resume or recoverable trash was established.
README one-click installation explicitly warns it installs nginx/MySQL and expects a clean server; it was not run.

gaps: Primary documentation is sparse beyond README/API examples; source provides most detail.
External provider operability and moderation availability remain unresolved.
No security audit or live behavior validation was performed.

R39.summary: Photographer-oriented published gallery with a GPU/HDR viewer, storage-adapter build pipeline and optional database-backed multi-tenant CMS.
deployment: Self-hosted web gallery and builder CLI
Docker deployment documented through official companion repository
Optional backend/SaaS mode with PostgreSQL and Redis
Native iOS 18+ companion, distributed via TestFlight link
R39.storage_model: Static mode builds a JSON manifest and JPEG thumbnails from configured originals, retaining URLs into S3-compatible/B2/GitHub/local/Eagle storage. Backend mode stores photo metadata in PostgreSQL and injects a tenant-specific live manifest; originals remain in configured object/file storage. Optional plugins publish derived assets separately.
R39.privacy_model: Gallery publication and remote storage are explicit design choices, not end-to-end encrypted personal backup. A local provider avoids mandatory cloud storage; maps, external providers, Git synchronization, hosted SaaS, OAuth and push notifications introduce deployment-dependent network services.
maturity_notes: Pinned cdeada392f4bcdc9e8ddaceb61eed6051f93caa1; manifest has no tagged release. Inventory describes pinned main documentation/source, not a released binary guarantee.
README describes multi-size thumbnails, but detailed pipeline documents one 600px JPEG per photo; generation behavior is recorded at the more specific level.

License is ANL v1.0: MIT library code and AGPL project code with UI attribution. SaaS guide additionally says commercial rights are not granted, in tension with the root license's no-additional-restrictions wording; commercial adopters need clarification rather than assuming ordinary permissive licensing.

features.name: Localized gallery interface
features.detail: README's application Core Capabilities explicitly lists English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese with Hong Kong/Taiwan variants, Japanese and Korean internationalization. This is UI language support, not AI query-language support; native iOS language parity is not established by that statement.

features.name: Published web gallery
features.detail: Gallery SPA can use a generated static manifest or an SSR host that injects manifest and SEO/OpenGraph data.

features.name: Self-hosting
features.detail: Manual builder/web deployment and an official companion Docker guide are documented; a managed hosted service is an alternative, not required.

features.name: iOS gallery companion
features.detail: Native Swift/UIKit client for iOS 18+ browses galleries and supports push notifications; README links TestFlight, not a claimed camera-roll backup feature.

features.name: Responsive masonry layout
features.detail: Masonry layout adapts gallery presentation to screen size.

features.name: GPU image navigation
features.detail: WebGPU-first viewer falls back to WebGL without navigator.gpu; supports zoom/pan/pinch and double-tap cycling among fit, fill and 100%.

features.name: Mobile touch viewer
features.detail: Pinch and double-tap controls accompany a responsive gallery, with native iOS browsing also available.

features.name: Off-thread tiled decoding
features.detail: Large photos decode in a worker and stream tiles to the GPU instead of decoding entirely on the main UI thread.

features.name: HDR gain-map display
features.detail: Detects JPEG gain maps including Apple HDR photos and composites HDR on compatible high-dynamic-range displays.

features.name: HEIC/HEIF ingestion
features.detail: Build pipeline converts HEIC/HEIF to JPEG and applies EXIF orientation; README also lists TIFF/BMP conversion.

features.name: Paired iPhone Live Photos
features.detail: Lists storage objects before image filtering to identify paired videos and enables playback; detection is configurable.

features.name: Embedded Motion Photos
features.detail: Pipeline detects embedded Motion Photo video or a paired Live Photo, never both for the same item.

features.name: Photographic EXIF display
features.detail: ExifTool extracts camera/lens, focal length, aperture, ISO, GPS and other exposure metadata for viewer and manifest display.

features.name: Embedded keywords and regions
features.detail: Extracts XMP keywords/regions into manifest arrays and merges keywords into gallery tags; missing arrays trigger incremental backfill.

features.name: Named XMP region overlay
features.detail: Region boxes/labels can appear over placeholders and remain aligned while zooming; affected photos switch to a DOM viewer. This consumes existing regions, not automatic face detection.

features.name: Fujifilm film recipes
features.detail: Displays extracted Fujifilm film-simulation settings.

features.name: Folder-derived tags
features.detail: Auto-generates tags from directory structure; Eagle integration can also map folders to tags.

features.name: Tag-driven gallery filtering
features.detail: Pipeline documents merging embedded keywords into existing tags for tag-driven UI; Eagle provider additionally filters by folders and tags.

features.name: Image tone analysis
features.detail: Pipeline computes tone information and stores it in manifest records; this is not documented object tagging or semantic search.

features.name: MapLibre geographic gallery
features.detail: Interactive map uses GPS coordinates; site configuration exposes map style/projection. Offline basemap availability is not established.

features.name: Incremental storage synchronization
features.detail: New objects are processed; LastModified changes rebuild metadata; missing thumbnails regenerate; unchanged manifest/thumbnails are reused and orphaned thumbnails are cleaned after source deletion.

features.name: Local filesystem source
features.detail: Local provider publishes files on the same host without an external storage dependency; configure basePath and baseUrl.

features.name: Object storage adapters
features.detail: Providers support S3-compatible services, B2, Aliyun OSS and Tencent COS, with provider-specific domains/CDN configuration.

features.name: GitHub-backed originals
features.detail: GitHub storage is documented for small galleries/demos with about 1 GB recommended repository size, not unlimited archival scale.

features.name: Eagle library publication
features.detail: Eagle 4 source publishes an existing Eagle library with folder/tag filters and folder-to-tag mapping.

features.name: Builder lifecycle plugins
features.detail: Hooks before/after builds, processing and manifest save permit custom logic and storage rewriting; custom StorageProvider implementations can add backends.

features.name: Derived-asset Git synchronization
features.detail: Bundled opt-in plugin reuses manifest/thumbnails from a Git repository and optionally commits/pushes changes; push needs a token and Git on PATH.

features.name: Remote thumbnail publication
features.detail: Bundled opt-in thumbnail-storage plugin uploads derivatives to default/secondary storage, rewrites URLs, deduplicates uploads per run and falls back to local URLs on upload failure.

features.name: Thumbnail and ThumbHash derivatives
features.detail: Detailed pipeline writes one 600px quality-100 JPEG thumbnail per photo and ThumbHash placeholders; derivatives are reused independently of manifest refreshes.

features.name: Parallel build workers
features.detail: Worker/cluster modes and per-worker/download concurrency are configurable. Tasks begin largest-first to reduce tail latency; cluster mode needs sufficient queued work.

features.name: Continue past failed photos
features.detail: Per-photo errors mark an item failed and continue, while fatal errors terminate nonzero; logs/TUI report counts.

features.name: Selective rebuild controls
features.detail: --force rebuilds all; --force-manifest refreshes metadata while retaining valid thumbnails; --force-thumbnails regenerates thumbnail derivatives.

features.name: Non-writing builder inspection
features.detail: --dry-run performs processing but does not save manifests, clean thumbnails or run plugin side effects; --key-regex limits inspection to matched storage keys.

features.name: Builder command interface
features.detail: CLI supports configuration display, plain logs versus TUI, incremental/rebuild modes and nonzero error exits.

features.name: Social share and rich previews
features.detail: Supports image sharing with dynamic OpenGraph images/SEO metadata and embedding through a public SDK.

features.name: Visitor comments and reactions
features.detail: README explicitly limits visitor comments/reactions to backend-powered galleries, rather than static-only deployments.

features.name: Runtime metadata editing
features.detail: Backend CMS edits titles/tags/descriptions and enabled state in PostgreSQL, with fresh data on refetch/page load without a builder run; tenant admins can also upload.

features.name: Multi-tenant hosted galleries
features.detail: One backend serves isolated tenant workspaces resolved by slug/domain, each with storage and plan configuration.

features.name: Tenant roles and superadmin
features.detail: Tenant roles gate edits and a superadmin manages tenants, content, suspensions/bans and plan overrides.

features.name: Verified tenant domains
features.detail: Backend accepts per-tenant custom domains after DNS CNAME/TXT verification as well as ordinary tenant subdomains.

features.name: Central OAuth gateway
features.detail: Optional SaaS architecture uses a single OAuth callback domain that routes provider responses to per-tenant sessions.

features.name: Billing and plan enforcement
features.detail: Backend includes Creem integration, tenant plans/overrides and request-level usage/quota enforcement. Specific hosted paid-only feature entitlements are not enumerated in inspected docs.

limitations.text: Region overlay alignment assumes embedded coordinates correspond to the EXIF-rotated image and currently switches those photos from GPU to DOM rendering.
Backend caching must not share injected tenant data across tenants; authenticated responses need short TTLs or cache bypass.
GitHub provider is recommended for small collections, and moving providers requires rebuilding/migrating manifest and thumbnail references.
Root license and SaaS commercial-rights wording are inconsistent; exact paid hosted feature gates and commercial permission need clarification.

Face recognition, semantic search, duplicate cleanup, recoverable trash, mobile backup, private album access rules and E2EE are not established by these sources. XMP face-region display must not be conflated with inference.

gaps: No tagged release exists in manifest; sources are pinned main.
Commercial-rights wording and hosted plan entitlements unresolved; performance/renderer behavior was not executed.

R40.summary: Legacy Android camera, local gallery, image editor and multi-service sharing application.
deployment: Android application; historical Google Play and repository release distribution
R40.storage_model: Existing local media folders and all-photo views, local edits, favourites, descriptions and app-specific trash/upload-history data. Sources do not establish embedded-versus-catalogue storage for descriptions.
R40.privacy_model: Local camera/gallery/editing do not require uploading to a provider. Sharing explicitly sends selected media to configured social/cloud services. Store description claims the project does not store user data; this is not a guarantee about destination services. Geotagging is disabled by default and embeds location when enabled.
maturity_notes: Repository is archived in the frozen manifest. Snapshot is development commit 60acbd2e5691d3d2f794b86e1277bfedab481035; latest release v1.11.0 is dated 2020-08-15.
README says development contains ongoing work and master is stable; source-only UI options can be ahead of that release.
Integrated service APIs, Android permissions and voice-assistant behaviour may have changed since the historical release; no live service compatibility was tested.
Acknowledges Open Camera and LeafPic lineage, with OpenCV-based editing.

features.name: Android camera and gallery application
features.detail: README provides Android distribution and development setup; latest frozen release is v1.11.0.

features.name: Built-in camera
features.detail: Take photographs inside the app with advanced scene and white-balance modes and front/rear camera selection.

features.name: Automatic and manual camera controls
features.detail: Official application description explicitly documents automatic and manual camera control; device-specific support is not enumerated.

features.name: Voice-launched camera
features.detail: README describes Google voice actions for taking a picture and selecting front/rear cameras; requires the external voice-assistant integration.

features.name: Optional capture-time geotagging
features.detail: Camera introduction says geotagging starts disabled, requires location permission and records location in saved files when enabled.

features.name: Browse local media in place
features.detail: README explicitly provides local folder and all-photos modes without a mandatory cloud import.

features.name: Folder albums and covers
features.detail: Gallery UI offers folder navigation, album rename, new folders and setting or clearing an album preview/cover.

features.name: Configurable gallery columns
features.detail: Separate folder/media column settings are provided for portrait and landscape layouts.

features.name: Copy and move images
features.detail: Copy/move media to existing or newly created folders; UI asks whether to replace files or make copies.

features.name: Rename image and album
features.detail: UI includes individual image and album rename actions, with a warning when changing an image extension.

features.name: ZIP a folder
features.detail: Gallery exposes folder ZIP creation with progress, cancellation and saved-location feedback.

features.name: Images, video and GIF filters
features.detail: Filter menu distinguishes all media, images, videos and GIFs.

features.name: Name and numeric ordering
features.detail: Sort controls include name, numeric interpretation and ascending order.

features.name: Date-taken ordering
features.detail: Gallery sort menu includes date and date taken.

features.name: Order by file size
features.detail: Size is explicitly listed among gallery sort choices.

features.name: Timed image slideshow
features.detail: Gallery has slideshow and interval controls; later validation text restricts interval input to 2–10 seconds.

features.name: Full-resolution zoom behaviour
features.detail: Viewer settings allow delaying full-size loading or loading the full image only when zoomed in.

features.name: Internal video player
features.detail: Settings explicitly permit the embedded video player instead of another app; historical service compatibility is unrelated to this local feature.

features.name: GIF media category
features.detail: Gallery offers GIF filtering and the release lists an Android GIF drawable dependency; exact animation performance is not measured.

features.name: Dark and AMOLED themes
features.detail: Choose white, dark or dark AMOLED themes, primary/accent colours, navigation styling and a separate media-viewer theme.

features.name: Favourite photo collection
features.detail: Long-select or use the heart action to add/remove favourites, including multiple selected images; the collection has a dedicated view.

features.name: Photo descriptions
features.detail: README supports adding descriptions; UI provides create, update and delete feedback. Embedded metadata writing is not established.

features.name: Image technical details
features.detail: Details UI includes EXIF, device, orientation, location, path, type and resolution, with missing-data states.

features.name: Crop with aspect ratios
features.detail: Transform section provides cropping, with free and preset ratios including 1:1, 3:2, 7:5 and 16:9 in UI resources.

features.name: Rotate images
features.detail: Transform rotates images; gallery UI specifically lists left/right 90-degree and 180-degree rotations. Flip is not established by the inspected feature list.

features.name: Filters and tonal adjustment
features.detail: OpenCV-based filters plus contrast, hue, saturation, temperature, tint and sharpness controls are explicitly documented.

features.name: Stickers and handwriting
features.detail: Add facial/expression/object/comment/wish/emoji/hashtag stickers and draw handwritten content on images.

features.name: Compress by dimensions or size
features.detail: Gallery action text exposes separate compression-by-dimensions and compression-by-size workflows; exact compression algorithm is not established.

features.name: Affix selected images
features.detail: Affix combines at least two images horizontally or vertically, with output-format, quality and save-in-current-album controls; videos are explicitly rejected.

features.name: Editor undo and redo
features.detail: README documents back/forward editing steps; this is editing history, not a durable journal for file moves and deletions.

features.name: Destructive-action and discard confirmation
features.detail: UI asks before deleting images/albums, permanently clearing trash and discarding crop/rotation/filter/annotation edits.

features.name: App-specific trash and restore
features.detail: Move to TrashBin, restore individually/all, or permanently delete; help says only images deleted inside Phimpme appear here.

features.name: Hide versus exclude folders
features.detail: Hide creates .nomedia and can affect other apps; exclusion affects this gallery recursively, with an option to choose a parent directory. Neither is described as encryption.

features.name: Connected social and cloud sharing
features.detail: Historical README lists Facebook, Messenger, Twitter, Nextcloud, ownCloud, Imgur, Dropbox, Box, Flickr, Pinterest, Instagram, WhatsApp and Tumblr. Some builds need service API keys/application IDs and external accounts; current provider compatibility is unverified.

features.name: Upload history
features.detail: Dedicated history offers latest/last-first ordering and clear-history confirmation; clearing history is not documented as deleting provider copies.

features.name: Upload and archive progress
features.detail: UI defines per-provider upload progress/success/retry notifications and ZIP operation progress/completion.

features.name: Defer high-resolution loading
features.detail: Viewer can delay full-size image loading until zoom, and automatic media refresh can be disabled for large libraries according to its setting help.

features.name: Local capture and editing
features.detail: Local gallery and editing precede optional connected-service sharing; official store text claims the project does not store users' data.

limitations.text: Archived project with a 2020 latest release; provider authentication, Google voice actions and modern Android compatibility were not verified. Listed integrations are historical documented functionality, not a promise of current service availability.
Sharing builds require API keys/application IDs for several external services, and sharing intentionally sends images off-device.
Trash contains only images deleted in this application. Hiding uses .nomedia and is not a secure encrypted vault.
Affix cannot combine videos and needs at least two images; gallery auto-refresh help recommends disabling it for very large collections.

No inspected evidence establishes semantic search, face recognition, exact duplicate detection, encrypted backup, sidecar writing or a durable file-operation journal. Isolated Tags/Timeline string labels were not treated as implemented features.

gaps: No substantive separate manual beyond README-derived documentation; official store description, detailed UI guidance and release notes used.
Source-UI-only features marked medium confidence; external integrations not live-tested.
Focused pinned-tree localization discovery and inspected English UI documentation did not establish multiple translated interface languages; this remains undocumented, not explicitly unsupported.

R41.summary: Unix-oriented exact-content duplicate and filesystem-lint scanner that emits reviewable action scripts, with optional byte comparison, tree deduplication, caches, reflink operations and a Shredder GUI.
deployment: Linux CLI and distribution packages
Source builds on other Unices including FreeBSD, Darwin and Solaris; Linux is primary target
Optional Python/GTK Shredder desktop frontend
R41.storage_model: Traverses existing files directly. Normal scanning emits shell/JSON reports without deleting media. Optional caches write checksums/timestamps into filesystem extended attributes; replay consumes saved JSON. Separate generated scripts or standalone --dedupe perform changes.
R41.privacy_model: Local filesystem analysis does not require hosted media services. Hash caches, JSON reports and scripts contain paths and other file metadata. Custom handlers can invoke external tools, so privacy depends on those configured commands.
maturity_notes: Frozen master fd20430ef830eab25b5726df8498a04d9a4b804f; latest release v2.11.0 dated 2026-11-01.
Tutorial marks duplicate-tree merging experimental and GUI documentation warns it is still developing; old GUI dependency text is superseded by v2.11.0's Python 3.12/GTK 3.22 minimums.
Tutorial and manpage contain some differing historical defaults; precise current option semantics below follow pinned manpage and v2.11.0 notes rather than generic examples.
Performance descriptions are project claims, not benchmarks run here.

This evidence establishes terminal-interface localization, not completeness of every Shredder GUI translation.

features.name: Noninteractive filesystem CLI
features.detail: Scan file/directory arguments or stdin; normal execution produces reports/scripts rather than interactively deleting files.

features.name: Linux distribution packages
features.detail: Linux is the primary target and README points to distribution packages; other Unices compile with some optimizations unavailable.

features.name: Shredder GTK frontend
features.detail: rmlint --gui launches separately installed GUI dependencies; 2.11.0 requires Python 3.12/GTK 3.22 for the GUI.

features.name: Analyze files in place
features.detail: No media import/catalogue copying is required; scans supplied filesystem paths.

features.name: Multi-root scans
features.detail: Scan several file/directory roots in a run and rank their relative importance.

features.name: Configurable content hashing
features.detail: Default BLAKE2b content matching with alternative BLAKE3, SHA, MD5, Highway, Metro, Murmur and xxHash variants. 64-bit hashes are explicitly discouraged for duplicate safety.

features.name: Paranoid byte comparison
features.detail: --paranoid or --algorithm=paranoid compares file bytes rather than relying on digest equality.

features.name: Whole duplicate directory trees
features.detail: --merge-directories aggregates matching file content into duplicate trees. Default equality disregards names/layout and empty-file contents; --honour-dir-layout requires matching relative layout. Marked experimental in tutorial.

features.name: Ordered original-selection policies
features.detail: Rank by root order, mtime, basename/path alphabetic order, depth, basename length, path/name regex and inner/outer hardlink counts. Criteria chain provides deterministic tie-breaks; default is pOma.

features.name: Tagged original roots and protected copies
features.detail: Paths after // are preferred, but preference alone does not protect every tagged copy. --keep-all-tagged protects all, and --must-match-tagged limits candidates to groups represented in those roots.

features.name: Size-bounded duplicate scan
features.detail: Configure inclusive min/max sizes with decimal/binary units; empty files are separate lint by default. 2.11 adds a directory st_size lower-bound flag useful for Ceph rbytes.

features.name: Name and relative-path match constraints
features.detail: Require same/different basename, extension, extensionless name, parent directory or relative path in addition to content matching; optional case-insensitivity is ASCII-only, not fuzzy-image/name matching.

features.name: Incremental mtime and tolerance filters
features.detail: Scan files newer than a timestamp or updated stamp file, retaining size siblings as comparison candidates. Separate mtime-window requires content-equal files to lie within a time window, which can transitively chain groups.

features.name: Explicit byte-range comparison
features.detail: Clamp start/end by byte offset, percentage or factor to compare part of each file, e.g. excluding a fixed header. Results are partial-content matches, not exact whole-file duplicates.

features.name: Traversal boundaries and link handling
features.detail: Limit depth, mount crossing, hidden files and permission eligibility; follow symlinks, ignore them or compare their target strings. Loop detection is documented when following links.

features.name: Composable input selection
features.detail: Use find or another selector to pipe paths, including NUL-separated paths, rather than a built-in arbitrary include/exclude regex engine.

features.name: Handle existing hardlink aliases
features.detail: Default considers hardlinks; --keep-hardlinked preserves aliases of the original, while --no-hardlinked considers only the highest-ranked member and ignores other aliases.

features.name: Extended-attribute checksum cache
features.detail: Separate read/write/clear xattr controls cache checksum and timestamp; requires filesystem support and write access for writes, and relies on mtime to invalidate stale values. Cross-endian portability depends on algorithm.

features.name: Merge and replay prior scans
features.detail: Replay saved JSON to change ranking/filter/output or merge previous runs without rehashing. It does not discover new paths and ignores entries whose mtime changed; hashing/traversal options no longer apply.

features.name: Multiple report and action formats
features.detail: Emit JSON including optional linewise records, CSV, shell/Python scripts, fdupes-compatible blocks, unique paths, timestamps and summaries; multiple outputs can coexist.

features.name: Unique-file inventory and complete hashes
features.detail: Unique-path formatter emits nonduplicate paths; --hash-unmatched completes hashes for same-size nonduplicates, while --hash-uniques hashes every traversed file, including unique sizes.

features.name: Hardlink action plans
features.detail: Generated scripts can replace duplicates with hardlinks; they require same filesystem and can fall back to symlinks when configured.

features.name: Symbolic-link action plans
features.detail: Script handlers can replace duplicates with links to the selected original.

features.name: Reflink/extent deduplication
features.detail: Supports reflink copy or kernel-verified FIDEDUPERANGE clone on capable filesystems. Standalone --dedupe checks equality, shares extents and preserves destination metadata; optional readonly mode targets Btrfs snapshots with root.

features.name: Ordered action fallbacks
features.detail: Configure comma-separated handlers; smart link tries clone, reflink, hardlink then symlink. Default script handler is permanent remove, not trash.

features.name: Review and dry-run action plans
features.detail: Normal scan does not delete files; scripts can be inspected/edited first, Python output provides dry run, and GUI explicitly distinguishes dry versus destructive execution.

features.name: Script confirmation and GUI recheck
features.detail: Generated shell script prompts before proceeding unless bypassed; GUI guide says files are rechecked before deletion and presents editable keep/delete marks.

features.name: External trash integration
features.detail: Tutorial shows a custom handler invoking separately installed trash-cli; OS trash is not the normal built-in remove handler.

features.name: Custom duplicate handlers
features.detail: Shell handlers receive duplicate and original paths; generated Python scripts can be customized for specialized actions.

features.name: Find empty files
features.detail: Dedicated selectable empty-file lint type, independently configurable from duplicate content matching.

features.name: Find nested empty directories
features.detail: Finds empty directories including nested empty trees.

features.name: Find broken symbolic links
features.detail: badlinks identifies symbolic links without valid targets.

features.name: Find invalid owner/group IDs
features.detail: badids identifies files with unresolved UID/GID ownership.

features.name: Find unstripped binaries
features.detail: Optional lint type identifies binaries retaining debug symbols; it is not enabled by default.

features.name: Scriptable file/tree equality check
features.detail: --equal returns status indicating whether multiple files or directory contents match and accepts paranoid mode; directory layout is not automatically part of equality.

features.name: Standalone parallel hash utility
features.detail: --hash operates like a multithreaded checksum tool over paths or stdin using supported hash algorithms.

features.name: Inspect physical sharing
features.detail: --is-reflink distinguishes reflinks, hardlinks, identical paths, different devices, symlinks, unavailable extent information and inline extents through exit statuses.

features.name: Parallel traversal and hashing
features.detail: Configurable worker count defaults to 16; setting it to one does not make the entire program single-threaded.

features.name: Bound hashing/comparison memory
features.detail: --limit-mem caps memory for hashing/paranoid comparison, not total process RSS; path/index and other overhead remain.

features.name: Rotational-disk extent ordering
features.detail: Optional FIEMAP reads physical file extents to optimize disk access; disabled automatically where unavailable.

features.name: Live GUI scan results
features.detail: Shredder streams CLI JSON into a tree while scanning and allows editing keep/delete decisions after scan.

features.name: GUI structured result filters
features.detail: Filter path text plus size ranges, mtime and twin count; generate scripts for all results or only visible results.

features.name: Duplicate distribution chart
features.detail: GUI charts duplicate distribution across scanned directories and shows a running affected-byte count during script execution.

limitations.text: Translation guide calls internationalization rudimentary; Japanese catalogue header says its AI-assisted translation has not been reviewed by the submitter. Localization coverage/linguistic quality was not runtime-tested.

Normal scan is non-destructive, but generated scripts default to permanent removal and standalone --dedupe changes storage extents. Review plus independent backup is recommended; scripts/replay are not an undo journal.

Do not change scanned trees while directory merging or its removal scripts run. Tree mode consumes extra memory, defers output, ignores layout by default and cannot combine with sh:clone; sh:link is suggested instead.
mtime-based xattr caches can become unsafe if contents change without timestamp changes. Clamped ranges intentionally identify only partial duplicates. Weak hash choices increase collision risk.
Reflinks require supported filesystems/kernel features; hardlinks cannot span filesystems. 2.11 generally skips files under 4 KiB for cloning because they may use inline extents.

No inspected evidence establishes perceptual photo/video similarity, photo thumbnails, face recognition, media playback, EXIF catalogue editing, a recoverable operation journal or crash-safe transactional cleanup.

gaps: No runtime filesystem/codec tests; performance figures in cautions were not adopted as our benchmarks.
Historical tutorial defaults may differ from the current manpage/release; profile follows the latter for exact options.

R42.summary: Directory-first self-hosted web gallery for browsing existing media with rich structured search, metadata-derived people/maps, scoped shares and scheduled derivative generation.
deployment: Officially recommended Docker on low-resource servers including Raspberry Pi
Native Node.js installation possible but explicitly unsupported
R42.storage_model: Source directory tree is the source of truth; SQLite (recommended) or MySQL index is treated as rebuildable cache. Thumbnails, converted photos/videos and job data use separate writable locations. Core browsing is read-only, but explicitly enabled uploads write new files to the source directory.
R42.privacy_model: Self-hosted originals with configurable authentication, roles and media/directory allow/block queries. Optional OIDC provider and online map tile/geocoding services add network dependencies. Reads externally assigned face metadata rather than claiming face recognition; shares cannot exceed creator access.
maturity_notes: Manifest release 3.5.2 (2026-01-24), pinned master aea3bd3e5bb77104dabc9adddbfaa1d5875c776c contains later documentation/settings.
FAQ says no database upgrade scripts and no fixed release schedule; breaking changes can require resetting DB/config.
README says source folder is never modified, but feature manual/release and UploadManager establish opt-in uploads; read-only claim applies to browsing, not every enabled operation.
Feature/release prose says ORCID, while detailed config explicitly implements OIDC; generic OIDC is the precise supported claim.

features.name: Responsive browser gallery
features.detail: PiGallery2 is explicitly a photo-gallery website with a responsive interface for phone, tablet and desktop browsers; Docker is the recommended server deployment rather than a native client-app distribution.

features.name: Translated web interface
features.detail: Detailed feature manual explicitly lists internationalization with full translation support; it does not enumerate every available language or establish complete translation of every current string.

features.name: Refine the open directory or search result
features.detail: Feature manual describes a local filter panel that further narrows the current directory or search results, distinct from submitting the full structured query language.

features.name: Self-hosted directory gallery
features.detail: Browser interface points at an existing photo tree and is intended for low-resource hardware; speed is a project claim, not a measured benchmark.

features.name: Official Docker deployment
features.detail: Docker is official/recommended; native Node.js installation is possible but unsupported.

features.name: In-place directory indexing
features.detail: Shows the original folder hierarchy recursively without mandatory reimport; database is a cache, not the authority for source organization.

features.name: Read-only browsing pipeline
features.detail: Original media folder needs read permission; derived assets go to separate writable temp folder. Explicit upload mode is an exception that adds files.

features.name: Demand/scheduled reindexing
features.detail: Cached-folder timeout and reindex sensitivity control scans; never mode indexes only unseen folders or explicit jobs, and scheduled default indexing processes changes only.

features.name: Folder/file exclusion rules
features.detail: Skip folder names/paths/globs, folders containing marker files, or photo/video filename globs; matching is case-sensitive and default excludes common trash directories.

features.name: Hierarchy and optional flattened browsing
features.detail: Directory navigation includes recursive subfolders; optional flatten button lists all descendants, with documented same-path limitation.

features.name: Responsive on-scroll photo grid
features.detail: Phone/tablet/desktop grid renders on demand while scrolling and prioritizes visible thumbnails; no stronger virtualized-row guarantee is inferred.

features.name: Photo/video lightbox
features.detail: Fullscreen viewer includes EXIF panel, captions/face overlays, low-resolution placeholder before full image and keyboard/swipe navigation.

features.name: Full-resolution on zoom
features.detail: Lightbox can load original resolution when zoomed or cached previews are too small.

features.name: Automatic lightbox slideshow
features.detail: Configurable interval (default five seconds), loop slideshow and separate video loop controls.

features.name: Query-driven photo-frame mode
features.detail: Generates a looping display link for a directory or search, suitable for kiosk apps; recurring-date queries can produce anniversary frames.

features.name: Theme/color modes
features.detail: Configurable automatic theme mode, selected theme and custom CSS theme definitions.

features.name: Browser video playback
features.detail: Direct formats MP4/WebM/OGV/OGG; other listed formats such as MKV/MOV/AVI require conversion.

features.name: FFmpeg derivative transcoding
features.detail: Produces MP4 or WebM, with configurable bitrate, height, FPS, codecs, CRF, preset and custom input/output flags; thumbnails use ffmpeg/ffprobe.

features.name: Apple Live Photo pairing
features.detail: Current config enables pairing still image and companion video by Content Identifier metadata; pinned-branch feature may postdate manifest release.

features.name: Conditional DNG/ARW support
features.detail: Feature list marks DNG/ARW support dependent on container libvips build; not a universal camera RAW decoder guarantee.

features.name: Conditional HEIC rendering
features.detail: HEIC is listed with container/libvips compatibility caveat and browser/Sharp conversion requirements.

features.name: AVIF configured format
features.detail: Current supported-photo list includes AVIF with browser/Sharp capability caveat.

features.name: SVG viewing with upload restriction
features.detail: SVG is in viewing format list but blocked for uploads by default because SVG can contain scripts.

features.name: Animated GIF derivative support
features.detail: animateGif converts GIF to animated WebP and defaults on.

features.name: Technical metadata panel
features.detail: Viewer displays EXIF, tags/keywords, locations and GPS read from files.

features.name: IPTC captions in display
features.detail: captionFirstNaming optionally displays IPTC 120 caption instead of filenames; not metadata-writing support.

features.name: Imported face-region metadata
features.detail: Reads Adobe XMP face regions, draws bounding boxes and exposes people browsing/search. Does not perform automatic face detection/recognition according to inspected evidence.

features.name: Structured boolean/range queries
features.detail: Exact/wildcard and negated filters, AND/OR, comparator ranges and n-of expressions; autocomplete suggests files/directories/captions/places/people/keywords.

features.name: Filename/directory/caption search
features.detail: file_name, directory, caption and any_text queries support exact or wildcard forms; directory glob /* includes the directory and all descendants.

features.name: Date ranges and recurring memories
features.detail: Date ranges and relative recurring windows such as last four days every week/month/year or a shifted past period are documented.

features.name: Metadata rating filters
features.detail: Supports equality, ranges, comparisons and negation on ratings read from media; does not establish rating editing.

features.name: Resolution/orientation filters
features.detail: Resolution query uses megapixels with ranges/comparators; portrait/landscape orientation queries also supported.

features.name: Person names and face count filters
features.detail: person name queries and person-count numeric ranges search imported face metadata; faces tab access and starring require configurable roles.

features.name: Keyword metadata search
features.detail: keyword searches can drive logical albums; FAQ suggests assigning unique keywords in external Lightroom/digiKam rather than editing them here.

features.name: Place names and distance queries
features.detail: Position searches city/state/country; distance forms such as 5-km-from:(New York) query nearby photos.

features.name: Logical albums
features.detail: Any search query can be saved as a logical album; .pg2conf is used for saved search/config behavior, distinct from conventional database-only manual albums.

features.name: Per-directory name/date/random sorting
features.detail: Empty .order_[ORDER].pg2conf overrides only that folder, choosing ascending/descending name/date or random; not recursive.

features.name: Date grouping with timezone policy
features.detail: Photo/search default grouping is date; configurable timestamp-offset handling uses local wall-clock time or global time, assuming UTC where offset missing.

features.name: Map photos via pluggable tile providers
features.detail: Uses OpenStreetMap or configured Mapbox/custom tile URLs, with photo markers and clickable full-view photos; Mapbox requires token.

features.name: GPX routes with activity styles
features.detail: Displays GPX paths and differentiates activities such as running/flying with colors/icons; configurable path bending handles long flight segments.

features.name: Lossy GPX compression
features.detail: On-demand/scheduled compression removes too-close or near-collinear points using distance, temporal spacing and deviation thresholds.

features.name: Folder-local dated Markdown stories
features.detail: Displays .md files near gallery/map; pg-date comments attach sections to dates, enabling narrative photo presentation.

features.name: Scoped directory/search links
features.detail: Share a folder with optional descendants or search results; effective access intersects share query with creator media/directory permissions, not merely opening-page scope.

features.name: Password-protected shares
features.detail: Links optionally require passwords, and instance policy can require passwords for all shares.

features.name: Built-in accounts
features.detail: Authentication/user management configurable; roles include Limited Guest, Guest, User, Admin and Developer, with sharing users constrained separately.

features.name: Role capabilities and visibility rules
features.detail: Admins manage settings/duplicate view; Users can share/list faces/random links. Per-user/global media and directory allow/block queries are independent; block wins and unavailable paths return 404.

features.name: Optional OIDC login
features.detail: Issuer/client/scopes/claims, allowed email domains, optional account creation and default role are configurable; strict linking can bind identity and cap eligible roles.

features.name: Opt-in directory uploads
features.detail: Disabled by default, minimum role Admin by default; optional .uploader.pg2conf requirement whitelists target directories, with blocked extensions and per-file errors.

features.name: Reject existing upload destinations
features.detail: Upload validates plain filename/root containment and rejects existing path with FileAlreadyExists before writing; no claim of race-proof transactional writes.

features.name: ZIP download of visible results
features.detail: Config enables zipped download of listed directory or search results.

features.name: Possible duplicates by metadata
features.detail: Admin-only duplicate view groups equal name+size or creation-date+size and merges overlapping groups; default listing limit 1000. No hashes, byte comparison or perceptual similarity are used in examined method.

features.name: Multisize cached derivatives
features.detail: On-demand thumbnail/preview sizes default 320/540/1080/2160, persisted outside originals with visible-photo priority; more sizes trade CPU/storage for quality.

features.name: Concurrent thumbnail generation
features.detail: Thumbnail workers default to CPU count minus one with configurable concurrency cap; this is derivative processing, not a claim of parallel scanning or perceptual matching.

features.name: Scheduled processing chains
features.detail: Schedules indexing, cover filling, photo/video conversion, GPX compression and temp cleanup with after-job dependencies, bounded database batches and retained progress history.

features.name: Optional gallery auto-refresh
features.detail: AutoUpdate polls for new photos/videos at configurable interval, default 60 seconds when enabled; not a filesystem event watcher.

features.name: Random image endpoint links
features.detail: Creates a URL serving a random photo, useful for external wallpaper/photo-frame applications and subject to user rights.

features.name: Server-side extension system
features.detail: Separate server.js extensions receive lifecycle/config/REST hooks and limited photo UI buttons; configured dependency installation may run at initialization and repository discovery reads an online list.

limitations.text: No database migrations are provided; release 3.5.2 warns search changes can break saved queries, shares/random links and config, and photo-button extension contracts changed.
Read-only browsing does not mean an instance with uploads enabled cannot write original folders; upload defaults off and must be permission/whitelist configured.
Duplicate candidates are metadata heuristics, not verified content equality; imported face regions are not machine recognition.
Metafiles are visible whenever their directory is available even if media filters hide photos; block the directory to hide its Markdown/GPX/config files.
Default search caps are 10,000 media and 200 directories. RAW/HEIC depend on libvips/browser conversion support. Disabled authentication defaults to Admin role unless changed.
No inspected evidence establishes E2EE, guaranteed offline maps/geocoding, destructive duplicate cleanup, trash/undo, or built-in face recognition.

gaps: Configuration decorative SVG and duplicate JSON representations omitted; functional option groups read.
Share expiry not established in inspected manual and not inferred.
No runtime performance or deployment tests; current-branch additions distinguished from release.

R43.summary: Self-hosted photography gallery emphasizing timeline/album/map presentation, large-image viewing, Live Photos and web-based upload administration.
deployment: Recommended self-hosted Docker image
Node.js 22 source deployment
Separate ChronoFrame Cloud hosted offering
R43.storage_model: Mounted data directory holds database, settings, session secret and local photos; dashboard uploads generate previews and indexing data. Supports multiple configured local/S3/OpenList storage schemes but switching the default affects future uploads only, not existing originals.
R43.privacy_model: Self-hosted local storage is supported. Optional map tiles and reverse geocoding call MapTiler/Mapbox/Nominatim services, OAuth contacts GitHub and custom analytics can introduce tracking. Hidden/password albums protect application routes, not already public object-storage/CDN URLs; docs recommend local storage for protected files.
maturity_notes: Frozen commit 3f44c6b8d10625698889bfe610a690e4e2379f98; latest v1.2.0 release published 2026-11-09.
v1.0 introduced setup/database-managed settings and migration from earlier environment configuration; old configuration guides are explicitly archived.
Current license is AGPL-3.0-only for application, with MIT exceptions for contracts/WebGL packages; hosted Cloud is separate from self-hosted deployment.
No live demo was contacted and no uploaded private media was used.
