features.name: Current-source WebDAV storage adapter
features.detail: Branch source implements authenticated PUT, MKCOL, DELETE and proxy GET for a configured WebDAV provider, but README/release do not establish packaged open-source availability.

features.name: Drag/drop, clipboard and batch uploads
features.detail: Upload images by drag/drop or pasting screenshots with Ctrl+V; supports multiple images and guest/user management.

features.name: Batch remote-URL upload
features.detail: Newline-separated URLs are processed server-side, with a configurable referer, per-guest/user count limit and counts for failures/excess URLs.

features.name: Current-branch chunk upload endpoints
features.detail: Source exposes uploadChunkFile and processFile/merge endpoints for web and client routes; this establishes branch support, not guaranteed 20240319 package parity or restart-resume semantics.

features.name: Account duplicate-upload check
features.detail: README lists account-level duplicate checking on upload; upload endpoint accepts optional MD5. Full comparison/verification semantics are not established, so this is not claimed as byte-verified library cleanup.

features.name: Temporary image retention
features.detail: README advertises timed temporary image storage and upload methods accept a day value; cleanup timing, provider removal and cache expiry are not established.

features.name: Personal image gallery and detail cards
features.detail: README documents personal album browsing and image-information cards.

features.name: Paged gallery and image results
features.detail: Album and image queries accept page number/size and return total counts with selected rows.

features.name: Create and edit share galleries
features.detail: Gallery controller creates a titled set of image references, supports editing membership/title and lists/deletes galleries by user/admin context.

features.name: Gallery-specific image notes
features.detail: Gallery membership stores per-image notes along with URL/name references; embedded original-file metadata is not modified by the inspected controller.

features.name: Recorded image-name editing
features.detail: Rename action changes the recorded idname for a stored image identifier; physical object-key renaming is not established.

features.name: Image-name search
features.detail: selectPhoto passes a nonempty searchname into the image query; ordinary users are constrained to their own user ID.

features.name: Image-record date-range filter
features.detail: Query accepts start/stop times and rejects reversed ranges; whether dates are capture EXIF or upload timestamps is not established here.

features.name: Administrative record filters
features.detail: Admins can filter by storage source, username/user type, own-versus-all and violation flag, with ascending/descending order selection.

features.name: SVG hosting
features.detail: README explicitly lists SVG among accepted image formats; this does not establish raster editing or thumbnail rendering of SVG.

features.name: WebP and icon image hosting
features.detail: README explicitly names WebP and ICO in addition to common image formats.

features.name: Direct links and gallery sharing
features.detail: README offers direct image links and batch gallery sharing; controller returns generated gallery keys for created collections.

features.name: Optional gallery password
features.detail: Gallery create/update accepts an optional password of at least three non-space characters and gallery listing checks it; not an E2EE or security-audit claim.

features.name: Customizable embed code
features.detail: One-click copy of image embed links with user-defined code format.

features.name: QR codes for direct image links
features.detail: README lists generating a QR code from an image's direct link.

features.name: Accounts and guest uploads
features.detail: Multiple registered users and visitors have separately configurable upload management; registration/password recovery integrate email service.

features.name: Configurable visitor upload capacity
features.detail: Guest uploads can be enabled/disabled and have a shared capacity budget; URL upload count limits distinguish unauthenticated from registered users.

features.name: Per-user quotas and expansion codes
features.detail: Set available user capacity and bulk-generate account-expansion codes; redeeming a valid code increases the account allocation.

features.name: Group-based storage routing
features.detail: Distribution groups associate group name, storage-key ID, user type and compression flag; default group cannot be deleted.

features.name: Configured image content review
features.detail: README describes real-time multithreaded review; configuration requires service API credentials and can enable a selected review provider. No on-device or air-gapped guarantee.

features.name: IP upload blocking
features.detail: Administrator-configurable IP blacklist is explicitly documented.

features.name: Controllable upload API
features.detail: README documents site-controlled upload APIs and source exposes web/client routes; account token can be regenerated with immediate effect.

features.name: Account and site overview
features.detail: Dashboard totals cover own images/galleries/quota usage and, for privileged users, global image/user counts, review and guest-capacity state.

features.name: Monthly upload/library record charts
features.detail: Controller builds twelve monthly counts for a selected year, restricted to current user unless admin requests global data; not a capture-time photo timeline guarantee.

limitations.text: Repository explicitly warns that source is experimental and may not work, and recommends compiled release bundles. Source-only features may differ from the 20240319 package.
WeChat mini-program is paid-Core-only; desktop clients work with both editions. Other paid capabilities are not enumerated precisely and are not merged into this open-source inventory.
Official manual at doc.hellohao.cn could not be retrieved. Storage-provider operational limits, backup/recovery, exact expiry deletion semantics and metadata preservation remain unverified.
Public description mentions watermarking but inspected open-source README/controller evidence does not establish its implementation or edition; no watermark feature is counted as present.
No inspected evidence establishes face recognition, semantic search, photo-GPS maps, perceptual duplicates, app trash, byte-verified copies or E2EE.

gaps: Official external manual unavailable; six targeted source files supplement README and release.
Open-source/Core split is explicit only where evidenced; watermark and current-source WebDAV distribution unresolved.

Chinese UI evidence does not establish a multilingual/localized interface selector; focused pinned-tree localization discovery found no positive evidence, so it remains undocumented rather than unsupported.
